title: 看圖用法：請連同完整詞形理解
content: be noted for N（以……著稱；noted 作形容詞）。請連同例句理解圖片；不要把片語或變化後詞形的意思直接套給單字原形。

title: 看圖用法：請連同完整詞形理解
content: bring forth a plan/idea（提出計畫／想法）；forth 本身是副詞。請連同例句理解圖片；不要把片語或變化後詞形的意思直接套給單字原形。

title: 看圖用法：請連同完整詞形理解
content: range from ... to ...（從……到……不等）。請連同例句理解圖片；不要把片語或變化後詞形的意思直接套給單字原形。

title: 看圖用法：請連同完整詞形理解
content: departed grandmother（已故的奶奶）；departed 在此作形容詞。請連同例句理解圖片；不要把片語或變化後詞形的意思直接套給單字原形。

title: 看圖用法：請連同完整詞形理解
content: identify with sb（對某人有共鳴）。請連同例句理解圖片；不要把片語或變化後詞形的意思直接套給單字原形。

title: pay a visit to + 地方
have a runny nose
content: 表示「流鼻水」。例：Leo stayed home because he had a runny nose and a cough.

title: at an altitude of + 數字
content: ：（海拔）高度。at an altitude of + 數字；易混 attitude。

title: the reason for + N / the reason why + 子句
content: 分別接名詞與完整子句，說明「……的原因」。例：Nobody knows the reason why the lights went out.

title: show／express regret for + N/V-ing
content: 對……表示後悔。例：He expressed regret for missing the family gathering.

title: a chalk（✗）→ a piece of chalk（✓）
content: chalk 為不可數名詞，不可直接用 a chalk，須用 a piece of chalk。

title: make a will
content: 立遺囑。例：The lawyer advised him to make a will.

title: meet a challenge (of...) ＝ rise to a challenge (of...)
go to church
content: 上教堂，做禮拜。例：We go to church together every Sunday.（每個星期天我們都會一起上教堂。）

title: switch / turn... on = switch / turn on...
low/high morale
content: ：士氣（不可數）。low/high morale；raise/boost/improve morale；易混 moral。

title: be high in + 成分
content: 表示「富含某種成分」。例：Beans are high in protein and fiber.

title: foundation 搭配
content: lay a foundation for …＝lay the foundation(s) for …：為…打好地基／奠下基礎。

title: remain 作「仍保持是」解的句型
content: remain 作「仍保持是」解時，之後須接名詞或形容詞作補語，例：remain a puzzle（仍一直是個謎）、remain healthy（保持健康）。

title: from time to time
content: 偶爾、不時。例：I still visit my elementary school from time to time.

title: have faith in...
content: 對……有信心。同義：have trust in...；have belief in...。

title: stress sb out
content: 使某人壓力過大／焦慮不安。

title: get sb sth = get sth for sb
disciplinary action
content: a. 紀律的；片：a disciplinary committee、disciplinary action；詞族：discipline

title: have / get butterflies in one's stomach
content: 某人感到很緊張 = feel very nervous。

title: sit on someone's knee(s)
content: 表示「坐在某人的膝上」。例：The child sat on her grandfather's knee during the story.

title: used to V
content: 過去經常（但現在不再）做……

title: imagine + V-ing
content: 表示想像做某事，後接動名詞，不接 to + 原形動詞。例：Can you imagine living on a small island?

title: a pair of compasses
content: *n.* 指南針；compasses 圓規：a pair of compasses。

title: have had one's fill of + N/V-ing
content: 已經受夠……。例：I've had my fill of listening to this song.（我已經受夠聽這首歌了。）

title: keep sth in order
content: 把某事物整理得井然有序。例：Peter always keeps his room in order.（彼得總是把房間整理得井然有序。）

title: hallway
content: 書頁正式列作 hall 的相關字；本頁其餘為單元收尾，無新增正式片語／文法。

title: model oneself after sb
content: 仿效某人，以某人為榜樣

title: grow up
content: 長大。例：Lawrence wants to be a pianist when he grows up.（勞倫斯長大後想做一名鋼琴家。）

title: fish 複數
content: fish 單複數同形；表不同種類的魚時，可寫 fishes。

title: cramp sb's style
content: ：抽筋；束縛。get/have a cramp；cramp sb's style。

title: charge sb + 費用 (+ for sth)
content: 向某人索取（某物的）費用

title: give sb sth / give sth to sb
content: 雙受詞句型；物品可直接放在人後，也可用 to 改寫。例：Mina gave her brother a card. = Mina gave a card to her brother.

title: fracture A into B
content: ：斷裂；骨折；使斷裂／分裂。fracture one's leg/rib/arm、fracture A into B。

title: spread sth (out)
content: 把某物攤開來；把身體某部位伸展開來。

title: in association with...
content: 與……聯合／合作；= in cooperation with...。

title: make a selection
content: 挑選意中人選；挑選中意的事物。

title: talk rubbish = talk nonsense/garbage
content: *n.* 垃圾（英式、不可數）；美式 garbage / trash；也可指胡說：talk rubbish = talk nonsense/garbage。不可說 a rubbish，可說 a piece of rubbish。

title: since then
content: 從那時起，常與現在完成式搭配。例：We met in fifth grade and have been friends since then.

title: situation 常與介詞 in 並用
content: 本字常與介詞 in 並用。

title: apply A to B
content: 把 A 運用到 B；把 A 塗抹在 B 上

title: love to V / love V-ing
content: 兩者通常都表示「喜愛做……」；V-ing 較強調長期喜好。例：I love reading beside the window on rainy days.

title: kill two birds with one stone
content: 一舉兩得；用一個行動同時完成兩件事。例：Cycling to work lets Mia exercise and save money, killing two birds with one stone.

title: in an ambush
content: ：埋伏突襲；in an ambush；lie/wait in ambush；militia。

title: drive sb crazy
content: 使某人抓狂。例：That noise is driving me crazy.（那噪音讓我抓狂。）

title: focus A on B
content: 把 A 聚焦在 B 上。

title: minimum 句型
content: a minimum of + 數字＝at least + 數字：最少…。

title: walk down the street
content: 表示「沿著街道走」。例：We walked down the street looking for the bookstore.

title: catch fire
content: 著火。例：Paper catches fire easily.（紙張很容易著火。）

title: prefer to V rather than + V
the other side of the coin
content: 從另一方面來說，事情的另一面

title: a piece of...
content: 一塊／片／件／張……。例：a piece of paper/furniture/advice（一張紙／一件傢俱／一則建議）。

title: stop + V-ing
content: 停止做目前正在做的事。

title: delight
content: take delight in ...；To sb's delight, ... = To sb's joy, ...；be delighted at / by / with ...；be delighted that ... = be glad that ...。

title: between A and B
content: 在 A 與 B 之間。

title: one...another...
content: 表示「一個……，另一個……」，後者通常是不特定的另一個。例：One guest ordered soup, and another chose salad.

title: car exhaust fumes
content: n. 煙氣；vi. 發怒；片：car exhaust fumes、fume about / over...、stand sb up

title: sweep across / through + 地方
content: sweep across / through + 地方：襲捲某地方。

title: free time
content: 空閒時間。例：Kent likes to go surfing in his free time.（肯特閒暇時喜歡去衝浪。）

title: meet sb's expectations
content: 符合某人的期望。同義說法：live up to sb's expectations；measure up to sb's expectations。

title: charge sb with sth
content: 指控某人犯了某項罪名

title: an oral test / a written test
have / get ants in one's pants
point sth out / point out sth
content: 指出某事。例：The teacher pointed out two grammar mistakes in my essay.（老師指出我文章中的 2 個文法錯誤。）

title: use sth to V
content: 用某物來做某事。例：We use this app to record new vocabulary.

title: bury / have one's head in the sand
curiosity
content: out of curiosity；Curiosity killed the cat.

title: content 句型
content: be content with …＝be contented with …＝be satisfied with …＝be pleased with …；to one’s heart’s content：使某人心滿意足、盡情地。

title: separate A from B = A be / get separated from B
content: 把 A 與 B 分開

title: mention + N / V-ing / that 子句
content: 表示「提到……」，後面通常不加 about。例：Ella mentioned meeting you at the science fair.

title: else 的位置
content: 用於 any-、every-、no-、some- 開頭的詞及疑問詞之後；else 不用於 which 後。

title: lead / live a(n) + adj. + life
content: 過著某種生活。例：After retiring, they lived a quiet life by the sea.

title: transplant A to B
content: vt. / n. 移植；片：transplant A to B、liver / heart transplant；衍：transplantation

title: a suitable place to V
content: a suitable place to V：適合做……的地方。

title: be on the rise
content: 上升。例：Oil prices are on the rise.（油價上漲中。）

title: sell sb sth = sell sth to sb
measure up to sb's expectations = live up to sb's expectations = meet sb's expectations
the center of...
content: ……的中心點／中央。例：Wall Street has become the center of business in New York City.（華爾街已成為紐約市的商業中心。）

title: be wild about...
content: be wild about... = be crazy / mad about...：瘋狂喜愛……。

title: cancel an order
content: 取消訂單。例：Carl told the manager he wanted to cancel his order.（卡爾告訴經理他想取消他的訂單。）

title: bring sb out of sb's shell
an article of clothing / furniture = a piece of clothing / furniture
pie in the sky = castles in the air
content: 不太可能實現的想法／計畫。

title: sb’s return to / from + 地方
content: 某人回來某地／某人從某地回來。

title: through thick and thin
content: 無論好壞、在任何情況下

title: the head of + 組織／部門
content: 表示「……的主管或領導人」。例：She became the head of the research department.

title: garbage / trash
content: *n.* 垃圾（英式、不可數）；美式 garbage / trash；也可指胡說：talk rubbish = talk nonsense/garbage。不可說 a rubbish，可說 a piece of rubbish。

title: It is a shame that... = It is a pity that... = It is too bad that...
sb's mind is a blank ＝ sb's mind goes blank
an electric appliance = an electrical appliance
rotation of the Earth
content: ：旋轉；輪流。rotation of the Earth、job/crop rotation、in rotation；對照 revolution。

title: be representative of...
content: 代表……。同義說法：stand for...；represent...；be a representation of...。

title: expense 與 expenses
content: expense 可指單筆費用；日常或營運開銷通常使用複數 expenses。例：The company reduced its travel expenses last year.

title: separate A from B
content: 表示「把 A 和 B 分開」。例：Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones.

title: bring sb up / bring up sb
channel A into B
content: 把 A 引入／專注於 B 上

title: perch on / in ...
content: *vi.* 棲息、停留於；*n.* 鳥類棲木。perch on / in ...。

title: It occurs to sb that... ＝ It strikes sb that...
a crackdown on sth
content: ：制裁；鎮壓。a crackdown on sth；crack down on；近 clampdown、control、restriction。

title: be low in + 成分
content: 表示「某種成分含量低」。例：This soup is low in salt.

title: expect sb to V
content: 預期某人會……；要求某人做……

title: one of the all-time greats
content: 史上最傑出的人物之一。例：Many fans consider her one of the all-time greats in tennis.

title: One swallow doesn't make a summer.
content: 孤燕不成夏／一事成功並不代表萬事大吉。

title: It is / seems probable that...
content: 很可能……。同義句型：It is / seems likely that...。

title: be in a good / high mood
trouble oneself with sth
content: 某人為某事而煩惱。例：Don't trouble yourself with trifles.（不要為小事情煩惱。）

title: of cardinal significance/importance
content: ：樞機主教；極為重要的、根本的。of cardinal significance/importance。

title: committee 與 team 常與介詞 on 並用
content: 該字及 team（隊伍）常與介詞 on 並用。

title: a man of good / noble / great character
content: 有品德的人，品德高尚的人

title: for 與 because 表原因
content: for 作連接詞時較書面，通常接在主要子句後補充理由；because 可置於主要子句前或後，直接回答原因。例：We went inside, for the wind was getting stronger.

title: handle a crisis = deal with a crisis = solve / resolve a crisis
base A on / upon B
content: A 根據 B 為基礎

title: attach 句型
content: attach importance to sth：將某事物看得很重要；attach A to B：將 A 附著於 B 上。

title: next to + N
content: 可表示「在……旁邊」；也可表示在喜好或重要性上「僅次於……」。例：Next to music, drawing is her favorite activity.

title: raise a family
content: 表示「養家、扶養孩子」。例：They worked hard to raise their family.

title: learn of...
content: 得知……。例：Candice was shocked when she learned of her friend's marriage.（坎迪絲得知好友結婚的事時感到很震驚。）

title: aid sb in + N/V-ing = assist sb in + N/V-ing = help sb (to) V
be in full swing
content: be in full swing：如火如荼地進行中。

title: obsess about...
content: 片 (2) obsess about... 過分注意……

title: come into existence = come into being
operate / operation
content: *a.* 使用中的；和手術有關的。相關 operate / operation；反義 inoperative。

title: eat out / eat in
content: eat out 是外出用餐；eat in 是在家吃。例：We usually eat in on weekdays and eat out on Saturday.

title: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
content: ：肉湯；soup；Too many cooks spoil the broth.

title: note (that)...
content: 注意到……。例：I noted that Sharon didn't feel well today.（我注意到雪倫今天不太舒服。）

title: in no time
content: 很快地、轉眼間。例：With everyone helping, the room was clean in no time.

title: either 作代名詞的動詞一致
content: either + 單數動詞；either of + 複數名詞 + 複數動詞。

title: stop sb from V-ing
content: 片：restrain sb from V-ing = stop sb from V-ing

title: flee 搭配
content: flee the country：逃出國；flee from …：逃離…。

title: prove to sb that...
content: prove to sb that...：向某人證明……。

title: stick to sth
content: stick to sth：黏住某事物；堅守某事物。

title: have (got) a frog in one's throat
run away (from...)
content: （從……）逃走。例：Little Billy ran away from the big dog.（小比利逃離那隻大狗。）

title: be far from + adj./N/V-ing
content: 遠不及……。例：What Elaine said was far from the truth.（伊蓮所說的跟事實相差甚遠。）

title: television / TV 的冠詞
content: watch television／watch TV 表示看電視，通常不加冠詞；a television 指一台電視機。例：We bought a new television but rarely watch TV.

title: It appears that...
content: 似乎……。＝ It seems that...。例：It appears to me that something is wrong with the plane's engine.（我感覺飛機的引擎似乎有點問題。）

title: a golf club
content: 高爾夫球桿；高爾夫俱樂部。

title: for one thing,... for another,...
content: 首先／一方面……；再者／另一方面……。

title: within a ... radius
content: ：半徑；（半徑）範圍。pl. radii；within a ... radius；對照 diameter。

title: be useful for
content: 對某用途有幫助，後接名詞或 V-ing。例：This small brush is useful for cleaning keyboards.

title: a.m./p.m. 用法
content: 通常用小寫，須置於阿拉伯數字後，且不可與 o'clock 並用（10 a.m. 正確；a.m. 10、ten a.m.、10 o'clock a.m. 皆錯）。

title: on (the) air
content: （廣播、電視）播出。例：The program will soon be on the air.（這節目很快就要播出。）

title: rap on/at ...
content: ：饒舌樂；敲擊；批評、責備。rap music、rap on/at ...、rap sb for sth；rapper。

title: bribe sb to V/with sth
content: ：賄賂（n./v.）。bribe sb to V/with sth；accept/take a bribe；bribery；易混 bride。

title: while sth away / while away sth
make a discovery
content: 表示「有所發現、取得新發現」。例：The researchers made an unexpected discovery in the cave.

title: alert
content: be on the alert for ...；be alert to ...；alert sb to sth = awaken sb to sth。

title: a shooting star / meteor
content: *n.* 彗星。Halley’s Comet；相關 a shooting star / meteor。

title: Dr. 縮寫
content: doctor 縮寫成 Dr. 時，用於人名前、表稱呼。

title: a commander in chief = a commander-in-chief
content: 總司令（複數為 commanders in chief）。

title: get + 形容詞
content: 表示「逐漸變得……」。例：The nights are getting colder.

title: go + adj.
content: 連綴動詞表「變成」，後接形容詞作主詞補語；如 go bad / sour（食物腐敗）。

title: order sb to V
content: 命令某人做……。例：Don't order me to do this or that.（別命令我做這做那的。）

title: turn into / turn A into B
content: turn into 是變成；turn A into B 是把 A 變成 B。例：The rain turned into snow, turning the road into ice.

title: personal space
content: 表示「個人空間」，包括身體周圍或具有私人性質的範圍。例：Please respect other people's personal space on the train.

title: body temperature / body language
content: 分別表示「體溫／肢體語言」。例：Her body language showed that she felt uncomfortable.

title: grieve over/for sth
content: ：哀悼。mourn sb's death／mourn for sb；近 grieve over/for sth；mournful。

title: far 的不規則比較級／最高級
content: far 的形容詞、副詞比較級和最高級為不規則變化：far, farther / further，farthest / furthest。

title: a gap between A and B
content: 表示 A 與 B 之間的差距、間隔或時間差。例：There is a six-year gap between the two buildings.

title: not to be sneezed at
content: *vi./n.* 打噴嚏；be nothing to sneeze at（美）＝not to be sneezed at（英）：不可小覷、很重要。hiccup 打嗝。

title: in the air
content: 空氣中。例：There was a sense of excitement in the air.（空氣中充斥著刺激感。）

title: buy + 說法／藉口
content: 口語表示「相信、接受某人的說法」。例：I don't buy his excuse for missing the meeting.

title: cope
content: cope with ...；書上同列 deal with、handle。

title: go to the bathroom = use the bathroom
little 作形容詞
content: 表「不多的」時，其後接不可數名詞。

title: be / get soaked to the skin = be / get wet to the skin
a mix of A and B
labor force
content: *n.* 勞動力（常用單數）；labor force；staff 員工。

title: refer to + N
content: 可表示「提到、指的是、查閱」。例：The word “they” refers to the two visitors.

title: pick sb up / pick up sb
presentation
content: give/make a presentation/report；present sb with sth。

title: from time to time = at times = sometimes = on occasion = occasionally
sb's persistence in + N/V-ing
content: *n.* 堅持；持續（皆不可數）：sb's persistence in + N/V-ing。

title: commitment 句型
content: make a commitment to + V：致力要…。

title: quarrel with
content: quarrel with sb about / over sth＝have a quarrel with sb about / over sth：因某事與某人起爭執。

title: take pride in... ＝ pride oneself on... ＝ be proud of...
allowance
content: make an allowance for ...＝考慮…；=take ... into consideration／take ... into account。

title: take sb's order
content: 接受某人的點餐。例：The waiter came to take my order.（服務生過來幫我點餐。）

title: drunk driving
content: 酒駕。（書頁標「延伸」，屬片語性複合詞，非獨立詞條，掛於 drive 詞條下。）

title: the apple of one's eye
content: 表示「某人最珍愛的人或物」。例：Their youngest daughter is the apple of her grandfather's eye.

title: be all ears
content: 表示「洗耳恭聽、全神貫注地聽」。例：Tell me what happened—I'm all ears.

title: be particular about... = be picky / choosy about...
a big fish in a small pond
quite a few + 複數可數名詞
content: 表示「相當多、不少」，意思不是「很少」。例：Quite a few students joined the weekend workshop.

title: a great loss to sb
content: 對某人而言是一大損失。

title: get / have a tooth cavity filled
content: 片：get / have a tooth cavity filled

title: look like
content: 看起來像。例：That cloud looks like a rabbit.

title: a listener / an audience
content: a listener 為一個聽眾；an audience 為一群聽眾。

title: stop + 人 + from V-ing
content: 表示「阻止某人做……」。例：Nothing could stop Mia from entering the competition.

title: consult 搭配
content: consult sb：請教某人；consult with sb：與某人商量／討論。

title: milk + 牛／羊
content: 此處 milk 作動詞，表示「擠……的奶」。例：The farmer taught us how to milk a goat.

title: roam about ...
content: *vi. & vt. & n.* 漫步、遊走。roam about ...；近義 wander / rove。

title: much less
content: 更別說（與否定句並用）。例：Ryan can barely cook meat, much less pasta.（雷恩不會煮肉，更別說煮義大利麵了。）

title: devote A to B
content: 將 A 奉獻在 B 之上。

title: leave for + 地方 = set off for + 地方 = head to / for + 地方 = depart for + 地方
make a living
content: 表示「謀生、賺取生活所需」。例：She makes a living by designing websites.

title: on the / one's way to + 地方
spread A on B = spread B with A
content: 把 A 塗抹在 B 上。

title: introduce A to B
content: 把 A 介紹給 B，向 B 介紹 A

title: to no purpose = in vain = to / of no avail
make / shoot a film = make / shoot a movie
drop off + 人／drop + 人 + off
content: 讓某人下車、順道送到某處；代名詞須放中間：drop her off。例：Dad dropped me off at the library.

title: mourn for sb
content: ：哀悼。mourn sb's death／mourn for sb；近 grieve over/for sth；mournful。

title: consist of...
content: 由……組成；= be made up of...；= be composed of...。

title: half (of) the + 名詞 的動詞單複數
content: of 可省略；接複數可數名詞時採複數形動詞，接單數可數名詞或不可數名詞時採單數形動詞。例：Half of the work is finished.（工作已完成了一半。）

title: by the same token
content: ：代幣；情感表示。as a token of sb's appreciation/gratitude；by the same token＝likewise；近 symbol。

title: get + 人 + 事物 / get + 事物 + for + 人
content: 表示「替某人取得或購買某物」。例：Could you get me a bottle of water?

title: in a low voice / be in a low mood
content: 分別表示「低聲地／情緒低落」。例：He answered in a low voice because the baby was sleeping.

title: attain / achieve one's goal
content: *vt.* 達到、獲得：attain / achieve one's goal；attainment *n.* 獲得、成就。

title: consult 用法
content: consult / refer to the dictionary / phone book 表「查字典／電話簿」；look up the word / number in the dictionary / phone book 表「在字典／電話簿內查單字／號碼」。

title: a salvage operation
content: vt. 搶救；n. 搶救出的財物；片：a salvage operation；似：save

title: at the cost of...
content: 以……的代價。例：Roger transformed the business at the cost of his health.（羅傑犧牲了健康來改變公司。）

title: nail A to B
content: 把 A 釘在 B 上。

title: a big cheese = a big wheel / shot
fall into the trap of + V-ing
content: 上了當去做……；掉入圈套去做……。

title: hunch over ...
content: *n.* 預感、直覺；*vi. & vt.* （使）背部隆起。have a hunch that ...；hunch over ...；hunchback 駝背者。

title: share + N + with + 人
content: 表示「與某人分享……」。例：Nora shared her travel photos with the class.

title: at the climax of ...
content: *n. & vi.* 最精彩處、最高點；達到最高峰。climax in / with ...；at the climax of ...；reach a climax。

title: live 的兩種讀音
content: 動詞 live /lɪv/ 表生活、居住；形容詞 live /laɪv/ 表現場的、活的。例：We live nearby and watched the live broadcast.

title: show 的節目與放映用法
content: 名詞 show 可指節目；動詞 show 可指電影上映。例：That talk show airs after the new film is shown.

title: chew
content: chew the fat = shoot the breeze = chitchat；bite off more than one can chew；a stick / pack of chewing gum。

title: go for a walk / drive
content: 表示「去散步／開車兜風」。例：Dad went for a walk after dinner.

title: though 與 but
content: 延續 p188：Though 作連接詞表「雖然」時，不可再與 but 並用。

title: be / remain as cool as a cucumber
content: 片：be / remain as cool as a cucumber、a sea cucumber

title: link A to / with B = A be linked to / with B
content: 將 A 與 B 有（實體）連結；使 A 與 B 有相關性。

title: a grain of salt / sand / sugar
come from + 地方／背景
content: 表示「來自……」。例：This tradition comes from a small village in Italy.

title: be faced with + N
content: 表示「面臨……」。例：The town is faced with a serious water shortage.

title: hail A as B
content: 片：hail A as B、hail a cab / taxi

title: point at...
content: 指向……。例：The little boy pointed at the toy he wanted.（小男孩指著他想要的玩具。）

title: put up with
content: 忍受。例：I can’t put up with that loud noise anymore.

title: search A for B
content: search A for B：在 A 中找 B。

title: depart
content: depart for + 地點 = set out for + 地點 = leave for + 地點。

title: in the countryside ＝ in the country
a wedding feast
content: *n.* 盛大宴會；*vi.* 舉辦／參加宴會；*vt.* 宴請。a state banquet；近義 feast，a wedding feast。

title: witness 搭配
content: a witness to sth：是某事的證人；bear witness to …：為…作證。

title: make reference to...
content: 提到；言及……；= refer to...；= mention...。

title: be full of ambition
content: 表示「充滿抱負、很有企圖心」。例：The young athlete is full of ambition and trains every day.

title: dispense medicine
content: vt. 分配、配藥；片：dispense A to B、dispense medicine；詞族：dispenser、dispensary

title: fruit 與 fruits
content: 泛指水果時通常不可數；強調不同種類或成果時可用 fruits。例：The project finally produced the fruits of years of research.

title: arm sb with sth
content: 為某人提供某武器裝備。

title: play a(n) + adj. + role / part in...
content: 在……方面扮演……的作用／角色

title: lunar calendar
content: ：月亮的。lunar calendar；反義 solar；相關 eclipse。

title: be skilled at / in + N/V-ing
content: 擅長某事、具有某種技術

title: be invaluable to/for ...
content: *a.* 無價的、極寶貴的：be invaluable to/for ...；反義 worthless。

title: mingle A with B
content: ：混合；融入。mingle with ...、mingle A with B；近 mix。

title: prime 搭配
content: prime time；a prime time show / program；prime minister；prime rib；in one’s prime＝in the prime of life。

title: need to V
content: 需要／必須做……。例：Jackson needs help with his homework.（傑克森的家庭作業需要協助。）

title: sympathy 句型
content: have sympathy for …＝sympathize with …；be sympathetic to / towards …：對…表示同情。

title: an approach to + N/V-ing
content: 處理某事的方法；to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞。例：The school adopted a new approach to teaching science.

title: charge + 人 + for + N
content: 表示「向某人收取某項費用」。例：The hotel charged us extra for breakfast.

title: brink 補充
content: on the verge of... = on the brink / edge of...

title: take place
content: 發生；舉行，主詞通常是事件或活動。例：The science fair will take place next Friday.

title: once + 子句
content: 表示「一旦／一……就……」，引導時間副詞子句；未來語境中的 once 子句通常用現在式。例：Once the rain stops, we will leave.

title: a way to V
content: 做某事的方法。例：Reading aloud is a good way to improve pronunciation.

title: inform sb of sth
content: 通知某人某事。同義：notify sb of sth。

title: be busy with + N / be busy V-ing
content: 分別表示「忙於某事／忙著做……」。例：Dad is busy preparing dinner.

title: be appropriate for
content: be appropriate for …（=be suitable for …）：適合…。

title: come across sb/sth
content: 偶遇某人／偶然發現某物。

title: shame on sb
content: 某人應該感到羞愧；某人真不像話

title: show / express one's solidarity with sb
content: 片：show / express one's solidarity with sb

title: be unique to + 地方
content: 為某地方所獨有。同義說法：be native to + 地方；be indigenous to + 地方。

title: the click of a mouse
content: 點擊滑鼠（比喻某事可透過電腦很快地達成）。

title: let sth slide
content: let sth slide：對於某事鬆懈了，放任某事惡化。

title: food for thought
content: 表示「發人深省、值得仔細思考的事」。例：The documentary gave us plenty of food for thought.

title: a pair of earrings
content: a pair of earrings：一副耳環。

title: be sentenced to + 數字 + years in prison / jail
reach a new low
content: 表示數值「降到新低」，也可指表現或行為「跌至新低點」。例：Temperatures reached a new low last night.

title: carry on + N/V-ing
content: 繼續做……。＝ go on / keep on / continue + N/V-ing。例：If you carry on eating like that, you're going to gain a lot of weight.（如果你照那樣繼續吃下去，會變胖很多。）

title: stand sb up
content: n. 煙氣；vi. 發怒；片：car exhaust fumes、fume about / over...、stand sb up

title: a solution for + 人 + to V
content: 讓某人得以做某事的解決方法。例：Flexible hours may be a solution for parents to balance work and family.

title: take office
content: 就職。例：Mr. Smith took office as mayor of this city yesterday.（史密斯先生昨天就職為本市市長。）

title: sb's contention that...
content: 片：sb's contention that...、be in / out of contention for sth

title: be consumed by
content: be consumed by …：充滿（某種情緒）。

title: outward(s) / inward(s)
content: *a.* 向外／向內的；副詞 outward(s) / inward(s)；互為反義。

title: while 子句簡化為 while + V-ing
content: 副詞子句與主要子句主詞相同且為主動語態時，可刪除副詞子句主詞並將動詞改為 V-ing。例：While walking home, Mia listened to a podcast.

title: nevertheless／nonetheless／however 與 but
content: 前三者均為連接性副詞、之前應置分號；but 為連接詞、之前置逗點即可。

title: and the like = and so on
break down
content: ：（機器）故障；精神崩潰。源自 break down；have a nervous breakdown。

title: household name
content: a household name＝家喻戶曉的人物／名人。

title: view A as B
content: 表示「把 A 視為 B」。例：Many people view mistakes as chances to improve.

title: be classed as...
content: 被歸類為……。例：Kurt is classed as a temporary worker.（柯特被歸類為臨時員工。）

title: put sb in peril = put sb in danger
content: *n./vt.* 危險、使陷入危險：put sb in peril = put sb in danger、at one's peril；perilous 危險的。

title: harness the power of ...
content: ：馬具、挽具、登山安全帶；利用。make use of＝take advantage of；harness the power of ...。

title: mate A with / to B
content: 使 A 和 B 交配。

title: head out
content: 出發、動身外出。例：We headed out before sunrise to avoid the heat.

title: spend + 時間 + V-ing
content: 花費時間做某事。例：Leo spent the afternoon preparing for the presentation.

title: have a tendency to + V
content: 有……的傾向；= tend to + V。

title: even if 與 even though
content: even if 表假設「即使」；even though 表已知事實「雖然」。例：Even if it rains, we’ll go. Even though it rained, we went.

title: produce / breed / procreate
content: *vi. & vt.* 生殖、繁殖；複製、翻印。reproduce oneself；相關 produce / breed / procreate；名詞 reproduction / production，近義 breeding / replica。

title: attach A to B
content: ：使分開。detach A from B；反義 attach A to B。detached：冷漠的；獨立式的（house）；attached。

title: a relation between A and B
content: A 和 B〔事物〕之間的關係

title: an article / item / piece of clothing
content: an article / item of clothing = a piece of clothing：一件衣服。

title: ask sb to V / ask for sth
content: ask sb to V 是請某人做事；ask for 是索取或尋求。例：I asked Ben to wait while I asked for help.

title: be in disagreement about / over... = have a disagreement about / over...
public opinion
content: 民意，公眾輿論。例：Public opinion is in favor of the candidate.（民意支持這位候選人。）

title: have a good knowledge of... = have a good understanding of...
have a sweet tooth = enjoy sweets
in person
content: 表示「親自、本人到場」，不是透過網路或他人。例：You must collect the certificate in person.

title: roll out + 產品／服務
content: 表示「正式推出新產品、服務或方案」。例：The company will roll out its new payment system next month.

title: get on / off a bus；by bus
content: 大型公共交通工具通常用 get on／off；by bus 表示交通方式。例：Get off the bus at the next stop.

title: originate in + 時間／地方
content: *vi.* 源自。originate in + 時間／地方；originate from sth.；名詞 origin；近義 derive。

title: sick / annual leave；take leave
content: leave 作不可數名詞指休假。例：She is on sick leave and will take annual leave next month.

title: in order to V
content: 為了做……。例：Fred leaves home at 7 a.m. in order to get to work on time.（為了能準時上班，佛萊德早上 7 點離開家裡。）

title: be in correspondence with sb
content: ：通信；關聯；be in correspondence with sb；correspondence between A and B；correspond；correspondent。

title: shuffle one’s feet
content: *vi.* 拖著腳走；*vi. & vt.* 坐立不安；洗（牌）。shuffle one’s feet；shuffle the cards。

title: draw / make an analogy between A and B
content: n. 相似、類似；片：draw / make an analogy between A and B

title: (That's) a likely story!
content: 說得倒像是真的一樣／聽起來像真的一樣

title: 關係代名詞 + 插入語 + V
content: 可在 who／which 後插入 I think、I believe 等評論語；真正的主詞動詞關係仍屬於外層關係子句。例：Mia is the student who I believe can lead the team.

title: urge sb to + V
content: 激勵某人做……；= call on sb to + V。

title: come to a close
content: 表示「結束、告一段落」。例：The summer festival came to a close at midnight.

title: an honorary degree / chair / doctorate
content: *a.* （學位）名譽上的。an honorary degree / chair / doctorate；相關 honor / honorable。

title: go wild
content: go wild：變得興奮異常不受控制；暴跳如雷。

title: be one of the all-time greats
content: 有史以來最偉大的人之一。

title: in solitude
content: a. 獨居的；似：lonely；反：sociable；詞族：solitude；片：in solitude

title: pass the time
content: *n.* 消遣、娛樂；近義 hobby；pass the time。

title: It is alleged that ...
content: ：（無證據地）宣稱。allege that ...／It is alleged that ...；alleged、allegedly、allegation；近 accusation。

title: champion / successful / triumphant
content: ：勝利者／勝利／得勝的；近義 champion / successful / triumphant。

title: fail 用法
content: fail 表「辜負」時，以人作受詞。

title: and so forth = and so on = and the like = etc
compare A to B
content: 把 A 比喻為 B。

title: be born in + 年份／國家
break out
content: ：爆發。源自 break out（疾病／戰爭爆發）。

title: fume about / over...
content: n. 煙氣；vi. 發怒；片：car exhaust fumes、fume about / over...、stand sb up

title: hear + 受詞 + V/V-ing
content: 聽到……做……。例：I heard someone knocking on the door.（我聽到有人在敲門。）

title: go back to the drawing board
content: go back to the drawing board：（失敗後）從頭開始。

title: hand + 人 + 事物 / hand + 事物 + to + 人
content: 表示「把某物遞給某人」。例：Please hand the receipt to the customer.

title: percent 用法
content: percent 須與數字並用；percent 後接 of，若 of 後為複數名詞，動詞用複數；若為不可數名詞，動詞用單數。

title: man 表「人類」
content: 作總稱時僅用單數，且不加冠詞。

title: guarantee
content: be under guarantee；come with / without a guarantee。

title: value one's friendship with + 人
content: 表示「珍惜與某人的友誼」。例：I truly value my friendship with Emma.

title: in an attempt to V = in order to V
a piece / two pieces / a lot of merchandise
content: 用法：a piece / two pieces / a lot of merchandise

title: a guide dog = a seeing-eye dog
in short
content: 表示「簡言之、總之」。例：In short, the plan costs too much and takes too long.

title: a rocky road
content: 困難重重的路程；艱辛的路程。

title: prefer A over B
content: 表示「比起 B 更喜歡 A」。例：My brother prefers trains over buses for long trips.

title: hold sb in high regard
content: hold sb in high regard＝hold sb in high esteem：尊敬某人。

title: regard A as B ＝ look on / upon A as B ＝ think of A as B ＝ see / view A as B ＝ consider A (to be) B
select A for B
content: 挑選 A 給 B；為 B 挑選 A。

title: throw sth away / throw away sth
wrinkle (up) one's nose
content: n. 皺紋；vi. & vt. 起皺；詞族：wrinkled；片：wrinkle (up) one's nose

title: learn one's lesson
content: 學到教訓。例：Tom learned his lesson and will never lie again.（湯姆學到教訓，再也不會說謊了。）

title: boast
content: boast of / about ... = brag of / about ...；an empty boast；It is sb's proud boast that ...。

title: let alone...
content: let alone...：更別提說……，更不用說……（用於否定句之後）。

title: learn from / about...
content: 從……中學習／學習有關……。例：You should learn from your mistakes.（你應從錯誤中學習。）

title: be geared to + V
content: 被設計適合……；= be designed to + V。

title: 中文「最近」指未來時不可用 lately
content: 中文的「最近」也可指「未來這段期間」，此時應使用 in the near future（最近，在最近的未來），與未來式或未來進行式並用。

title: have a flat tire
content: have a flat tire：（車子）爆胎。

title: to be blunt / frankly speaking
content: *a.* 鈍的；不利的；直言不諱的；*vt.* 使變鈍、減弱。to be blunt / frankly speaking；反義 sharp。

title: be on the stage ＝ go on the stage
be as happy as a clam
content: n. 蛤蜊；片：be as happy as a clam

title: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
read sb sth
content: 唸某物給某人聽（＝ read sth to sb）。例：Ben read the whole class his story.（班唸他的故事給全班聽。）

title: a mere + 數字
content: 僅僅若干……；= merely + 數字；= only + 數字。

title: be in good / high spirits ＝ be in a good mood
make + 受詞 + 原形動詞
content: 使役結構，表示「使／迫使某人或某物做……」。例：The funny video made everyone laugh.

title: as a matter of fact
content: 事實上。＝ in fact。例：Belle isn't my girlfriend. As a matter of fact, she is my wife.（貝兒不是我女朋友。事實上，她是我老婆。）

title: mediate (sth) between A and B
content: ：居中調解。mediate (sth) between A and B；mediator；近 negotiate。

title: take + 人／事物 + seriously
content: 表示「認真看待……」。例：The manager takes every customer complaint seriously.

title: as：像（＝ like）
content: 作連接詞表比擬，語氣近似 like，與既有「當……時」「因為……」兩筆 note 是同一 as 的不同義項。例：The house looks exactly as it did when I was a child.（這棟房子看起來就像我小時候所看到的那樣。）

title: sb's nature
content: 某人的本／天性。例：It is just part of John's nature to be friendly with people.（待人親切正是約翰的天性之一。）

title: go through the ordeal of ...
content: ：嚴酷考驗、煎熬。go through the ordeal of ...；近 torment。

title: personal belongings
content: 隨身私人用品〔恆用複數〕

title: line up
content: 排隊。例：All of the students are lining up to receive their awards.（所有的學生正排隊等著領獎。）

title: forget to V
content: 忘了要做……。例：My mother forgot to wake me up this morning.（我媽媽今早忘記叫我起床。）

title: leave for + 地方
content: 動身前往某地。例：Our train leaves for Tainan at noon.

title: blow / wipe / pick one's nose
content: 分別表示「擤鼻涕／擦鼻子／挖鼻孔」。例：Please use a tissue to blow your nose.

title: It is sb's duty to V
hold / give a press conference
content: 開記者會；= hold / give a news conference。

title: on New Year's Eve / on Christmas Eve
content: 在新年前夕（除夕）／在平安夜那天。

title: loud and clear
content: 清楚明白地。例：I can hear your voice loud and clear.（我可以清楚地聽到你的聲音。）

title: usher sb in / into / to...
content: 片：usher sb in / into / to...、usher in...

title: communism / capitalism
content: *n.* 社會主義；social 社會的、社交的；communism / capitalism 共產主義／資本主義；socialist 社會主義者／社會主義的；sociologist 社會學家。

title: mercy
content: have mercy on sb = have pity on sb；be at the mercy of ...；mercy killing = euthanasia。

title: less 作形容詞／比較副詞的用法
content: less 作形容詞修飾不可數名詞；作比較副詞時句型為 less + adj./adv. + than + 比較對象。

title: dwell on ...
content: *vi.* 居住；dwell–dwelt/dwelled–dwelt/dwelled：dwell in ... = reside in ...、dwell on ...；dwelling 住所。

title: take a step
content: take a step：採取措施／行動。

title: suffer from...
content: 飽受（疾病）之苦，罹患（疾病）。

title: yellow 作動詞
content: 表示「變黃」或「使……變黃」。例：Years of sunlight had yellowed the old newspaper.

title: lay out
content: *n.* 裝潢擺設；刊物版面編排；lay out 計畫、設計。

title: hand down sth / hand sth down
boss + 人 + around
content: 表示「對某人頤指氣使、使喚來使喚去」。例：Stop bossing your teammates around.

title: protein
content: be rich / high in protein；be low in protein。

title: have no backbone to V
content: n. 脊椎；支柱；勇氣；片：be the backbone of...、have no backbone to V

title: get 表「理解」
content: 作此義時，時態上不可使用現在進行式。

title: find sb/sth + adj.
content: 認為或發現某人／某物具有某種狀態。例：I found the instructions confusing at first.

title: be under/in the spotlight
content: ：聚光燈；受到注意、使突出；be under/in the spotlight；highlight。

title: once upon a time
content: （故事開頭）很久以前。例：Once upon a time, here lived a beautiful elf.（很久以前，這裡住著一個漂亮的小精靈。）

title: floor vs. story（樓層辨析）
content: 表「在第幾樓」用 floor，表「共幾層樓高」用 story。誤：That's a five-floor building. 正：That's a five-story building.（那是一棟 5 層樓高的建築。）

title: be born with a silver spoon in one's mouth
content: 某人含著金湯匙出生；某人富裕家庭出身。

title: have no option
content: have no option / choice / alternative but to V：除了…之外別無選擇。

title: lift a prohibition
content: ：禁令。lift a prohibition；a prohibition on/against sth＝a ban on sth；動詞 prohibit。

title: have problems / difficulty + V-ing = have a hard time + V-ing
a platform for + 人 + to V
content: 表示「供某人做某事的平台」。例：The website provides a platform for artists to share their work.

title: typhoon / hurricane / cyclone
content: 以上三字皆指「颱風」，只是在不同地區有不同名稱。

title: be grounded in / on...
content: 以……為根據。＝ be based on...。例：Your report should not be grounded in imagination.（你的報告不該以想像為根據。）

title: change A into B
content: 把 A 變成 B = transform A into B = turn A into B。

title: tell sb (that) / tell sb about
content: tell sb (that) 後接告知內容；tell sb about 後接主題。例：Please tell me that you’re safe, and tell me about the trip later.

title: pound A on / against B
content: 用 A 猛擊 B；用 A 連續重擊 B。

title: cram A into B
content: ：硬塞；填鴨、惡補；死記硬背。cram A into B、cram for a test/exam、a cram school。

title: no smoke without fire
content: 無火不生煙／無風不起浪。

title: revolve around
content: vi. 旋轉、公轉；片：revolve around；詞族：revolution；似／相關：rotate、rotation

title: loan 句型
content: be on loan：已借出；loan sb sth＝lend sb sth；loan sth to sb＝lend sth to sb。

title: be one in a million
content: 獨一無二／萬中選一的好人。

title: a slice / piece of papaya
content: a slice / piece of papaya：一片木瓜。

title: have good / poor eyesight
content: *n.* 視力（不可數）。have good / poor eyesight；相關 hearing 聽力。

title: jump / skip rope
content: 跳繩（rope 之前不加 the）。

title: like a bull in a china shop
content: 是個莽撞的人，是個笨手笨腳的人。

title: be distinguished for...
content: 因……而出名；= be renowned / famous for...。

title: cater for / to
content: vi. 辦理宴席；迎合需求；片：cater for / to；衍：caterer

title: take A under B's wing
content: B 對 A 呵護有加。

title: fall in love with + 人／事物
content: 表示「愛上……」。例：Leo fell in love with the quiet mountain town.

title: determine + N／wh-子句
content: 確定、查明某事；可接名詞或疑問詞子句。例：The test will determine whether the machine is safe.

title: take in + 風景／景象
content: 觀看並欣賞眼前的景色或事物。例：We stopped at the top of the hill to take in the view.

title: as a matter of fact / in fact
content: 事實上，用來補充或修正資訊。例：I thought he was new; in fact, he has worked here for years.

title: bring sb up
content: 養育某人；常用被動 be brought up。例：She was brought up by her grandparents.

title: in one's capacity as + 職位
shock sb that... = shock sb to V
be short of / on + N
content: 表示「缺少……；……不足」。例：We are short of chairs for tonight's meeting.

title: give sb a hearty welcome
content: 片：give sb a hearty welcome、a hearty breakfast

title: in a low / loud voice
content: 小／大聲地。例：Alex is so shy that he only talks in a low voice.（艾力克斯太害羞了，只敢小聲地說話。）

title: laundry/dish detergent
content: ：洗滌劑。laundry/dish detergent＝dishwashing liquid；a bar/cake of soap；stain。

title: It makes no difference to sb
remove A from B
content: 將 A 從 B 中除去

title: take sb/sth to + 地方
content: 帶某人或某物去某地。例：Could you take this package to the front desk?

title: give + 人 + a hand with + N
content: 表示「幫助某人做……」。例：Could you give me a hand with these boxes?

title: the definitive collection
content: a definitive answer 明確的答覆；the definitive collection 最具權威的作品集

title: for real
content: 真正的；真實的。例：I've just won the lottery! For real!（我剛中樂透了！是真的！）

title: grace
content: with good grace；have the grace to + V；grace sb with your presence。

title: in sb's mind
content: 在某人腦海／心中。例：Eddie is the coolest guy in my mind.（艾迪是我心中最酷的男人。）

title: in the wild
content: in the wild：在自然／野生環境中。

title: come up with + 想法／方案
content: 表示「想出、提出……」。例：The students came up with a clever solution.

title: basic / daily needs
content: 基本需求／日需品。例：Housing and food are basic needs.（吃住是基本需求。）

title: get 表示「理解」
content: 口語中 get 可表示「聽懂、理解」；這個意思通常不用進行式。例：I understand the words, but I don't get the joke.

title: fashion A out of B
content: 用 B 製造出 A

title: tip sb off / tip off sb
content: 向某人通風報信。例：The informant tipped off the police about the robbery.（線民向警方密報這樁搶案。）

title: a difference between A and B
content: A 和 B 間的差別

title: cultivate a relationship with ...
content: ：培養；建立（關係、友誼）；耕種。cultivate a relationship with ...；cultivated；近 nourish。

title: cell phone
content: 片：cellular phone = cell phone = mobile phone

title: aspire to V
content: 片：aspire to V、aspire to sth、aspire after sth

title: the newlyweds
content: 新婚夫婦（恆用複數，帶定冠詞）。

title: be important to + 人
content: 表示某人主觀上「重視……」。例：Spending time with family is important to me.

title: on hand
content: 在手邊、現成可用。例：Keep some medicine on hand during the trip.

title: fruit 的可數性
content: 指所有水果時視為集合名詞、不可數；指特定一種或數種水果時視為可數名詞。

title: go to bed / in bed / on the bed
content: go to bed 表示「去睡覺」；in bed 表示人在床上休息；on the bed 表示物品或人在床的表面。例：The jacket is on the bed, but Mia is already in bed.

title: fool around
content: 鬼混；無所事事 = idle around。

title: oppose + N/V-ing
content: 反對……；= be opposed to + N/V-ing；= object to + N/V-ing。

title: shy、introvert / introverted
content: a. 外向的；似：extrovert / extroverted；反：shy、introvert / introverted

title: wants and needs / for want of + N
content: wants and needs 表示「各種需求」；for want of 表示「因缺少……」。例：The project failed for want of enough funding.

title: merit 搭配
content: the merits and demerits of sth；on merit：依績效。

title: Every cloud has a silver lining.
content: n. 內襯；片：Every cloud has a silver lining.

title: proposal 搭配
content: approve / reject a proposal：贊成／反對某項提議。

title: be aware of + N / V-ing
content: 表示「知道、留意……」。例：Drivers should be aware of children crossing the road.

title: stretch one's legs
content: （站起來走動以）活動一下筋骨

title: make use of
content: ：馬具、挽具、登山安全帶；利用。make use of＝take advantage of；harness the power of ...。

title: in the cold
content: 字面表示「處於寒冷環境中」；也能比喻「被排除在外、不知情」。例：The decision was made without us, leaving our team in the cold.

title: at the end of
content: 在……末尾／結束時。例：There is a short quiz at the end of each unit.

title: kid + 人 / be kidding
content: 作動詞表示「開某人的玩笑」；I'm kidding 表示「我在開玩笑」。例：Relax—I was only kidding.

title: sorry 的三種句型
content: be/feel sorry about + 事；be sorry that + 子句；be sorry to hear/see + 內容。例：I’m sorry to hear that your trip was canceled.

title: most 的冠詞規則
content: most 表「大多數」時通常不加 the；最高級 most 修飾名詞時要加 the。例：Most students chose the most practical plan.

title: a good / bad judge of sth
content: 很會／很不會判斷某事物。

title: respond to sth
content: 回答／應某事；對某事做出反應。

title: make it to + 地方／活動
content: 表示「成功抵達或趕上……」。例：We made it to the station just before the train left.

title: see a doctor/client
content: 看醫生／拜訪客戶。例：Henry saw the doctor this morning.（亨利今早去看醫生。）

title: 數量詞 + of + whom
content: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞為人時可用 some／many／most／all／none + of whom；不可改用 that。例：The club has twenty members, most of whom are students.

title: prepare for...
content: 為……做準備。例：Every student is preparing for the test.（每個學生都在準備考試。）

title: ship + 物品 + to + 地方
content: 此處 ship 作動詞，表示「運送、寄送」。例：The company ships its products to customers overseas.

title: spirits 搭配
content: be in high / low spirits＝be in a good / bad mood：精神／情緒很好／很差（spirits 恆用複數）。

title: be capable of + N/V-ing
content: 有能力……的；可以……的。同義：be able to + V。

title: the final nail in the coffin of sb/sth = the final nail in sb’s/sth’s coffin
content: 某人／事最後致命的一擊。

title: all the best
content: （用於告別或信末祝福語）祝一切順利。

title: do sb an injustice
content: ：不公平。do sb an injustice；反義 justice；近 unfairness。

title: remember + V-ing
content: 記得曾做……。例：I remember visiting this place before.（我記得曾到過這個地方。）

title: give rise to...
content: 引起／導致……（＝ result in... ＝ contribute to... ＝ bring about...）。例：The mayor's speech gave rise to a heated discussion.（市長的演說引發熱烈的討論。）

title: make an accusation
content: 片：make an accusation、an accusation against sb

title: hold on
content: 稍等；也可指抓牢。例：Hold on a moment while I check the schedule.

title: It is natural (for sb) to V
of one’s own 與 on one’s own
content: of one’s own 是某人自己的；on one’s own 是獨自或靠自己。例：She wants a room of her own and can clean it on her own.

title: cost sb dear
content: 花某人很多錢；使某人付出代價。

title: once again
content: 再次、再度，常用於重新陳述或重複發生。例：Once again, the team checked every answer before submitting the form.

title: billions of + 複數可數名詞
panel 搭配
content: an instrument panel：儀表板（正式說法）；a solar panel：太陽能發電板。

title: fiction countability
content: novel 可數；fiction 為小說類總稱、集合名詞，不可數；書上標示 a fiction 不可。

title: have time / take one’s time
content: have time 是有時間；take one’s time 是慢慢來、不必急。例：Take your time; we still have an hour.

title: for a rainy day
content: 以備不時之需；未雨綢繆。

title: grab / have a bite to eat
數字-year-old + 名詞
content: 作複合形容詞時 year 使用單數並加連字號。例：They have a six-year-old daughter.

title: pick up + 人／pick + 人 + up
content: 接某人、讓某人上車；若受詞是代名詞，必須放中間：pick him up。例：I will pick my sister up after school.

title: to some degree = to a (certain) degree
subscribe to sth
content: ：訂閱。subscribe to sth；subscription；take out/cancel/renew a subscription。

title: be in a position to V / be in no position to V
wonder + 疑問詞引導的名詞子句
content: 疑問詞包括 when、what、how、where 等；想知道……。

title: central / local government
content: 中央／地方政府〔皆不可數〕

title: first / business / economy class
content: 頭等／商務／經濟艙。例：My boss prefers to fly in first class.（我老闆偏好搭頭等艙。）

title: species
content: 單複數同形；a species of ...；two / three / four species of ...。

title: make a scene
content: 大吵大鬧以致丟人現眼

title: have good / bad / similar taste in...
take dictation
content: ：口述；指定、規定。dictate a letter/memo to sb；dictate to sb；dictation、take dictation、at sb's dictation。

title: preside over a meeting ＝ chair a meeting
cram for a test/exam
content: ：硬塞；填鴨、惡補；死記硬背。cram A into B、cram for a test/exam、a cram school。

title: a good deal
content: 一筆划算的交易；便宜又值得購買的東西。例：This second-hand desk was a really good deal.

title: admission
content: apply for admission to + 學校。

title: A is similar to B
content: A 與 B 類似（但並非完全相同）。

title: a hamburger bun
content: a hamburger bun：做漢堡用的麵包。

title: spill the beans
content: 表示「洩漏祕密、說溜嘴」。例：Don't spill the beans about the surprise party.

title: a happy / sad / poker face
content: 開心的臉／難過的臉／撲克臉。

title: economically/technically feasible
content: ：可行的。a feasible plan；economically/technically feasible；It is feasible (for sb) to V；反義 implausible。

title: war 與 battle 的辨析
content: war 指全面的「戰爭」，battle 指在戰爭中一場一場的「戰役」。

title: grind
content: grind to a halt / stop = come to a halt / stop；grind one's teeth。

title: interact with + 人／事物
content: 表示「與……互動」。例：The children interacted with the robots during the exhibition.

title: lay an egg
content: 表示鳥類等「下蛋」。例：The hen usually lays an egg in the morning.

title: connect A to B
content: 表示「將 A 與 B 連接或聯想在一起」。例：The bridge connects the village to the main road.

title: be of great value ＝ be valuable
shoulder / bear / carry the burden of + V-ing
sth cost sb + 金額
content: 某物花某人若干金額。例：That car cost me a fortune.（買那輛車花了我不少錢。）

title: have a baby / be expecting a baby
content: 分別表示「生小孩／懷孕、即將有小孩」。例：The couple is expecting a baby this winter.

title: pin A to B
content: 將 A 別在 B 上

title: an automated teller machine
content: 詞族／相關：cash、teller、an automated teller machine、a cash register

title: have a physical examination
content: 做體檢；= have a physical checkup。

title: a report on/of sth
content: 有關某事物的報導／報告。例：Zoey did a report on butterflies.（柔伊做了一篇有關蝴蝶的報導。）

title: be open to + N
content: 表示「對……開放」，也可表示「願意接受……」。例：Our teacher is open to new ideas from the class.

title: sb's native land
content: 某人的母國。例：He returned to his native land after a few years.（幾年後，他回到了自己的母國。）

title: Strike while the iron is hot.
begin to V / begin V-ing
content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：She began to laugh. = She began laughing.

title: in consequence of...
content: 因為……；= as a consequence/result of...；= because/on account of...。

title: infection / infect
content: *a.* 傳染的。相關 infection / infect；近義 contagious / epidemic。

title: be stuck in a traffic jam
content: be stuck in a traffic jam：遇到塞車。

title: stance、with regard to、subtitles
content: a. 沉默的；vt. 消音；似：silent；note：stance、with regard to、subtitles

title: A is a complement to B
content: ：補足物；補足。A is a complement to B；complementary；易混同音 compliment（讚美）。

title: the youth / the youth of today
by virtue of
content: by virtue / means / way of …：憑著／藉由…。

title: cover up sth / cover sth up
content: 掩蓋某事物。例：The police tried to cover up the truth.（警方企圖掩飾真相。）

title: break the law / rule
content: 違法／規。例：Christina would never break the school rules.（克莉絲蒂娜絕不會違反校規。）

title: avert one's eyes / gaze
content: 片 avert one's eyes / gaze 轉移某人的目光

title: be generous to sb
content: be generous to sb：對某人很慷慨。

title: come close to + N / V-ing
content: 表示「差一點……；幾乎達成……」。例：The team came close to winning the final game.

title: by the sea 與 by sea
content: by the sea 表示「在海邊」；by sea 表示「經由海路」。例：They live by the sea but usually travel by air.

title: get along with sb
content: 與某人相處。例：It's hard to get along with selfish people.（和自私的人相處是一件很難的事。）

title: recover from... = get over... = recuperate from...
grow + adj.
content: 變得……。例：As time went by, Clara grew older and wiser.（隨著歲月流逝，克萊拉變老也更有智慧。）

title: in abundance
content: ：充滿。abound in/with ...；abundance、abundant；in abundance＝in profusion/in large quantities。

title: be ornamented / decorated with
content: n. 裝飾品；vt. 裝飾；片：be ornamented / decorated with；詞族：decorate、decoration

title: be in revolt against
content: vi. / n. 造反、反感；片：revolt against、be in revolt against；詞族：revolution、rebel

title: take a break / rest
content: 休息一下。例：Let's take a break for ten minutes before we go back to work again.（我們休息 10 分鐘再繼續工作。）

title: lead to...
content: 導致……。＝ result in...／contribute to...／give rise to...／bring about...。例：The driver's carelessness led to the accident.（駕駛員的粗心導致這起意外。）

title: have a short fuse
content: *n.* 保險絲、引線、導火線；*vt. & vi.* 融合、熔合。have a short fuse 易怒；近義 blend。

title: be + 形容詞 + enough to V
content: 表示「足夠……而能做……」。例：Nina is tall enough to reach the top shelf.

title: cost sb sth
content: 使某人失去某物。例：The reporter's racist comments cost him his job.（這位記者種族歧視的言論讓他丟了工作。）

title: a badge of honor
content: n. 徽章；片：a badge of honor

title: as + adj./adv. + as possible
content: 儘可能地……。例：Come here as soon as possible.（儘快過來。）

title: stop by / stop in
content: 表示「順道短暫拜訪」。例：I'll stop by the bakery on my way home.

title: a disciplinary committee
content: a. 紀律的；片：a disciplinary committee、disciplinary action；詞族：discipline

title: pause + N / pause to V
content: 可以表示「暫停某事」，也可表示「停下來去做另一件事」。例：Leo paused the video to answer the door.

title: be close to + 地方／人
content: 表示「距離近」或「與某人親近」。例：Our apartment is close to the train station.

title: look back to + 特定時間／事件
content: 表示「回想某個明確時間點或事件」。例：He looked back to the day he first visited the island.

title: a stray dog / cat
content: *vi.* 偏離原路、走失、入歧途；*a.* 走失的、散落的。a stray dog / cat；stray from / off the path。

title: turn A into B = change A into B
be short for + 完整名稱
content: 表示「是……的縮寫或簡稱」。例：“Lab” is short for “laboratory.”

title: be able to V
content: 有能力做……。＝ be capable of + V-ing。例：I'm sure David is able to do it by himself.（我確定大衛有能力獨自做這件事。）

title: lure sb into N / V-ing
content: vt. 引誘；n. 誘惑；片：lure sb into N / V-ing

title: happen to V
content: 碰巧……。例：I happen to have $100 with me.（我碰巧身上有 100 元。）

title: be driven by + N
content: 受……驅使、推動或影響。例：Her decision was driven by a desire to help others.

title: each 用法
content: each 作形容詞時置單數可數名詞前，後接動詞用單數；each 作代詞與 of 並用時連接複數名詞，後接動詞亦用單數。

title: A result in B ＝ A cause B
indifference to sth
content: n. 冷漠；片：indifference to sth；似：apathy；反：concern

title: get in / out of a car；by car
content: 小型車輛通常用 get in／out of；by car 表示交通方式。例：We got out of the car and continued on foot.

title: pattern oneself after sb
content: 仿效某人，以某人為榜樣

title: happy / merry
content: *a. & n.* 快樂的；男同性戀的／男同性戀。歡樂義現多用 happy / merry；come out of the closet 出櫃。

title: by now
content: 表示「到目前為止、事到如今」，常搭配完成式或 should。例：The package should have arrived by now.

title: blame A for B = blame B on A
content: 把 B 怪罪在 A 身上。

title: be in the habit of + V-ing
bachelor's degree
content: n. 單身男子；學士；片：bachelor's degree；相關：spinster

title: in spite of...
content: 儘管……（之後須接名詞或動名詞作受詞）。同義說法：despite...；notwithstanding *prep.* 儘管。

title: give sb a tip on sth
content: 告訴某人做某事的祕訣／訣竅。例：Thank you for giving me some tips on how to ski.（謝謝你告訴我一些滑雪的祕訣。）

title: as soon as...
content: 一……就……。例：The boy cried as soon as he saw the stranger.（小男孩一看到那個陌生人就哭了。）

title: the rest of...
content: 其餘的……（動詞單複數視其後所接名詞而定）。例：The rest of the money is to be given to Hanks.（其餘的錢要給漢克斯。）

title: have the right to V/N
content: 有……的權利。例：In certain countries, women don't have the right to vote.（在某些國家，女性沒有投票權。）

title: make room for sth
content: 為某物騰出空間。例：Can we make room for one more table?（我們可以騰出空間再放一張桌子嗎？）

title: be full of...
content: 充滿……。＝ be filled with...。例：My heart was full of warmth when he offered to help.（當他主動提議幫忙時，我的心中充滿著溫馨的感覺。）

title: while 表時間與對比
content: while 可表示「當……時」或「然而」，需靠兩子句關係判斷。例：While I prefer tea, my brother drinks coffee.

title: a news / main / cover story
content: 分別表示「新聞報導／主要報導／封面故事」。例：The discovery became the newspaper's main story.

title: try + V-ing
content: 嘗試……。例：I tried shutting the computer, but it didn't work.（我試過將電腦關機，但沒有效。）

title: regular 與 regularly
content: regular 是形容詞，修飾名詞；regularly 是副詞，修飾動詞。例：Regular exercise helps people sleep better, so Mia exercises regularly.

title: subject A to B
content: 使 A 受制於 B。

title: a collection of... / a large collection of...
for a while / once in a while
content: for a while 是一段時間；once in a while 是偶爾。例：Sit here for a while; I visit this park once in a while.

title: minor in... = choose... as one's minor
inspire
content: inspire sb to + V；draw inspiration from ...；a source of inspiration。

title: focus (one's attention) on... = concentrate (one's attention) on...
not utter a word
content: *a.* 完全的；*vt.* 說、發出。not utter a word；utter a sigh；副詞 utterly；近義 complete / completely / entirely / totally。

title: for one thing…, for another…
content: 用來依序提出兩個理由：一方面……，另一方面……。例：I chose the train; for one thing, it is safer, and for another, it is cheaper.

title: take place
content: 發生、舉行；通常不用被動語態。例：The school festival will take place next Friday.

title: file / bring a suit against sb
content: file / bring a suit against sb：對某人提出訴訟。

title: have problems / difficulty V-ing
content: 做某事有困難，也可說 have a hard time V-ing。例：He has difficulty remembering names.

title: be interested in + N / V-ing
content: 表示「對……有興趣」，介系詞 in 後接名詞或動名詞。例：Lily is interested in learning about local history.

title: on average
content: 平均而言，通常放在句首或句尾。例：On average, the students read three books a month.

title: feel comfortable with sb
content: 與某人在一起感到自在。

title: 數字 + hundred
content: 表「幾百」時，前面無論數字多少，hundred 一律不加 s，如 one / two / three / four hundred。

title: excuse me
content: 打擾一下；對不起；不好意思；借過。

title: aspire after sth
content: 片：aspire to V、aspire to sth、aspire after sth

title: lend / give sb a helping hand
hand sb sth = hand sth to sb
all alone / not … at all
content: all alone 是獨自一人；not…at all 是一點也不。例：She wasn’t nervous at all, even though she performed all alone.

title: provide against sth
content: 防備、預防某事物；為（防備）某事物做準備

title: practice + N / V-ing
content: 表示「練習或實行……」；接動作時使用 V-ing。例：We practiced speaking English before the presentation.

title: vanilla extract
content: n. 香草；片：vanilla ice cream、vanilla extract

title: find out
content: 查明、弄清楚資訊。例：We need to find out when the last train leaves.

title: aspire to sth
content: 片：aspire to V、aspire to sth、aspire after sth

title: run into + 人
content: 表示「偶然遇見某人」。例：I ran into my former teacher at the night market.

title: a drop in the ocean
content: a drop in the ocean = a drop in the bucket：滄海一粟（英／美）。

title: on sb's / the right side
content: 在右邊。例：The Opera House is on your right side.（歌劇院在你的右邊。）

title: on the spur of the moment
content: 片：on the spur of the moment、spur sb on to V

title: evidence 的可數用法
content: an evidence（×）；a piece of evidence（○）：一項證據。

title: invite sb to + 活動／地點
relieve sb of ...
content: ：剝奪。deprive sb of sth＝rob sb of sth；relieve sb of ...。

title: inclusive of = including = ... included
content: *a.* 包含的：inclusive of = including = ... included；exclusive 不包括的、新聞獨家的、商品專用的。

title: take off / put on a hat
a mischievous smile / grin / look
content: *a.* 惡作劇的、頑皮的。a mischievous smile / grin / look；名詞 mischief；近義 naughty。

title: There is no question about / of...
be in (the) first / second / third grade
commit 搭配
content: commit a crime；commit robbery；commit A to B＝devote A to B＝dedicate A to B；commit oneself to + N/V-ing。

title: horizon 搭配
content: broaden one’s horizons：擴充某人領域（本片語中 horizons 恆為複數）；be on the horizon：即將出現／即將到來（本片語中 horizon 恆為單數）。

title: be of (great) use
content: 很有用，語意相當於 be (very) useful。例：The checklist was of great use during the trip.

title: split
content: split sth in two / in half；split up with sb = break up with sb；a banana split。

title: play a vital role in...
content: 在……方面扮演極重要的角色。

title: ask / answer a question
content: 提出／回答問題。例：Students may ask questions after the talk.

title: rob sb of sth
content: ：剝奪。deprive sb of sth＝rob sb of sth；relieve sb of ...。

title: interfere
content: interfere in ... = meddle / intervene in ...；interfere with ... = hamper ...。

title: a beauty shop = a beauty parlor
thank sb for N / V-ing
content: 因某事感謝某人。例：I thanked Leo for helping me carry the boxes.

title: isolation 搭配
content: live in isolation＝lead a secluded life：過著與世隔絕的生活。

title: get along with + 人
content: 表示「與某人相處融洽」。例：Tina gets along well with her new classmates.

title: show up
content: 出現、到場。例：Only eight players showed up for practice.

title: be filled with...
content: 充滿……（＝ be full of...）。例：My heart was filled with joy when I saw my old friend again.（再次見到老友時，我的內心充滿喜悅。）

title: carry a risk／a risk of V-ing
content: 帶有風險；有做某事的風險。例：Driving while tired carries a serious risk.

title: deny sb sth ＝ deny sth to sb
rack one's brains = beat one's brains
competition 搭配
content: be in competition with …／compete with …：與…競爭。

title: unless + 子句 = if ... not
content: 除非；書列與 if 否定子句互換。

title: a densely/sparsely populated city
content: ：居住於（常用被動）。a densely/sparsely populated city；population、populous。

title: spark sb’s imagination
content: spark sb’s imagination：激發某人的想像力。

title: originate from sth.
content: *vi.* 源自。originate in + 時間／地方；originate from sth.；名詞 origin；近義 derive。

title: place a high value on sth
call sb (up) / call (up) sb = give sb a call
give A's regards to B ＝ remember A to B
content: 代 A 向 B 問好

title: a locker room
content: n. 置物櫃；片：a locker room

title: a sense of hearing / smell / taste
again and again
content: 一再、反覆地。例：Leo practiced the difficult line again and again until it sounded natural.

title: prepare breakfast/lunch/dinner
content: 準備早／午／晚餐。例：Mother is preparing breakfast.（媽媽正在準備早餐。）

title: the fruit(s) of + N
content: 比喻「……的成果、結果」。例：This exhibition is the fruit of months of preparation.

title: give in to
content: 向壓力、誘惑或某人屈服。例：Don’t give in to fear before the contest begins.

title: tend to + V
content: 容易……，往往會……。同義：be apt／inclined／prone to + V。

title: a pack of wolves / wild dogs
lose one's head
content: 表示「慌張、失去冷靜」。例：Ben lost his head when the alarm suddenly rang.

title: to no purpose
content: 片 in vain 白費功夫 ＝ to no avail ＝ to no purpose

title: liver / heart transplant
content: vt. / n. 移植；片：transplant A to B、liver / heart transplant；衍：transplantation

title: buy + 人 + 事物 / buy + 事物 + for + 人
content: 兩種結構都表示「買某物給某人」。例：Mia bought her brother a new backpack.

title: give to charity
content: 捐款或捐物給慈善機構。例：We gave our unused coats to charity.

title: make an attempt to V = attempt to V
contrast A with B
content: 將 A 與 B 對比。

title: in public
content: 公開地，當眾。例：The basketball star hasn't been seen in public for years.（這名籃球明星好幾年沒公開出現了。）

title: be (just) around the corner
content: 快要到了 = be coming soon。

title: favor A over B
content: 贊同 A 而不贊同 B，喜歡 A 勝於 B

title: watch / mind one's step
content: watch / mind one's step：小心某人的腳步。

title: be out of a job
content: 失業。例：If you make another mistake, you're out of a job.（如果你再犯錯，就會沒有工作了。）

title: play the + 樂器名稱
content: 彈奏某樂器。例：My sister plays the guitar very well.（我姊姊很會彈吉他。）

title: work out sth / work sth out
content: 想出、解決某事。例：Let’s work out a fair schedule together.

title: be unclear about...
content: 對……不清楚。（unclear 本身查無 word_id，此片語以 clear 詞條掛載。）

title: end in a draw
content: 以平局告終。例：The soccer match ended in a draw.（這場足球賽打成平手。）

title: 地方 + be peopled by / with...
content: ……居住於某地。例：The town is peopled by students from the nearby university.（附近大學的學生居住在這個城鎮。）

title: without a backward glance
content: 頭也不回地（表示很高興離開某地）。

title: can：助動詞與一般動詞／名詞
content: 助動詞 can 表能力或許可，後接原形動詞；一般動詞可指把食物裝罐，名詞指罐頭／罐子。例：She can swim, and she cans tomatoes every summer.

title: accident vs incident
content: accident 指突發的意外事件；incident 較廣泛，可指突發意外或有人蓄意造成的事件。

title: in rotation
content: ：旋轉；輪流。rotation of the Earth、job/crop rotation、in rotation；對照 revolution。

title: from/at the outset
content: ：開始。from/at the outset＝from the beginning；近 onset。參照 set out。

title: walk a / sb's dog = take a / sb's dog for a walk
go in search of...
content: go in search of...：去搜尋／尋找……。

title: make history
content: 創造歷史。例：Neil Armstrong made history by walking on the moon.（尼爾·阿姆斯壯在月球上漫步創造了歷史。）

title: have an / no interest in...
content: 對……有／沒有興趣。例：I have no interest in music. I love dancing.（我對音樂沒興趣，我喜歡跳舞。）

title: whistle to get someone's attention
content: 表示「吹口哨引起某人的注意」。例：Tom whistled to get his dog's attention.

title: in sb's neighborhood
content: 在某人住處附近。同義：near where sb lives。

title: throw away / get rid of
content: vt. 丟棄；似：throw away / get rid of

title: 人 + spend + 金錢／時間 + V-ing
have no equal
content: 沒有勢均力敵的對手，出類拔萃

title: major in... = choose... as one's major
house 作動詞
content: 提供住處、收容。例：The shelter can house thirty people overnight.

title: as + 身分／角色
content: 作介系詞，表示「以……的身分；作為……」。例：As the team leader, Ben must make the final decision.

title: have no alternative/choice/option but to + V
content: ：外交；交際手腕；diplomat；diplomatic；have no alternative/choice/option but to + V。

title: be the backbone of...
content: n. 脊椎；支柱；勇氣；片：be the backbone of...、have no backbone to V

title: intensive care unit
content: an intensive care unit：加護病房（縮寫為 ICU）。

title: sense + N／sense + that 子句
content: 感覺或察覺某事。例：I sensed that something had changed.

title: be in a slump
content: ：（價格、銷售）暴跌；暴跌、不景氣；a slump in...；be in a slump。

title: percentage 搭配
content: a large percentage of …：相當大百分比的…／大部分…；a small percentage of …：很小百分比的…／一小部分…。

title: because of + N/V-ing = due to + N/V-ing = as a result of + N/V-ing = thanks to + N/V-ing
dictate a letter/memo to sb
content: ：口述；指定、規定。dictate a letter/memo to sb；dictate to sb；dictation、take dictation、at sb's dictation。

title: a solution to sth
content: 某事物的解決辦法；某事物的答案。

title: a large / small number of + 複數可數名詞
for free
content: 免費。＝ free of charge。例：I didn't need to pay for the book because it was free.（我不用花錢買這本書，因為是免費的。）

title: act the part of...
content: 扮演……的角色。例：Emma Watson acted the part of Hermione in the Harry Potter movie series.（艾瑪·華森在《哈利波特》系列電影裡飾演妙麗一角。）

title: vocabulary 與 words 的改寫
content: John has a very large vocabulary. ＝ John knows many words.（約翰懂很多單字。）

title: be mad about / for / on sb/sth
as a token of sb's appreciation/gratitude
content: ：代幣；情感表示。as a token of sb's appreciation/gratitude；by the same token＝likewise；近 symbol。

title: break a record
content: 打破紀錄。例：He just broke the Olympic record for the men's 100-meter dash.（他剛剛打破了男子 100 公尺短跑奧運紀錄。）

title: take (great) pains to V
content: 煞費苦心／小心翼翼地做……，努力試著做……。

title: for ages
content: 很久。＝ for a long time。例：I haven't seen Sam for ages.（我好久都沒見到山姆了。）

title: would like to V / feel like V-ing
content: would like to V 是想要做；feel like V-ing 是有做某事的心情。例：I’d like to rest, but I don’t feel like sleeping.

title: switch A for B
content: 用 B 來代替 A。

title: reward
content: give sb sth as a reward；reward sb with sth。

title: fracture one's leg/rib/arm
content: ：斷裂；骨折；使斷裂／分裂。fracture one's leg/rib/arm、fracture A into B。

title: a piece of cake
content: 口語表示「非常容易的事」。例：The first puzzle was a piece of cake for Anna.

title: close with + N
content: 表示「以……作結」。例：The ceremony closed with a performance by the school band.

title: be aware of...
content: 知道……；察覺到……。同義：be conscious of...。

title: in a hurry / rush = in haste
president-elect
content: 當選人；elect 與名詞並用形成複合字，置於名詞之後。

title: a port city = a harbor city
behind sb’s back
content: 在某人背後、瞞著某人。例：It is unfair to make decisions behind her back.

title: shake someone's hand
content: 表示「與某人握手」。例：The candidates shook hands before the debate.

title: be weary of + N/V-ing
content: ：令人厭倦的。tired、tire；近 boring、weary；be weary of + N/V-ing＝be tired of + N/V-ing。

title: located 後介詞的選用
content: in 與大城市或區域並用；on 與街道或山峰並用；at 與轉角或某個有地址號碼的房舍並用。

title: be made of...
content: 由……製成（用於可辨認原材料時）。

title: The following are + 複數可數名詞
go + 形容詞
content: 表示「變成某種狀態」，常用於不良或明顯變化。例：The bread went stale after being left outside.

title: deserve 句型
content: deserve + N＝deserve to + V；Sb deserved it.＝Sb asked for it.＝It served sb right.：某人活該。

title: resolution 句型
content: make a resolution to + V＝make a promise to + V＝resolve to + V＝determine to + V＝make up one’s mind to + V。

title: It is feasible (for sb) to V
content: ：可行的。a feasible plan；economically/technically feasible；It is feasible (for sb) to V；反義 implausible。

title: give and take
content: 互相讓步、彼此妥協。例：Good teamwork requires patience and give and take.

title: lie down
content: 躺下來。例：Debra was tired, so she lay down on the sofa.（黛珀拉感到疲憊，所以在沙發上躺下。）

title: be / turn purple in the face = be / turn purple with rage
a revelation about/that ...
content: ：被揭露的內情／真相（可數）；披露（不可數）。a revelation about/that ...；reveal；近 disclosure。

title: wish sb sth
content: 祝某人（快樂、幸運……）。例：I wish you a Merry Christmas.（祝你聖誕快樂。）

title: score high / low on a test / an exam
content: score high / low on a test / an exam：考試考高／低分。

title: a piece of rubbish
content: *n.* 垃圾（英式、不可數）；美式 garbage / trash；也可指胡說：talk rubbish = talk nonsense/garbage。不可說 a rubbish，可說 a piece of rubbish。

title: or else
content: 表示「否則、要不然」，也可用於提出另一種可能。例：Leave now, or else you'll miss the last bus.

title: decade 的口語改寫
content: six decades ago ＝ three score years ago ＝ sixty years ago（60 年前）。

title: hear of / about...
content: 聽說有關……的事。例：Have you heard about Cole's promotion?（你有沒有聽說柯爾升遷了？）

title: get home / get to + 地方
content: get home 不加 to；其他多數地點使用 get to。例：We got to the hotel after midnight and got home the next afternoon.

title: 過去分詞可作形容詞
content: unite 的過去分詞 united 可作形容詞，表「團結的」。

title: suit one's needs
content: 符合、適合某人的需求。例：You can adjust the schedule to suit your needs.

title: love at first sight
content: 表示「一見鍾情」。例：They said it was love at first sight.

title: reckon sth up
content: 片：reckon (that)...、be reckoned to be...、What do you reckon?、reckon sth up

title: It remains to be seen + 疑問詞子句
content: It remains to be seen 之後接 when、what、how 等疑問詞引導的名詞子句，表「……有待觀察」。

title: sb guess that... = sb's guess is that...
make a fire
content: 生火。例：Let's make a fire to keep us warm.（我們生火來保暖吧！）

title: geological / geology
content: *a.* 地理的；geography 地理學；geological / geology 地質的／地質學。

title: in one's view ＝ from one's point of view ＝ from one's viewpoint
plague sb with sth
content: ：使受煎熬、糾纏；瘟疫；be plagued with/by...；plague sb with sth；Black Death／bubonic plague；epidemic；plaque。

title: downtown 作副詞時不置介詞
content: downtown 作副詞時，之前不得置介詞：Let's go to downtown.（×）→ Let's go downtown.（○）咱們去市區。

title: mouse 複數
content: mouse 表「老鼠」時，複數形為 mice。

title: railroad/grade/level crossing
content: ：（鐵路）平交道；行人穿越道。railroad/grade/level crossing；pedestrian/zebra crossing＝US crosswalk。

title: be up to one's neck in debt
surroundings／environment／circumstances
content: surroundings 指住處環境，恆用複數；environment 指生態環境，常用單數；circumstances 指抽象環境，常用複數，常與 under 連用；under such circumstances：在這樣的環境下。

title: lead a(n) + adj. + life
content: 過著某種生活。例：After retiring, they led a quiet life in the countryside.

title: milk and honey
content: 比喻富足、舒適而美好的生活；常見於 a land of milk and honey。例：Moving abroad does not guarantee a life of milk and honey.

title: ask + 人 + to a dance / ask + 人 + to dance
content: 前者表示「邀請某人參加舞會」，後者表示「邀請某人跳舞」。例：Ryan asked Zoe to dance with him.

title: write / keep a journal
content: write a journal（×）→ keep a journal（○）：寫日誌／記日記。

title: in a playground
content: in a playground：在（學校）操場；在（公園）遊樂場。

title: ask sb out
content: 邀某人約會或一起外出。例：Ryan finally asked Maya out for coffee.

title: feed on + 食物
content: 表示動物「以……為食」。例：Many small birds feed on insects.

title: be about to V
content: 正要、即將做某事，通常指很快就會發生。例：The show is about to begin, so please take your seat.

title: point A at B
content: 把 A 對準 B。例：I pointed my camera at the movie star.（我把照相機對準這個電影明星。）

title: be the cream of the crop = be the very best
abbreviate A to B
content: *vt.* 縮寫。abbreviate A to B；名詞 abbreviation；近義 shorten。

title: surf the Net / net
content: surf the Net / net = surf / browse the internet：上網。

title: be prone to + N/V-ing
content: ：有…傾向的；可能…的。be liable to + N/V-ing＝be prone to + N/V-ing。

title: set out
content: ：開始。from/at the outset＝from the beginning；近 onset。參照 set out。

title: honor / honorable
content: *a.* （學位）名譽上的。an honorary degree / chair / doctorate；相關 honor / honorable。

title: Garbage in, garbage out.
content: 垃圾進，垃圾出／濫入濫出。

title: transfer sb to
content: transfer sb to + 地方：調至某地。

title: stand in one’s way
content: 妨礙、阻擋某人。例：Don’t let one mistake stand in your way.

title: prediction / prospect
content: *n.* 展望、前景；近義 prediction / prospect。

title: represent sth
content: 代表某事物。同義說法：stand for sth；be a representation of sth。

title: choke
content: choke sb to death；choke to death；choke on sth。

title: be fit to burst with sth
content: be fit to burst with sth：……極了，充滿（……情緒）的。

title: in the face of + N
content: 表示「面對……時；儘管有……」。例：The rescue team remained calm in the face of danger.

title: have the nerve to V = have the courage / guts to V
prawn／lobster
content: 明蝦／龍蝦，書頁列為 shrimp 的延伸詞彙。

title: end up + V-ing
content: 最後結果竟然做了某事。例：We missed the bus and ended up walking home.

title: a wolf in sheep's clothing
content: a wolf in sheep's clothing：披著羊皮的狼。

title: It is necessary (for sb) to V
come across + 人／事物
content: 表示「偶然遇見、無意間發現」。例：I came across an old photograph while cleaning the attic.

title: also 與 too 的位置
content: also 通常放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後；too 通常放在句尾。例：Nora is a doctor and is also a writer.／Nora is a writer, too.

title: start a family
content: 通常表示夫妻「開始生育、組成有孩子的家庭」。例：The couple hopes to start a family in a few years.

title: have a yearning for N / to V
content: 片：have a yearning for N / to V

title: a school of fish / whales
content: 一群魚／鯨魚。例：A school of silver fish swam beneath the boat.

title: book / reserve a table (for + 人數)
recover + 失物／recover from + 狀況
content: recover 接物品表示尋回；recover from 表示從疾病、打擊或困境中恢復。例：The police recovered the stolen bike, and its owner soon recovered from the shock.

title: It is typical of sb to V
aircraft number
content: an aircraft = an airplane；two aircraft = two airplanes（aircraft 單複數同形）。

title: sb demand / require / request that S (+ should) + V
distance between A and B
content: A 和 B 之間的距離。

title: The following is + 單數可數名詞
be obliged to sb for sth
content: *vt.* 迫使、使負有義務、施加恩惠：oblige sb to + V、oblige sb by + V-ing；obliged 感激的：be obliged to sb for sth；obligation 道德或法律上的義務、責任。

title: combine A with B
content: 將 A 與 B 結合。

title: It’s sb’s turn to V
content: 輪到某人做某事。例：It’s your turn to choose the next song.

title: a native speaker of + 語言 = a native + 語言 + speaker
due / owing to + N/V-ing ＝ because of... ＝ on account of... ＝ as a result of...
follow one's heart
content: 隨心所欲。例：You should follow your heart and ask her out.（你應該跟隨自己的內心，邀她出去。）

title: swim with the tide
content: swim with the tide：順應潮流，隨波逐流。

title: get / come to the point
content: 講到重點。例：Eileen talked for ten minutes before she got to the point.（艾琳講了 10 分鐘才講到重點。）

title: be happy about / with... = be satisfied with...
one another = each other
content: 互相、彼此。例：The teammates encouraged one another before the game.

title: a police officer
content: 警察，員警。例：Emily's father is a police officer.（艾蜜莉的父親是警察。）

title: a city of + 數字 + inhabitants
content: ：居住於；棲息於。inhabit + place＝live/dwell/reside in/at；inhabitant、resident、dweller、habitat；a city of + 數字 + inhabitants。

title: dispense A to B
content: vt. 分配、配藥；片：dispense A to B、dispense medicine；詞族：dispenser、dispensary

title: restrain sb from V-ing
content: 片：restrain sb from V-ing = stop sb from V-ing

title: be in distress
content: *n.* 痛苦、危難（不可數）；*vt.* 使極痛苦、悲傷。be in distress；a damsel in distress；形容詞 distressed。

title: You can’t teach an old dog new tricks.
content: 諺語；老狗學不會新把戲。

title: stretch out one's hand / foot to V
數字 + thousand / thousands of + N
content: 前面有明確數字時 thousand 不加 s；表示概數時用 thousands of。例：Two thousand tickets were sold within hours.

title: along the road
content: 表示「沿著道路」。例：Several small cafés stand along the road.

title: a firm decision / promise
content: 堅決的決定／堅定的承諾

title: lose face
content: 表示「丟臉、失去顏面」。例：He refused to admit the mistake because he was afraid of losing face.

title: mind (sb) + V-ing
content: 介意（某人）做……。例：I don't mind driving if you want to take a rest.（如果你想休息的話，我不介意開車。）

title: wake up and smell the coffee
hear 與 listen 的辨析
content: hear 指耳朵聽到聲音；listen 指用耳朵專注聆聽。

title: a shooting star
content: 表示「流星」。例：We saw a shooting star above the mountain.

title: let's + 原形動詞
content: 讓我們做……。＝ let us + 原形動詞。例：Let's go picnicking this afternoon!（我們今天下午去野餐吧！）

title: come to a stop
content: 表示「停下來」。例：The bus slowly came to a stop beside the school.

title: shade 搭配
content: in the shade of a tree；pull up / down the shades；shade into …：逐漸變成…；put … in the shade：使…相形失色。

title: hold a referendum on...
content: n. 公投；片：hold a referendum on...

title: exempt A from B
content: a. / vt. 豁免；片：be exempt from、exempt A from B

title: with open arms
content: 表示「熱烈、誠摯地歡迎」。例：The host family welcomed the exchange student with open arms.

title: on a daily basis
content: on a daily basis = every day：每天。

title: marry sb = get married to sb
differentiate between A and B
content: 片：differentiate A from B、differentiate between A and B

title: rise to fame
content: 出名。例：The celebrity rose to fame overnight.（這個名人一夕成名。）

title: to make a long story short
content: 表示「長話短說」。例：To make a long story short, we missed the final train.

title: criticize 搭配
content: be criticized as …：被批評為…；comment on sth：對…發表評論。

title: grateful
content: be grateful to sb for sth = be thankful to sb for sth = be indebted to sb for sth；show one's gratitude；out of gratitude。

title: strive
content: strive to + V = strive for sth。

title: divert A into B
content: 片：divert A into B、divert one's attention from...

title: vocational education / training
content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

title: sb's best/close friend
content: 某人最好／親近的朋友。例：Michael is one of my closest friends.（麥可是我最親近的朋友之一。）

title: mourn sb's death
content: ：哀悼。mourn sb's death／mourn for sb；近 grieve over/for sth；mournful。

title: use one's brain
content: 用某人的腦子；動動某人的腦子

title: be in the mood to V = be in the mood for sth
one’s take on sth
content: 某人對某事的看法。例：What is your take on the new school rule?

title: toy with sb/sth
content: 玩弄某人（的感情）／玩弄某事物（如物品、感情等）。

title: be born with a silver spoon in one's mouth
content: 某人生來就命好；某人是富裕家庭出身；某人含著金湯匙出生。

title: for an instant
content: 那一瞬間，有那麼一會兒。

title: connect A with B
content: 將 A 與 B 聯想在一起。同義：associate A with B。

title: voice 與 sound 的辨析
content: sound 可用來表『任何聲音』，而 voice 則專指『人所發出來的聲音』。

title: solve a problem = resolve a problem
everything but the kitchen sink
content: 幾乎所有的東西；過多的東西。

title: across the street 與 cross the street
content: across the street 表示「在街道對面」；cross the street 表示「穿越街道」的動作。例：She crossed the street to visit the shop across from the bank.

title: encourage + 人 + to V
content: 鼓勵某人做某事。例：Our coach encouraged us to try again.

title: major 作動詞時與 in 並用
content: major 作不及物動詞「主修」解時，與介詞 in 並用。

title: A be reminiscent of B
content: *a.* 使人想起的：A be reminiscent of B。

title: at a speed of...
content: at a speed of...：以……的速度。

title: open at + 時間 / open a meeting with + N
content: open 可表示「開始營業」，也可表示「開始會議或活動」。例：The chairperson opened the meeting with a short announcement.

title: restrict／confine／limit
content: 三者皆可作 vt.，書上標示皆可接 to。

title: datum／data 用法
content: data 的單數形為 datum；data 常被視為不可數名詞，其後動詞用單數形，但於正式寫作中常用複數形動詞。

title: just 的常見副詞義
content: 可表示剛剛、正好、只是或加強語氣，需依語境判斷。例：I just arrived. / This key is just what we need.

title: vote sb sth
content: 投票給某人讓其擔任某職務

title: a bar / pie / line / flow chart
possession 搭配
content: take possession of sth：取得某物的所有權；be found in possession of …：被發現擁有…。

title: modern art
content: 現代藝術。例：I know nothing of modern art.（我對現代藝術一無所知。）

title: meet sb's expectations
content: 符合某人的期望。例：This restaurant failed to meet its customers' expectations.（這間餐廳未能符合顧客的期望。）

title: for 與 because
content: 皆可表「因為」；for 可作對等連接詞，連接兩個對等子句且不置句首；because 為從屬連接詞，引導的子句可置句首或主要子句後。

title: in anticipation of ... = in expectation of ...
content: *n.* 期待、預期。in anticipation of ... = in expectation of ...；動詞 anticipate。

title: keep an eye on + 人／事物
content: 表示「留意、照看……」。例：Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?

title: be in need of sth
content: 需要某物。例：Sally's hair is in need of a cut.（莎莉的頭髮需要剪一下了。）

title: allow sb/sth to V
content: 允許某人／某事物……。例：My parents wouldn't allow me to go out alone.（我爸媽不允許我一個人出門。）

title: somewhat 的位置
content: 使用 somewhat 時，該字常置於形容詞與副詞之間，修飾該形容詞或副詞。

title: reputation
content: a man of high / good repute。

title: barrier
content: be a barrier to ... = be an obstacle / a hindrance to ...。

title: a part of speech
content: 詞性（複數為 parts of speech）

title: twinkle with joy / delight
content: 片：twinkle with joy / delight、a twinkle in one's eye

title: equate A with B
content: *vt.* 使相等：equate A with B；equation *n.* 方程式、等式；equivalent *a./n.* 相等的／相等物。

title: in practice
content: 實際上。書頁列為 in theory 的反義說法。

title: because of + N / V-ing
content: because of 後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing；because 後接完整子句。例：The game was delayed because of heavy rain.

title: complete / completely / entirely / totally
content: *a.* 完全的；*vt.* 說、發出。not utter a word；utter a sigh；副詞 utterly；近義 complete / completely / entirely / totally。

title: in order of importance / difficulty
content: 按重要性／難度的順序。例：We learned those words in order of importance.（我們是依重要性的順序來學那些字。）

title: expense / spending
content: *n.* （政府或個人的）開支、開銷。expenditure on ...；近義 expense / spending；反義 income / revenue。

title: from now on
content: 表示「從現在起」。例：From now on, I'll check my work more carefully.

title: all day / night long
content: 表示「整天／整夜一直……」。例：The neighbors' dog barked all night long.

title: track + progress/change
content: 追蹤進度或變化。例：This app helps students track their learning progress.

title: be crowded with... = be full of...
reflect on + N
content: 表示「認真回想、反思……」。例：At the end of the course, students reflected on what they had learned.

title: bring disgrace on sb
content: ：恥辱（不可數）；可恥事（恆單數）；使丟臉。bring disgrace on sb、in disgrace、be a disgrace to、disgrace oneself by V-ing；近 shame、disgraceful、shameful。

title: fall into categories
content: fall into two / three … categories：分成兩／三…個種類。

title: make a decision ＝ make up one's mind
look / gaze / stare out of the window
content: 表示「往窗外看」；gaze 強調長時間凝視，stare 常帶有目不轉睛的感覺。例：She gazed out of the window at the falling snow.

title: captain 在軍語與民航用語中的所指
content: 在軍語中，captain 若用於陸軍或空軍，指「上尉」軍階，也分別指「連長」或「分隊長」；若用於海軍，captain 則指「上校」軍階或「艦長」。在民航用語中，captain 則指客機「機長」。

title: draw near
content: 即將來臨。例：The Chinese Lunar New Year is drawing near.（農曆春節快到了。）

title: round = around（美）
content: 繞著／繞過，英式用 round，美式用 around（The Earth moves round/around the Sun. 同義）。

title: the Orient / Occident
content: vt. 使適應；片：orient A to B；詞族：oriented；相關：the Orient / Occident

title: trifling / trivial
content: *n.* 瑣事；*vi.* 小看、怠慢。trifle with ...；形容詞 trifling / trivial。

title: have trouble + V-ing
content: 做某事有困難；意思接近 have difficulty V-ing。例：I had trouble finding the correct entrance.

title: hold sb in great/high respect = hold sb in great/high regard
inland city
content: a. / adv. / n. 內陸（的）；片：inland city

title: a person of many accomplishments
content: 有多樣才華的人；= a versatile person。

title: be blanketed with / in sth ＝ be covered with / in sth
invest 句型
content: invest money in …：將錢投資於…；invest in …：投資於…。

title: information 是不可數名詞
content: 不可直接說 an information 或 informations；一則資訊可說 a piece of information。例：She gave me some useful information.

title: ride a bicycle = ride a bike
report to sb (on sth)
content: 向某人報告（某事）。例：Report to me after you've finished the work.（你工作做完後向我報告。）

title: possess 句型
content: be possessed of sth＝possess sth：擁有（能力、技能等）；be possessed by a ghost：被鬼魂附身。

title: be protective of sb
content: 保護某人；對某人呵護備至

title: be difficult (for sb) to V
content: （某人）很難做……。例：It's very difficult for me to answer the question.（這個問題我很難回答。）

title: in the front of 與 in front of
content: in the front of 指某物內部前方；in front of 指某物外部前方。例：We sat in the front of the bus, in front of two teachers.

title: raise money
content: 募款。例：They raised money for the homeless.（他們為遊民募款。）

title: can't get enough of + N
content: 表示「非常喜愛……，怎麼都不嫌多」。例：My brother can't get enough of mystery stories.

title: a swarm of bees
content: 表示「一大群飛行中的蜜蜂」。例：A swarm of bees gathered near the old tree.

title: castles in the air
content: 幾乎不可能實現的事情／計畫。

title: fight against...
content: 抵抗……。例：We have to work together to fight against crime.（我們必須團結一起對抗犯罪。）

title: once 表示「曾經」
content: 表示過去某段時間曾有的狀態。例：This quiet street was once a busy market.

title: regard A as B
content: 表示「把 A 視為 B」。例：The villagers regard the old tree as a local treasure.

title: be lodged in/at + 地方
content: ：寄宿、租住；安置、收容；卡住；小屋、度假屋；be lodged in/at + 地方；hunting/ski lodge；lodging；board and lodging＝room and board。

title: partial
content: be partial toward sb / sth；be partial to sb / sth；in part = partly。

title: be in turmoil
content: ：騷動、混亂；be in turmoil；throw ... into turmoil；chaos。

title: a slump in...
content: ：（價格、銷售）暴跌；暴跌、不景氣；a slump in...；be in a slump。

title: have an appetite for sth = have a liking / passion for sth = enjoy sth
toast A with B
content: 用 B 來向 A 敬酒。

title: save / make / earn money
content: save money 是省錢或存錢；make/earn money 是賺錢。例：Nina cooks at home to save money, and tutors online to earn money.

title: rub salt into the wound
content: 在傷口上灑鹽；雪上加霜。

title: be + 數字 + years old
content: 表示年齡。例：The museum is more than one hundred years old.
