title: continual 與 continuous
content: 兩者皆可指「連續地」；continual 主要指持續一段長時間、曾多次停止後重新開始；continuous 指過程不中斷、持續進行。

title: a railroad station = a railway station = a train station
rotate crops
content: ：（地球）自轉；輪職；輪耕。rotate crops；近 revolve。

title: be dubious about N / V-ing
content: a. 可疑的、不確定的；片：be dubious about N / V-ing；似：doubtful

title: worm (one's way) through...
content: 擠過……，艱難地移動／蜷縮著身子穿過……。

title: mix A with B
content: 將 A 與 B 混合。

title: the key to sth
content: 某物的鑰匙；某事物的關鍵。

title: the Ivy League
content: *n.* 常春藤。the Ivy League 常春藤盟校。

title: a twinkle in one's eye
content: 片：twinkle with joy / delight、a twinkle in one's eye

title: cut / split sth in half
content: 把某物對半切。例：Let's split the pizza in half.（我們把披薩切成兩半吧。）

title: relations between A and B
content: A 和 B〔人或團體〕之間的關係

title: neglectful
content: be neglectful of ... = be negligent in ...。

title: types of magazine
content: a fashion / computer / travel magazine：時尚／電腦／旅遊雜誌。

title: waken 與 wake
content: waken 與 wake 同義；前者較文雅，後者較普遍。waken 醒來＝wake up；waken sb＝wake sb up。

title: It is incredible that
content: It is incredible that …：…是難以置信的。

title: be known to + 人
content: 為某人或某群體所知。例：The story is known to children throughout the country.

title: since 表『自從』的時態要求
content: since 表『自從』時，可作連接詞，其所引導的副詞子句須使用過去式；作介詞時，其所引導的介詞片語則須為過去的時間點，而主要子句的時態應採『現在完成式』或『現在完成進行式』。例：We haven't seen each other since last year.（我們從去年起就沒見過面了。）

title: differentiate A from B
content: 片：differentiate A from B、differentiate between A and B

title: raise one's hand
content: 舉手。例：Raise your hand if you know the answer.（如果知道答案，請舉手。）

title: break into a laugh
content: 突然大笑起來；等同 burst out laughing／break into laughter／burst into laughter。

title: peer
content: peer pressure；peer at ... = stare / gaze at ...。

title: call sth off / call off sth
peck at...
content: n. 啄木鳥；詞族：peck；片：peck at...

title: enough 的位置
content: 修飾名詞時放前面：enough time；修飾形容詞或副詞時放後面：old enough、quickly enough。例：The room is large enough for twenty people.

title: glue A to / onto B
content: glue A to / onto B：把 A 黏到 B 上。

title: hail a cab / taxi
content: 片：hail A as B、hail a cab / taxi

title: landscape vs. scenery
content: landscape 特指有山有水的風景，為可數；scenery 亦指風景，為不可數。

title: be combined with + N
content: 與……結合或混合。例：The sauce is combined with fresh herbs before serving.

title: buy sb sth = buy sth for sb
send sb sth = send sth to sb
back and forth
content: 來回地。例：The dog ran back and forth across the yard.

title: click one's heels
content: 某人喀的一聲併攏腳跟。

title: reckon (that)...
content: 片：reckon (that)...、be reckoned to be...、What do you reckon?、reckon sth up

title: absent oneself (from + 地方)
content: 某人沒有出現（在某地方）

title: lavish sb with sth
content: 片 lavish sb with sth 給某人很多某物

title: deter sb from + N/V-ing
content: ：阻止。deter sb from + N/V-ing；deterrence 阻嚇；近 hinder。

title: climax in / with ...
content: *n. & vi.* 最精彩處、最高點；達到最高峰。climax in / with ...；at the climax of ...；reach a climax。

title: wolf sth down
content: vt. 吞食；似／片：gulp sth down、wolf sth down

title: remind + 人 + to V
content: 表示「提醒某人做……」。例：Please remind Kevin to bring his library card.

title: know the score
content: know the score = know the truth：知道真相。

title: fasten one's seat belt
content: 表示「繫好安全帶」。例：Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.

title: meet one's needs
content: 滿足某人的需求。例：The program was redesigned to meet students' needs.

title: expenditure on ...
content: *n.* （政府或個人的）開支、開銷。expenditure on ...；近義 expense / spending；反義 income / revenue。

title: prefer to + 原形動詞
content: 表示比較喜歡或寧願做某事。例：I prefer to study in the library after school.

title: against one’s will
content: 違背某人的意願。例：No one should be forced to join against their will.

title: win／beat／defeat 的辨析
content: win、beat、defeat 均有『獲勝』之意，惟 win 之後的受詞是『比賽』或『獎項』，beat 和 defeat 則可接『人』或『隊伍』。

title: see sb
content: 和某人交往。例：Katie has been seeing her boyfriend for two years.（凱蒂和她男朋友交往 2 年了。）

title: start to V / start V-ing
content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：It started to rain. = It started raining.

title: hold sth dear = value sth = cherish sth
accept/take a bribe
content: ：賄賂（n./v.）。bribe sb to V/with sth；accept/take a bribe；bribery；易混 bride。

title: no later than + 時間
content: 在某個時間點之前。例：The article must be submitted no later than May 31st.（這篇文章得在 5 月 31 日前遞交。）

title: accustom oneself to ...
content: *vt.* 使習慣：accustom oneself to ...；accustomed：get accustomed to + N/V-ing = get used to。

title: solve / face a problem
content: 解決／面對問題。例：We must face the problem before we can solve it.

title: surf the internet / Internet = surf the net / Net
one's bread and butter
content: 表示某人的「主要收入來源、賴以維生的工作」。例：Repairing computers is his bread and butter.

title: a superiority complex
content: 片 a sense of superiority 優越感（＝ a superiority complex）

title: a glass of water
content: 一杯水。例：Just give me a glass of water.（給我一杯水就可以了。）

title: an accusation against sb
content: 片：make an accusation、an accusation against sb

title: be plagued with/by...
content: ：使受煎熬、糾纏；瘟疫；be plagued with/by...；plague sb with sth；Black Death／bubonic plague；epidemic；plaque。

title: hear from sb
content: 收到某人（寄信、來電等）的訊息。例：I haven't heard from you in a long time.（我好久沒收到你的消息了。）

title: limitation 搭配
content: impose a limitation on …；within limits；know one’s limits。

title: be in / out of contention for sth
content: 片：sb's contention that...、be in / out of contention for sth

title: whether to V
content: 是否做……。例：Carmen couldn't decide whether to buy the blue dress.（卡門無法決定是否買那件藍色洋裝。）

title: on foot
content: 表示「步行」。例：The station is close enough to reach on foot.

title: go back (to + 地方) / go back home
content: 回某地用 go back to；home 前不加 to。例：I went back to the store, then went back home.

title: transmit sth (from A) to B
content: 片 (1) transmit sth (from A) to B 將某物（從 A）傳送到 B

title: cooperation with
content: in cooperation with …；in collaboration with …：與…合作。

title: only 的三種角色
content: 作副詞表示「僅僅」，作形容詞表示「唯一的」，作連接詞可表示「可是、只不過」。例：I wanted to join them, only I had to work.

title: lend sth to sb = lend sb sth
tell right from wrong
content: 明辨是非。例：The boy is too young to tell right from wrong.（小男孩太小了，還不能明辨是非。）

title: job/crop rotation
content: ：旋轉；輪流。rotation of the Earth、job/crop rotation、in rotation；對照 revolution。

title: a cash register
content: 詞族／相關：cash、teller、an automated teller machine、a cash register

title: air conditioning
content: 空調、冷氣系統。例：The air conditioning in our classroom is being repaired.

title: however 表「無論如何」
content: however 表「無論如何」時，等於 no matter how，之後先接形容詞或副詞，再接主詞及動詞。

title: be exempt from
content: a. / vt. 豁免；片：be exempt from、exempt A from B

title: leisurely 搭配
content: lead a leisurely life（=live leisurely）：過著悠閒的生活。

title: perform a mission
content: 執行任務。同義說法：carry out a mission。

title: map out a plan = draw up a plan
piece sth together
content: 把某物拼湊在一起。例：The detective pieced together the events of the night.（偵探將那一晚發生的事件拼湊起來。）

title: be weak in...（續 p.90 已收，本頁不重複）
weather 與 climate
content: climate 指某個地區的氣候，是可數名詞，可加冠詞 a 或用複數；weather 泛指天氣，是不可數名詞，絕對不可加冠詞 a 或用複數。

title: go on a trip / tour
content: 表示「去旅行／參加遊覽」。例：Our class went on a science tour during the winter break.

title: reproduction / production
content: *vi. & vt.* 生殖、繁殖；複製、翻印。reproduce oneself；相關 produce / breed / procreate；名詞 reproduction / production，近義 breeding / replica。

title: a good buy
content: 此處 buy 作名詞，表示「值得購買、價格划算的東西」。例：This winter coat was a good buy at half price.

title: a set of headphones = a headset
content: *n.* （恆用複數）耳機。a set of headphones = a headset；近義 earphones。

title: place importance on sth
content: 重視某事。例：This school places great importance on independent reading.

title: console / consolation
content: 面皰、粉刺／青春痘；acne 不可數。console / consolation 安慰／安慰；comfort。

title: like V-ing / like to V
content: 兩者都可表示喜歡；V-ing 常偏一般喜好，to V 可偏某次選擇或習慣。例：I like reading, but tonight I’d like to watch a film.

title: stay + adj.
content: 保持……。例：Where did you stay while you were in Paris?（此句實為 stay at/in，非 stay+adj，書頁該條例句另見 p.95）

title: at the age of + 數字
content: 在若干歲時。例：Steven left home at the age of 25.（史蒂芬在 25 歲時離家。）

title: care for + 人
content: 此處表示「照顧、照料某人」。例：Nina stayed home to care for her grandmother.

title: put A through to B
content: 把 A 的電話轉接給 B。

title: sell + 人 + 事物 / sell + 事物 + to + 人
content: 兩種結構都表示「把某物賣給某人」。例：The farmer sold the restaurant fresh vegetables.

title: give sb sth = give sth to sb
first thing (in the morning)
content: 一早第一件事；表示某事會優先處理。例：I’ll call the clinic first thing in the morning.

title: be known as + 身分／名稱
content: 以某個名稱或身分為人所知。例：The town is known as the flower capital of the region.

title: take preventive measures to V
content: ：預防的；可預防的藥／措施。take preventive measures to V＝take precautions to V；prevent。

title: including／inclusive of／included 的位置
content: 名詞前可使用 including 或 inclusive of；名詞後則使用過去分詞 included。

title: green energy
content: 綠色能源、低環境負擔的能源。例：The town plans to invest more in green energy.

title: reach a climax
content: *n. & vi.* 最精彩處、最高點；達到最高峰。climax in / with ...；at the climax of ...；reach a climax。

title: crack down on
content: ：制裁；鎮壓。a crackdown on sth；crack down on；近 clampdown、control、restriction。

title: abandon 句型
content: abandon hope / a plan＝give up hope / a plan；abandon oneself to + N/V-ing：沉溺於…。

title: arrest/search warrant
content: ：逮捕令；搜索令。arrest/search warrant；warranty＝保證書／保固，be under warranty/guarantee。

title: hold a meeting
content: 舉行會議。例：The club will hold a meeting after lunch.

title: Familiarity breeds contempt.
content: ：通曉、熟悉、親近；one’s familiarity with sth；familiar／be familiar with；familiarize；Familiarity breeds contempt.

title: pardon me
content: 打擾一下；不好意思；對不起；請再說一遍。

title: get down on one's knees
content: 跪下；等同 fall to one's knees。

title: have fun + V-ing = have a good time + V-ing
mean to V
content: 有意要做……。＝ intend to V。

title: arrive at + 地點
content: arrive at + 適當於（如車站、郵局等）到達……。

title: avoid + N / V-ing
content: 表示「避免……」；接動作時使用 V-ing，不能接 to V。例：Please avoid making loud noises in the hallway.

title: have a hunch that ...
content: *n.* 預感、直覺；*vi. & vt.* （使）背部隆起。have a hunch that ...；hunch over ...；hunchback 駝背者。

title: least 的冠詞規則
content: least 表最高級「最少的」修飾名詞時用 the；副詞用法依結構判斷。例：This route requires the least time.

title: mix with sb
content: 和某人打交道；和某人結交。

title: be sure to V
content: 必定／一定……。例：When traveling to Paris, be sure to visit the Eiffel Tower.（到巴黎旅遊時，一定要去看看艾菲爾鐵塔。）

title: sb's bark is worse than sb's bite
dishwashing liquid
content: ：洗滌劑。laundry/dish detergent＝dishwashing liquid；a bar/cake of soap；stain。

title: book + 票券／房間／交通工具
content: 作動詞表示「預訂」。例：We booked a room near the train station.

title: be hungry for... = be eager for...
on one’s way to
content: 在前往某地的途中。例：I bought some fruit on my way home.

title: be on display = be on exhibition
sb's public image
content: 某人的公眾形象。例：The actor's public image has been ruined by the incident.（這名演員的公眾形象被這起事件毀了。）

title: play on a seesaw
content: play on a seesaw：玩蹺蹺板。

title: be nothing to sneeze at
content: *vi./n.* 打噴嚏；be nothing to sneeze at（美）＝not to be sneezed at（英）：不可小覷、很重要。hiccup 打嗝。

title: be associated with...
content: 與……有關；= be connected to / with...。

title: A is different from B (in...)
content: A 與 B（在……方面）不同。＝ A differs from B in...。例：Gina is very different from her sister in personality.（吉娜與她妹妹在個性方面很不同。）

title: refer to the dictionary / phone book
content: 查字典／電話簿；= consult the dictionary / phone book。

title: Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn
content: ：（南、北）回歸線；熱帶的。Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn；tropical。

title: give sb a nod of encouragement / agreement
content: 對某人點頭以示鼓勵／同意

title: take/go for a stroll
content: ：散步（vi./n.）。take/go for a stroll＝take/go for a walk。

title: the arts
content: 藝術（含繪畫、舞蹈、音樂等的總稱）。例：The government is cutting funding for the arts.（政府削減提供給藝術的資金。）

title: 數字 + million
content: 以「數字 + million」表「幾百萬」時，無論前面數字為多少，million 一律不加 s。

title: a bilateral agreement
content: ：（談判、協定等）雙邊的。a bilateral agreement；對照 unilateral、multilateral、lateral。

title: flea market
content: a flea market：跳蚤市場（賣舊貨的市集）。

title: though 作副詞
content: though 作副詞表「然而」，等於 however，通常置於句尾。

title: administer medicine to sb.
content: *vt.* 管理；執行／實施（法律等）；給予（藥物、治療等）。administer justice / the law；administer medicine to sb.；衍生 administrator / administrative；近義 manage。

title: reach a peak / reach sth's peak
content: 達到巔峰；達到某事物的巔峰

title: book / reserve a table for + 人數
content: 表示「預訂幾人座的餐桌」。例：I'd like to reserve a table for six at seven o'clock.

title: one's love for + 人／事物
content: 表示「某人對……的愛或喜愛」。例：Her love for animals led her to become a vet.

title: stay out
content: 表示「待在外面、不回家」，常與時間搭配。例：You shouldn't stay out too late on a school night.

title: an editor in chief = an editor-in-chief
content: 總編輯（複數為 editors in chief）。

title: resolve 句型
content: resolve / solve the problem；resolve to + V；strengthen / weaken sb’s resolve。

title: win a game / race
content: 贏得比賽。例：We won the game by two points.（我們以 2 分之差贏得比賽。）

title: A conflict with B
content: A 和 B 衝突／相抵觸。

title: It is reported that...
content: 據報導……。例：It is reported that the flood claimed 20 lives.（據報導，此次洪水奪走了 20 條人命。）

title: a piece of cloth
content: a piece of cloth：一塊布料。

title: on the outskirts of ... = in the suburbs of ...
content: *n.* （恆用複數）郊區。on the outskirts of ... = in the suburbs of ...；近義 suburb。

title: win (sb's) favor
content: 得到（某人的）支持，博得（某人的）好感

title: midnight 與 midday
content: midnight 是半夜；midday 是正午，搭配 at midday。

title: signal + 人 + to V
content: 表示「示意某人做……」。例：The guard signaled us to wait outside.

title: throw a party
content: 舉行派對。例：We threw a party for our son's birthday.（我們開派對為兒子慶生。）

title: get down / fall to one's knees
content: 表示「跪下」；fall to one's knees 常帶有突然、懇求或筋疲力盡的語氣。例：The runner fell to his knees after crossing the finish line.

title: feel blue
content: 感到憂鬱、心情低落。例：Tina felt blue after her best friend moved away.

title: monetary policy
content: a. 貨幣的、金融的；片：monetary policy、in place

title: make a comment on...
content: 對……評論／發表意見；= comment on...。

title: accomplish a goal
content: 達到目標；= achieve / attain a goal。

title: classify
content: classify A as B = categorize A as B。

title: the rains
content: 複數 rains 常指某地區的「雨季、季節性降雨」。例：The roads become difficult to use when the rains arrive.

title: make / propose a toast to sb
a flight deck / path
content: a flight deck / path：飛機駕駛艙／飛機航線。

title: name A + 名字 + after B
content: 依 B 之名將 A 取名為……。例：We named him Henry after his grandfather.（我們以他祖父之名將他命名為亨利。）

title: set off fireworks
content: ：鞭炮（可數）。set off a firecracker；firework(s)、set off fireworks。

title: turn around / turn right / left
content: 轉身；右轉／左轉。例：Turn left at the light, then turn around at the gate.

title: be haunted by ...
content: ：（鬼魂）常出沒於；不斷困擾。be haunted by ...；haunted house。

title: extrovert / extroverted
content: a. 外向的；似：extrovert / extroverted；反：shy、introvert / introverted

title: take a chance
content: 冒險，碰運氣。例：Do not take chances with your health.（健康不能碰運氣。）

title: put down = write down
content: 寫下、記下。例：Put down your ideas before you forget them.

title: be due to V ＝ be expected to V
come to sb’s assistance
content: come to sb’s assistance：來幫助某人。

title: take care of + 人／事物
content: 表示「照顧；負責處理」。例：Could you take care of my plants this weekend?

title: operate on... = perform an operation on...
God 用法
content: god 若意成大寫的 God，專指基督教的上帝，不加冠詞。

title: smuggle sth into / out of...
content: vt. 走私；片：smuggle sth into / out of...；衍：smuggler

title: write... in ink
content: write... with ink（×）→ write... in ink（○）：用墨水寫……。

title: a ten-story building
content: story 也可表示建築物的「樓層」；作複合形容詞時使用單數。例：They work in a twelve-story building.

title: quake with cold/fear/anger
content: ：顫抖；搖晃；地震。quake with cold/fear/anger；近 shake、tremble。

title: apply for admission to a university
either A or B
content: 表示「A 或 B 其中之一」；A、B 應使用平行結構。例：You can either take the bus or walk home.

title: distinguish A from B
content: 區別 A 與 B 的不同；= tell A from B。

title: 金額's／時間's + worth of sth
content: 價值若干金額的某事物／需花費若干時間的某事物。若金額為阿拉伯數字，則不加「s」。

title: arrive in + 地點
content: arrive in + 大地方（如城市、國家等）到達……。

title: reservation 搭配
content: make a reservation for …：預訂…；without reservation：毫不保留地。

title: as a matter of fact = in fact
look sth up in a dictionary
pick sth up / pick up sth
as be one's custom
content: 是某人的習慣。依原書字樣抄錄。

title: be a stone's throw from + 地方
compose 句型
content: A be composed of B＝A be made up of B＝A consist of B＝B compose A；compose oneself：使自己鎮定。

title: translate A into B
content: translate A into B：將 A 翻譯為 B。

title: about 表大約
content: about + 數量／時間表示約莫。例：The walk takes about fifteen minutes.

title: be in favor of sth = favor sth
learn / know the ropes
content: 知道訣竅（ropes 恆用複數）。

title: space sth + 距離 + apart
content: 以若干距離間隔開某物。例：The gardener spaced these plants ten inches apart.（園丁以 10 英寸的距離間隔開這些植物。）

title: be fast approaching ＝ be around the corner ＝ be near at hand ＝ be coming soon
hit the books
content: 口語表示「用功讀書」。例：I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to hit the books tonight.

title: belief about + N
content: 表示「對某件事的信念或看法」。例：Their beliefs about education are quite different.

title: appreciate + N/V-ing
content: 欣賞、感激某事；後接名詞或動名詞，不接 to + 原形動詞。例：I appreciate having a quiet place to study.

title: the latter
content: 後者；原書註明前面固定加 the。

title: at sb's dictation
content: ：口述；指定、規定。dictate a letter/memo to sb；dictate to sb；dictation、take dictation、at sb's dictation。

title: most 的冠詞
content: 作形容詞表「最多的」時前加 the；表「大多數的」時不加 the。作最高級副詞表「最」修飾副詞、動詞時不一定加 the；修飾名詞時須加 the。

title: orient A to B
content: vt. 使適應；片：orient A to B；詞族：oriented；相關：the Orient / Occident

title: sth pop into sb's mind / head
audience 與 spectator 的分別
content: audience 是集合名詞（通常不加 s）；spectator 是可數名詞，複數需加 s。

title: sketch
content: do a sketch of ...；draw a sketch；a sketched map。

title: add A to B
content: 將 A 加進 B。例：If you add two and three, you get five.（2 加 3 等於 5。）

title: to no avail
content: 片 in vain 白費功夫 ＝ to no avail ＝ to no purpose

title: 疑問詞 + on earth...?
content: 到底……？（＝ 疑問詞 + in the world...?）。例：What on earth is Gary doing?（蓋瑞到底在做什麼？）

title: electric razor
content: ：電動刮鬍刀。＝electric shaver／electric razor；shave；對照非電動 razor。

title: out of sb's reach
content: 某人碰不到。例：Knives and forks should be put out of children's reach.（刀叉應該放在孩童伸手拿不到的地方。）

title: haunted house
content: ：（鬼魂）常出沒於；不斷困擾。be haunted by ...；haunted house。

title: catch / get / have a cold
content: catch或get a cold 表示「感冒了」；have a cold 表示「正患感冒」。例：Sam caught a cold after the camping trip.

title: connect A to B
content: 將 A 與 B 連結，使 A 與 B 有關聯。

title: have no choice but to V
drive sb to + 地方
content: 開車載某人到某地。例：I drive my son to school every day.（我每天開車送我兒子上學。）

title: be sure (that)...
content: 確信……。例：I am sure (that) Taylor will succeed.（我確信泰勒會成功。）

title: Not until 句首倒裝
content: not until 引導的否定副詞子句置句首時，其後須採倒裝句構。

title: a relationship between A and B
content: A 和 B 之間的關係

title: look back on + 一段時期／經歷
content: 表示「回顧某段經歷」。例：She looks back on her school days with gratitude.

title: make + 受詞 + 形容詞／名詞
content: 表示「使……變得……」或「使……成為……」。例：The good news made her happy.

title: allege that ...
content: ：（無證據地）宣稱。allege that ...／It is alleged that ...；alleged、allegedly、allegation；近 accusation。

title: divert one's attention from...
content: 片：divert A into B、divert one's attention from...

title: greeting
content: a greeting card；offer greetings to A for B = Remember B to A。

title: cameraman
content: 電影拍攝員／電視攝影記者。

title: be obsessed with...
content: 片 (1) be obsessed with... 著迷於……；因……而心神不寧

title: a draught of...
content: 片 a draught of... 一大口……

title: under the direction of sb
content: 在某人的領導／管理之下

title: forbid
content: forbid + V-ing；forbid sb to + V = forbid sb from + V-ing。

title: a lot of relief
content: 許多救濟物資。同義：a lot of relief materials。

title: in the sun
content: 表示「在陽光下」。例：Don't leave the medicine in the sun.

title: critical 搭配
content: be in critical condition：處於危急的情況；be critical of …：批評…。

title: next + 時間與 the next + 時間
content: next Friday 表示以下一個星期五；the next day 表示某個過去或未來時間點的隔天。例：We arrived on Monday and left the next day.

title: still 的位置
content: 表「仍然」時，通常置於一般動詞前、be 動詞後。例：He still studies there. / He is still a student.

title: keep / bear + 事物 + in mind
content: 表示「把……牢記在心、納入考量」，常用來提醒。例：Keep the weather in mind when planning the trip.

title: at some point
content: 在某個時候、某一階段。例：At some point, every learner makes mistakes.

title: a source of friction between A and B
content: ：摩擦力；衝突（不可數）。cause/create friction；a source of friction between A and B；近 conflict、clash。

title: count on... = depend on... = rely on...
reproduce oneself
content: *vi. & vt.* 生殖、繁殖；複製、翻印。reproduce oneself；相關 produce / breed / procreate；名詞 reproduction / production，近義 breeding / replica。

title: the press + 單數動詞（美）
content: 新聞界，記者；= the press + 單／複數動詞（英）。

title: object to + N/V-ing = oppose + N/V-ing = be opposed to + N/V-ing
with emotion
content: with emotion：感情激動地，帶著強烈的情感。

title: earn a living = make a living
else 的位置
content: else 放在 someone、anything、where 等不定代名詞、疑問詞之後。例：Is there anything else you need?

title: have little/a lot/nothing in common (with sb)
content: （與某人）有很少／許多／沒有共同點。例：Even though we are twins, we have very little in common with each other.（雖然我們是雙胞胎，彼此的共同點卻很少。）

title: at the expense of sth
content: 以某事物為代價，放棄某事物。

title: forget + V-ing
content: 忘了曾做……。例：I forgot watching this film.（我忘了曾看過這部影片。）

title: have a good command of + 語言
a feasible plan
content: ：可行的。a feasible plan；economically/technically feasible；It is feasible (for sb) to V；反義 implausible。

title: pedestrian/zebra crossing
content: ：（鐵路）平交道；行人穿越道。railroad/grade/level crossing；pedestrian/zebra crossing＝US crosswalk。

title: be true to sb ＝ be faithful to sb
have a nice time / day
content: 有一段美好的時光／有美好的一天。

title: wear a bow
content: 紮蝴蝶結；帶上蝴蝶領結。

title: be glued to sth
content: be glued to sth：目不轉睛地看某事物。

title: set a precedent for ...
content: *vt.* 在⋯⋯之前。A be preceded by B；形容詞 preceding；名詞 precedent，set a precedent for ...；unprecedented 史無前例的。

title: spread butter on sth = butter sth
big brother / sister
content: 口語中常表示「哥哥／姊姊」，但正式表達年齡關係通常用 older brother／sister。例：My older sister studies in Kaohsiung.

title: several 的搭配
content: several 後須接複數可數名詞。

title: a real find
content: 名詞用法，指難得發現的好東西或好人選。例：This quiet café is a real find.

title: keep sb posted on...
content: 隨時將……的最新消息告知某人。

title: clothes 用法
content: clothes 視為複數名詞，其後動詞須使用複數動詞。

title: ask for trouble
content: 自找麻煩。例：You're just asking for trouble if you drink and drive.（如果你酒駕就是在自找麻煩。）

title: pursue 搭配
content: pursue one’s goals；pursue one’s dreams；pursue a girl＝chase a girl＝chase after a girl。

title: put in + 時間／心力
content: 表示「投入時間或心力」。例：The team put in months of work before the competition.

title: a story about / of + N
content: 表示「關於……的故事」。例：Grandma told us a story about her childhood.

title: machinery 與 machine
content: machinery 為集合名詞、不可數；machine 為普通名詞，單數前須加 a/an/the，否則使用複數。a machine／two machines／many machines＝a lot of machinery。

title: establish sth
content: 建立某物；= set up sth。

title: food 與 foods
content: 泛指食物時通常不可數；指不同種類的食物時可用複數 foods。例：The market sells foods from several countries.

title: prefer A to B
content: 喜歡 A 甚於 B。

title: can't make head nor tail of sth
prevent sb/sth from + N/V-ing / being p.p.
content: 阻止某人／某物……；使某人／某物無法……。

title: be drawn to + N
content: 受到……吸引。例：Many visitors are drawn to the town's peaceful atmosphere.

title: certain of... ＝ some of...
content: 一些……。例：Certain of the employees take long coffee breaks.（有些員工喝咖啡的休息時間很久。）

title: Four divided by two equals two.
next 作副詞
content: next 可表示「接下來、下一步」，前面不需介系詞。例：Nobody knew what would happen next.

title: abide by ...
content: *vi.* 遵守；三態 abide–abided/abode–abided。abide by ...；law-abiding 守法的；abode 住所。

title: With pleasure.
content: 我很樂意。（用於回應請求或邀約）

title: How come + S + V?
content: 口語「為什麼……？」後面用直述句語序，不倒裝。例：How come you are home so early?

title: keep sb's fingers crossed = cross sb's fingers
a herd of cows
content: herd 是牛、象等群居大型動物的量詞，表示「一群牛」。例：A herd of cows crossed the country road.

title: spare
content: spare no effort to + V；spare sb's feelings；a spare tire；Spare the rod, spoil the child.

title: resemble
content: resemble 為及物動詞，不與介詞 like 併用；bear a close resemblance to ... = look very much like ...。

title: lamb 發音
content: lamb 的 b 不發音。

title: duck down
content: 表示「迅速低頭或彎腰」，通常為了閃避。例：We ducked down when the ball flew toward us.

title: be reconciled with sb
content: 片：reconcile A with B、be reconciled with sb

title: American / Canadian / French / ... by birth
content: 生於美國／加拿大／法國等。

title: go jogging
content: go jogging = go for a jog：去慢跑。

title: get + adj.
content: 表「變得」時為連綴動詞，後接形容詞。

title: go to sleep
content: 去睡覺（sleep 為名詞）= go to bed。

title: by airplane
content: 搭飛機。例：Matt is scared to travel by airplane.（麥特害怕搭飛機旅行。）

title: be sure of/about sth
content: 確信某事物。例：I am sure of Taylor's success.（我確信泰勒的成功。）

title: stab
content: stab sb in the + 身體部位；stab sb in the back。

title: turn right
content: 右轉。＝ turn to the right。例：Turn right at the next block, and you'll see the restaurant.（在下一個街區右轉，你就會看到那間餐廳了。）

title: handle a problem = deal / cope with a problem
socialize with sb
content: socialize vi. 與人交際（無編號附掛詞條）；片：socialize with sb

title: in the midst of
content: prep. 在……之中；似：among；片：in the midst of

title: have a lot on one's plate
detective 搭配
content: a detective novel；a detective movie / film。

title: an additional + 數字
content: 額外若干……。同義說法：an extra + 數字。

title: respectful
content: be respectful to sb；be respectful of sth；Respectfully yours, ...。

title: will 的時態與否定
content: 助動詞用於未來式；過去式為 would；否定 will not 可縮寫為 won't。

title: show respect to / for + 人／事物
content: 表示「對……表示尊重」。例：Students should show respect for different opinions.

title: cellular phone
content: 片：cellular phone = cell phone = mobile phone

title: A be equal to B ＝ A equal B
content: A 等於 B；A 和 B 相同

title: regulate temperature
content: regulate / adjust the temperature：調節溫度。

title: rent sth from sb (for + 金額)
appeal to + 人 / have appeal for + 人
content: 表示「對某人具有吸引力」。例：The simple design appeals to customers of all ages.

title: get into the swing of things / it
content: get into the swing of things / it：進入狀態，開始積極投入。

title: identify A as B
content: 將 A 認定為 B。

title: at the beginning / end of the term
a large amount of + 不可數名詞
content: 大量的……；後面接不可數名詞，動詞通常配合 amount 使用單數。例：A large amount of water was wasted.

title: a bake sale
content: a bake sale：烘焙義賣活動。

title: follow 的兩種理解義
content: follow instructions/signs 是遵循；can’t follow an explanation 是聽不懂。例：Follow the map, and tell me if you can’t follow my directions.

title: be made from...
content: 由……製成（用於無法辨認原材料時）。

title: the world is sb's oyster
content: n. 牡蠣；片：the world is sb's oyster

title: have an itch (for sth. / to V)
content: *n.* 癢、渴望；*vt. & vi.* （使）發癢。have an itch (for sth. / to V) 強烈渴望⋯⋯。

title: let sb + 原形動詞
content: 讓某人做……。例：Mia's parents won't let her go out after 10 p.m.（晚上 10 點後，米雅的爸媽就不讓她出門。）

title: be not sb's cup of tea
content: 不是某人的菜；不是某人所喜歡的。

title: the Mid-Autumn Festival / the Moon Festival
have a capacity of + 數字
desperate
content: be desperate to + V / for + N；書上同列 anxious、dying、eager、longing 的同句型。

title: coat A with B
content: 把 B 塗在 A 上。

title: be destined / bound for...
content: 片：be destined to V、be destined / bound for...

title: abound in/with ...
content: ：充滿。abound in/with ...；abundance、abundant；in abundance＝in profusion/in large quantities。

title: the moment／the instant／as soon as
content: 三者都可引導時間副詞子句，表示某事發生後另一件事立刻發生。例：As soon as the door opened, the children ran outside.

title: wait a minute = hold on a minute
fall down
content: 跌倒。例：The old woman fell down and hurt her leg.（老婆婆跌倒，傷了腿。）

title: furniture 不可數用法
content: a furniture（×）；a lot of furnitures（×）；a piece of furniture（一件傢俱）；a lot of furniture（許多傢俱）。

title: one of + 複數名詞
content: 表示「……之一」，of 後面的可數名詞使用複數。例：The waterfall is one of the natural wonders of the island.

title: although / though 與 but
content: although／though 作連接詞表「雖然」時，不得再與 but 並用，否則造成雙重連接詞錯誤。

title: key sth in / key in sth
be new to + 人
content: 表示某件事「對某人而言很陌生、不熟悉」。例：The software is still new to our team.

title: work for
content: 替某人或機構工作。例：My aunt works for a local newspaper.

title: write sth down / write down sth
from dawn to dusk
content: n. 黃昏；片：from dawn to dusk；相關：dawn、daybreak、twilight

title: mingle with ...
content: ：混合；融入。mingle with ...、mingle A with B；近 mix。

title: a sense of superiority
content: 片 a sense of superiority 優越感（＝ a superiority complex）

title: violinist / violin
content: *n.* 鋼琴家；piano 鋼琴；violinist / violin 小提琴家／小提琴。

title: It is generous of sb to V
content: It is generous of sb to V：某人很寬宏大量做……。

title: demonstration 搭配
content: give sb a demo（=give sb a demonstration）；hold a demonstration；launch a demonstration。

title: many happy returns (of the day)
content: 祝（你）長命百歲／祝（你）生日快樂。

title: devote oneself to + N/V-ing
content: 某人奉獻／致力於……；= dedicate oneself to + N/V-ing。

title: be responsible for + N/V-ing = have responsibility for + N/V-ing
conserve electricity/water/energy
content: ：節約（能源）；保護（環境）；果醬。conserve electricity/water/energy；conservation；對照 converse、reserve、preserve。

title: balance A on B
content: 把 A 平衡在 B 上。

title: unity 與介詞 with／in 並用
content: unity 可與介詞 with 及 in 並用。

title: a piece of toilet tissue / paper
have a fine / good / beautiful figure
in disgrace
content: ：恥辱（不可數）；可恥事（恆單數）；使丟臉。bring disgrace on sb、in disgrace、be a disgrace to、disgrace oneself by V-ing；近 shame、disgraceful、shameful。

title: frame sb
content: 陷害某人；= set sb up。

title: be in the same boat
content: 表示「處於相同的困境或情況」。例：None of us understood the instructions, so we were all in the same boat.

title: define A as B
content: 將 A 定義為 B

title: in all aspects
content: 在各方面；= in every aspect。

title: become + adj. / noun
content: 表示變得……或成為……。例：The sky became dark, and Mia became the team leader.

title: 人 + spend + 金錢／時間 + on ...
continue + V-ing = continue to V = go on + V-ing
satisfy one's desire for + N
content: 表示「滿足某人對……的渴望」。例：The quiet weekend satisfied her desire for peace.

title: A doesn't compare with B
content: A 比不上 B；A 和 B 不能相比。

title: for better or (for) worse
content: 不論好壞，不管結果如何

title: further vs farther
content: 一般而言，further 指程度上「更進一步」；farther 指實際空間、距離上「更遠」。

title: a large / small quantity of + 複數可數名詞／不可數名詞
be of no / little / some / great consequence
content: 不／不太／有些／非常重要；= be of ... importance。

title: enroll / enrollment
content: 同情：sympathize with；sympathy、sympathetic；pity。enroll / enrollment 註冊：enroll in ...。

title: a man / woman of few words
be up in the air
content: 尚未決定，懸而未決。例：The team's future is still up in the air.（該隊的前途仍懸而未決。）

title: be held accountable for sth
content: 片：be held accountable for sth = responsible

title: go / turn red
content: 因害羞、生氣或熱而臉紅。例：His face turned red when everyone applauded him.

title: an identity card = an ID card
teach + 人 + how to V
content: 表示「教某人如何做……」。例：My uncle taught me how to fix a bicycle tire.

title: a contact (lens)；a pair of contact lenses
content: 隱形眼鏡片；一副隱形眼鏡。

title: be two sides of the same coin = be different / opposite sides of the same coin
content: 是（同）一件事情／一個問題的兩面

title: intimate
content: an intimate friend = a very close friend。

title: administer justice / the law
content: *vt.* 管理；執行／實施（法律等）；給予（藥物、治療等）。administer justice / the law；administer medicine to sb.；衍生 administrator / administrative；近義 manage。

title: steak 熟度
content: steak well done：全熟；medium：5 分熟；rare：1 分熟。

title: hand in sth / hand sth in
book a table / room / ticket
content: 此處 book 作動詞，表示「預訂」。例：We booked a table by the window for Saturday evening.

title: do / cause damage to sb/sth = do / cause harm to sb/sth
young at heart
content: 表示「心態年輕」。例：My grandfather is eighty but still young at heart.

title: be through with ...
content: be through with ... = be finished with ... = be done with ... = finish ...；做完……。

title: on time 與 in time
content: on time 是準時；in time 是及時、趕在太晚之前。例：The bus arrived on time, and we reached the gate in time for boarding.

title: be kin to...
content: n. 親屬；a. 相似的；片：next of kin、be kin to...

title: gaze
content: gaze at ... = stare at ...；gaze out of the window；meet sb's gaze。

title: nag sb to V
content: 片：nag sb to V、nag sb about sth、nag at sb

title: hand in + 事物 / hand + 事物 + in
content: 表示「繳交文件、作業等」。例：Students must hand in the form by Friday.

title: be fully booked
content: 表示「已被訂滿、沒有空位」。例：The hotel was fully booked during the holiday weekend.

title: route 句型
content: sth be routed via / through + 地方：某物透過某地運送。

title: wander / rove
content: *vi. & vt. & n.* 漫步、遊走。roam about ...；近義 wander / rove。

title: adapt
content: adapt (oneself) to + N/V-ing = accustom oneself to／get accustomed to／get used to／adjust to + N/V-ing；be adapted from ...。

title: in the near future
content: 最近的未來；在不久後的未來。

title: convince sb to + V
content: 說服某人做……；= persuade sb to + V。

title: furnish sb with sth
content: furnish sb with sth＝provide sb with sth：提供某人某物。

title: have an eye for + N
content: 表示「對……有眼光、鑑賞力」。例：Tina has an eye for color and interior design.

title: play football
content: 打美式橄欖球（美）；踢足球（英）

title: a flight from A to B
content: 從 A 飛往 B 的航班。例：Our flight from Taipei to Seoul leaves at noon.

title: radiate from ...
content: *vt. & vi.* 放射；散發、流露；形容詞 radiant 光芒四射的、容光煥發的；名詞 radiation。radiate from ...；give off ...；be radiant with ...。

title: be out of order
content: （機器）故障。例：The telephone is out of order again!（這電話又壞了。）

title: It is said that + 子句
content: 被動句型，表示「據說……」。例：It is said that the castle is over five hundred years old.

title: neither A nor B 的動詞
content: 連接主詞時，動詞按最接近的主詞作變化。

title: be afraid of... = be scared of...
be free to V
content: 自由做……；有空做……。例：When you've finished this task, you're free to go.（你做完這份工作後，就可以離開了。）

title: would like to V = feel like + V-ing
be good at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「擅長……」；接動作時使用 V-ing。例：My sister is good at solving logic puzzles.

title: look for work = look for a job
except for...
content: 除……之外。例：No one can do it except for Peter.（除了彼得以外，沒有人能做這件事。）

title: breeding / replica
content: *vi. & vt.* 生殖、繁殖；複製、翻印。reproduce oneself；相關 produce / breed / procreate；名詞 reproduction / production，近義 breeding / replica。

title: not one's cup of tea
content: 表示「不是某人喜歡或擅長的事物」。例：Camping in heavy rain isn't my cup of tea.

title: the Taiwan / Formosa Strait
content: 片 (1) the Taiwan / Formosa Strait 臺灣海峽

title: go for a run
content: 去跑步。例：I'm going for a run after work.（我下班後要去跑步。）

title: call sth off
content: 取消某事。例：They called off the picnic because of the storm.

title: have difficulty (in) + V-ing = have trouble + V-ing
as far as sb can remember / tell...
content: 就某人能記得／理解的，……。例：As far as I can remember, Joan wasn't at the party.（就我能記得的，瓊安不在派對上。）

title: sue
content: sue sb for sth；sue for sth。

title: lay / put / place stress on...
content: 強調……（＝ lay / put / place emphasis on...）。

title: dismiss
content: dismiss A as B；dismiss sb from his / her job。

title: by mail
content: 藉由書信，用郵件的方式。

title: fail to + V
content: 表示「未能做成……」。例：Ryan failed to submit the form before noon.

title: 數字-year-old
content: 可表「若干歲的」，此為形容詞，須置名詞前，year 不加 s，如 a two-year-old girl。

title: be / get caught in a trap
content: 落入了陷阱中；困在陷阱中。

title: a call for help
content: 求救聲或求援。例：We heard a call for help from the riverbank.

title: condense A into B
content: vt. 濃縮、縮短；片：condense A into B；衍：condensation

title: make an error ＝ make a mistake
Trick or treat.
content: 不給糖就搗蛋。（萬聖夜兒童用語）

title: in that case / just in case
content: in that case 是既然如此；just in case 是以防萬一。例：It may rain; in that case, take this umbrella just in case.

title: give A B's congratulations
content: 代 B 向 A 道賀。

title: in the short term / run ＝ in the long term / run
content: 短期來看； 從長遠來看

title: be on display
content: 表示「正在展出、供人參觀」。例：Several student paintings are on display in the library.

title: at most
content: 至多、不超過。例：The repair will take two hours at most.

title: time sth to V
content: 安排某事在適當時間發生，以便達成目的。例：We timed our arrival to avoid the afternoon traffic.

title: turn on / off the television
content: 表示「打開／關掉電視機」。例：Please turn off the television before leaving.

title: clear conscience
content: with a clear conscience：問心無愧。

title: get used to + N/V-ing ＝ get accustomed to + N/V-ing
one...the other...
content: 談論確定的兩個人或事物時，表示「一個……，另一個……」。例：I bought two notebooks; one is blue, and the other is green.

title: cover for sb
content: 替某人代班。例：Rita covered for me while I went to the dentist.（我去看牙醫時，瑞塔幫我代班。）

title: box up + 事物
content: 作動詞表示「把……裝箱」。例：We boxed up the books before moving.

title: in bed 與 on the bed
content: 皆表「在床上」；in bed 指在床上蓋著毛毯、棉被，on the bed 則是沒有蓋毛毯、棉被。

title: jolly ... along
content: *a./adv./vt./n.* 快樂的／很、非常／使高興或勸說／歡樂活動；jolly ... along。joyous（事物、事件歡樂的）、joyful（人或心情喜悅的）、rejoice in/at sth。

title: no less than...
content: 至少……。例：No less than 9 students passed the exam.（至少有 9 個學生通過這次的考試。）

title: despite 句型
content: despite + N/V-ing＝in spite of + N/V-ing＝notwithstanding + N/V-ing；despite the fact that …。

title: between A and B / in between
content: between A and B 表兩者之間；in between 可單獨表示在中間。例：The pharmacy is between the bank and the café.

title: be interested in + N/V-ing
content: 對……感興趣。例：I'm interested in the magazine you're reading.（我對你在看的那本雜誌有興趣。）

title: a summer / winter wardrobe
content: 片 a summer / winter wardrobe 夏季／冬季衣物

title: inquire into = look into
content: *vt./vi.* 詢問：inquire about；inquire + 疑問詞子句；inquire into = look into 調查；inquire after sb's health。inquiry 詢問、調查；inquisitive 愛打聽的、好奇心重的。

title: take action
content: 採取行動。例：Let's take action before it is too late.（我們採取行動以免太遲。）

title: hit the road
content: 口語表示「上路、出發」。例：We should hit the road before traffic gets heavy.

title: draw back the curtains = open the curtains
have a physical checkup
content: 做身體檢查；= have a physical。

title: a special advisory committee
content: a special advisory committee 特別顧問委員會；a heavy rain advisory 大雨特報

title: identify with...
content: 對……感同身受；對……產生認同感。

title: ride a bicycle / by bicycle
content: ride a bicycle 表示騎乘動作；by bicycle 表示交通方式，前面不用冠詞。例：She goes to work by bicycle.

title: bring sb sth = bring sth to sb
place too much reliance on sth
content: 片：place too much reliance on sth

title: put on a happy / sad / poker face
content: 表示「刻意露出某種表情」。例：Although Mia was disappointed, she put on a cheerful face for the children.

title: expose A to B
content: expose A to B：使 A 暴露於 B；使 A 接觸 B。

title: 表某人在校成績優良的說法
content: John does well in school. ＝ John's academic performance is good.（約翰在校成績優良。）

title: be out of step
content: be out of step：舞步不協調，步伐錯亂。

title: leave sb/sth + adj.
content: 使某人或某物處於某狀態。例：Please leave the window open for a while.

title: small 的延伸義
content: 除了尺寸小，也可表示「年幼的、不重要的、輕微的」。例：One small error changed the final result.

title: A be preceded by B
content: *vt.* 在⋯⋯之前。A be preceded by B；形容詞 preceding；名詞 precedent，set a precedent for ...；unprecedented 史無前例的。

title: tend sth
content: 照顧某物。同義：take care of sth。

title: be bad at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「不擅長……」。例：I'm bad at remembering people's names.

title: light sth up / light up sth
tell / read + 人 + a story
content: 表示「講／念故事給某人聽」。例：Dad reads the children a story every night.

title: genius
content: have a genius for ... = have a talent for ...；a man of genius。

title: an only child
content: 獨生子／女。例：Vincent loves being an only child.（文森喜歡當獨生子。）

title: green 作動詞
content: 表示使某地更綠、更環保。例：Volunteers planted native trees to green the school grounds.

title: judge A by / from B
content: 根據 B 來判斷 A。

title: call on sb
content: 拜訪某人。例：Perhaps I'll call on you tonight.（也許今晚我會去看你。）

title: spur sb on to V
content: 片：on the spur of the moment、spur sb on to V

title: be reflective of...
content: ：反光的；反映、表現…的；reflective clothing；be reflective of...＝reflect；reflect；reflection。

title: issue
content: take issue with sb over sth＝不同意；be at issue＝有爭議／意見不合；issue sth＝發行某物。

title: transform
content: transform A into B = convert / change / turn A into B。

title: zoom in / out (on...)
content: vi. 急速移動；調整焦距；片：zoom in / out (on...)

title: be a disgrace to
content: ：恥辱（不可數）；可恥事（恆單數）；使丟臉。bring disgrace on sb、in disgrace、be a disgrace to、disgrace oneself by V-ing；近 shame、disgraceful、shameful。

title: a bar/cake of soap
content: ：洗滌劑。laundry/dish detergent＝dishwashing liquid；a bar/cake of soap；stain。

title: rest in peace
content: 安息。例：May the dead rest in peace!（願該死者安息！）

title: beg for + N / beg + 人 + for + N
content: 表示「乞求、懇求得到……」。例：The child begged his father for one more story.

title: around the clock
content: 表示「日夜不停、全天二十四小時」。例：Doctors monitored the patient around the clock.

title: manage + N／manage to + V
content: manage 接名詞表示管理；manage to V 表示設法成功做到。例：She manages a small shop and manages to close it before seven every evening.

title: just 作形容詞
content: 表示公平、公正。例：Everyone deserves a just decision.

title: dictate to sb
content: ：口述；指定、規定。dictate a letter/memo to sb；dictate to sb；dictation、take dictation、at sb's dictation。

title: be at a loss
content: 茫然不知所措；不知如何是好。

title: inflict sth on sb
content: ：身體的；整個身體地。bodily harm；inflict sth on sb。

title: be radiant with ...
content: *vt. & vi.* 放射；散發、流露；形容詞 radiant 光芒四射的、容光煥發的；名詞 radiation。radiate from ...；give off ...；be radiant with ...。

title: search for + 人／事物
content: 表示「尋找……」。例：Volunteers searched for the missing hiker until midnight.

title: on the brink / edge of...
content: note：on the verge of... = on the brink / edge of...

title: a flight crew
content: a flight crew：全體機組人員。

title: press sb to V
content: 竭力勸說某人做……；逼某人做……。

title: view A as B ＝ regard A as B
It is rare (for sb/sth) to V
on sb's mind
content: 令某人煩惱／心繫。例：You don't look happy. What's on your mind?（你不太高興的樣子。什麼讓你煩心？）

title: pay a bill = foot a bill
and the like
content: 等等、諸如此類。例：The shop sells notebooks, pens, stickers, and the like.

title: career / occupation / profession / vacation
content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

title: dispose of ... = get rid of ...
content: *vi.* 處理。dispose of ... = get rid of ...；disposable 用完即丟棄的；名詞 disposal，at sb.’s disposal 任由某人支配；近義 removal。

title: oblige sb by + V-ing
content: *vt.* 迫使、使負有義務、施加恩惠：oblige sb to + V、oblige sb by + V-ing；obliged 感激的：be obliged to sb for sth；obligation 道德或法律上的義務、責任。

title: harden one's heart
content: ：（使）變硬；硬化。harden one's heart；反義 soften。

title: appreciate + N/V-ing = be thankful for sth = be grateful for sth
to one’s fury
content: *n.* 震怒。to one’s fury；形容詞 furious；近義 anger / rage。

title: have a nervous breakdown
content: ：（機器）故障；精神崩潰。源自 break down；have a nervous breakdown。

title: a parking lot
content: 停車場。例：They asked the government to build more parking lots for local people.（他們要求政府為當地居民多建一些停車場。）

title: relate to sb
content: 理解某人；與某人產生共鳴。

title: affiliate oneself with/to ...
content: *n./vt.* 附屬機構／使隸屬：affiliate organization、subsidiary、branch；affiliate oneself with/to ...。

title: daily task
content: 每日工作或日常任務。例：Checking customer messages is one of her daily tasks.

title: conclude A with B = end A with B = wind up A with B
content: 以 B 來結束 A。

title: be liberal (with sth)
content: （在某事物方面）很肆意；有大量的（某事物）。

title: vanilla ice cream
content: n. 香草；片：vanilla ice cream、vanilla extract

title: simultaneous interpretation
content: *a.* 同步的。simultaneous interpretation 同步口譯。

title: be reckoned to be...
content: 片：reckon (that)...、be reckoned to be...、What do you reckon?、reckon sth up

title: in a way / in some ways
content: in a way 是在某方面；in some ways 是在若干方面。例：In some ways, online classes are more flexible.

title: select A as B = A be selected as B
take sides (with...)
content: 表明支持（某一方）。例：George took sides with Linda in the argument.（喬治在這次爭論中支持琳達。）

title: number / numerous / numeral
content: *a.* 無數的。相關 number / numerous / numeral；近義 countless。

title: a power plant
content: 發電廠。例：We paid a visit to the power plant yesterday.（我們昨天去參觀發電廠。）

title: stray from / off the path
content: *vi.* 偏離原路、走失、入歧途；*a.* 走失的、散落的。a stray dog / cat；stray from / off the path。

title: right now
content: 可表示「現在、此刻」，也可表示「馬上、立刻」。例：I need to speak with you right now.

title: wear / have a beard；grow a beard；shave (off) a beard
content: 有鬍子；留鬍子；剃某人的鬍子。

title: stop to V 與 stop V-ing
content: stop to V 表示「停下原本的事，轉去做另一件事」；stop V-ing 表示「停止正在做的事」。例：We stopped to rest.／We stopped walking.

title: be possible (for sb) to V
content: （某人）做……是可能的。例：It's possible to order a copy of the book online.（從網路上訂一本這本書是可行的。）

title: to one's + 情緒名詞
content: 凡表情緒的名詞如 excitement、sorrow、delight、joy、disappointment、satisfaction 等，均可與介詞 to 並用；to one's + 情緒名詞，意為「令某人……的是」。

title: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
content: 困境中的朋友才是真正的朋友／患難見真情。——諺語

title: a channel of communication ＝ a communication channel
out of the blue
content: 出乎意料地、突然地。例：An old classmate called me out of the blue.

title: high 與 tall
content: high 常形容建築、位置或程度；tall 常形容人、樹木及直立物體的高度。例：The tower is very high, and the trees beside it are tall.

title: course 的不同義項
content: course 可指課程、路線、一道菜；作動詞可指液體快速流動。例：Tears coursed down her cheeks during the main course.

title: a mixture of A and B
income / revenue
content: *n.* （政府或個人的）開支、開銷。expenditure on ...；近義 expense / spending；反義 income / revenue。

title: electric shaver
content: ：電動刮鬍刀。＝electric shaver／electric razor；shave；對照非電動 razor。

title: a television program = a TV program
not to mention sth
content: 更不用說某事物；= not to mention the fact that...；= to say nothing of...；= not to speak of...

title: take sb to task for + V-ing
make friends (with sb)
content: （與某人）交朋友。例：Kevin makes friends very easily.（凱文很容易交朋友。）

title: a number of + 複數名詞
content: 幾個……，後使用複數形動詞。

title: listen to...
content: 聆聽／聽從……。例：I enjoy listening to music at night.（我喜歡在晚上聆聽音樂。）

title: an oil / watercolor painting
content: an oil / watercolor painting：油畫／水彩畫。

title: the moment + 子句
content: 表示「一……就……」，可放在主句前或後。例：The moment I heard the alarm, I left the building.

title: group … by …
content: 依某標準將事物分組。例：The teacher grouped the words by topic.

title: a sea cucumber
content: 片：be / remain as cool as a cucumber、a sea cucumber

title: 感官動詞＋形容詞（聞起來……）
content: smell 為感官動詞，後加形容詞表「聞起來……」；同類尚有 look（看起來）、sound（聽起來）、taste（嚐起來）、feel（感覺起來）。

title: know for certain / sure
content: 確知。例：Nobody knows for certain when Michael is coming back.（沒有人確知邁可什麼時候會回來。）

title: try to V
content: 設法／試圖做……。例：I know you're busy, but try to come.（我知道你很忙，但試著來看看。）

title: be beyond one's control
content: 超過某人能控制的範圍

title: It was a shock to find / discover that...
every now and then
content: 偶爾、間或。例：I enjoy a sweet drink every now and then.

title: run out of sth
content: 用盡某物。例：Our car was running out of gas.（我們的車子快沒汽油了。）

title: as a result of... ＝ because of...
believe (that)...
content: 相信／認為……。例：Do you believe that he is telling the truth?（你相信他在說實話嗎？）

title: shift 搭配
content: shift A to B；shift one’s attention from A to B＝change one’s attention from A to B；work on the day / night shift。

title: at will
content: 隨意地、任意地。例：Members may enter the reading room at will.

title: call sb (up) / give sb a call
content: 打電話給某人。例：Give me a call when you reach the station.

title: look for work / look for a job
content: 找工作。例：He moved to the city to look for work.

title: one of the benefits of + N/V-ing
content: ……的好處之一；後面的主要動詞通常配合 one 使用單數。例：One of the benefits of walking is better sleep.

title: disgrace oneself by V-ing
content: ：恥辱（不可數）；可恥事（恆單數）；使丟臉。bring disgrace on sb、in disgrace、be a disgrace to、disgrace oneself by V-ing；近 shame、disgraceful、shameful。

title: illustration 搭配
content: an illustration magazine：插畫雜誌；illustration art：插畫藝術。

title: least 的冠詞
content: 作形容詞表「最少的」時前加 the；作最高級副詞表「最少地」修飾副詞、動詞時不一定加 the；修飾名詞時須加 the。

title: a piece of...
content: trash / garbage / rubbish / litter 皆表「垃圾」且均為不可數；表一件／個垃圾須用 。

title: have difficulty + V-ing
content: 做某事有困難；difficulty 後接動名詞。例：She had difficulty understanding the instructions.

title: whether... or...
content: 不論……還是……。例：I don't mind whether we go to France or Spain.（不論我們去法國或西班牙，我都不介意。）

title: make sure (that)...
content: 確定／確保……。例：You'd better make sure (that) all the answers are correct.（你最好確認所有答案都是正確的。）

title: keep／stay in touch with + 人
content: 與某人保持聯絡。例：I still keep in touch with my elementary school teacher.

title: a damsel in distress
content: *n.* 痛苦、危難（不可數）；*vt.* 使極痛苦、悲傷。be in distress；a damsel in distress；形容詞 distressed。

title: give sb a dirty look
content: 給某人白眼；瞪某人一眼。

title: place an order (for sth)
content: 下訂單。例：Dad placed an order for two sandwiches online.

title: be sensitive to / about sth
content: 對某事物很敏感，很容易因某事物而被冒犯。

title: be on holiday（英）= be on vacation（美）
a pair of sneakers
content: n. 運動鞋；片：a pair of sneakers

title: revolt against
content: vi. / n. 造反、反感；片：revolt against、be in revolt against；詞族：revolution、rebel

title: be in bad / low spirits ＝ be in a bad mood
like a lamb to the slaughter
take advantage of
content: ：馬具、挽具、登山安全帶；利用。make use of＝take advantage of；harness the power of ...。

title: the number of 與 a number of
content: the number of + 複數名詞接單數動詞；a number of + 複數名詞接複數動詞。例：The number of visitors is rising, and a number of shops are expanding.

title: a sort / type / kind of...；all sorts / types / kinds of...
a shopping center
content: 購物中心。例：The shopping center is going to open next month.（這個購物中心將於下個月開幕。）

title: a knife and fork
content: 一副刀叉（fork 前面不加 a）。

title: fail in one's attempt to V
keep + adj. / keep (on) V-ing
content: keep + adj. 表保持狀態；keep (on) V-ing 表繼續做。例：Keep calm and keep trying.

title: want 不使用進行式
content: 應說 I want this hat，不說 I am wanting this hat。

title: counter
content: over the counter；counter with ...；run counter to ...。

title: get off to a good / poor start
content: 有好／不順利的開端。例：The team got off to a good start with an early goal.

title: direct sb to + 地方
content: 指引／告訴某人去某地的路

title: at least
content: 至少。例：Please read at least ten pages tonight.

title: along with...
content: 和……一起；還有……。例：My camera was stolen, along with my cellphone.（我的相機連同手機一起被偷了。）

title: a solution to + N
content: ……的解決方法；介系詞通常用 to。例：We need a practical solution to the traffic problem.

title: get + 人／事物 + 形容詞
content: 表示「使某人或某物進入某種狀態」。例：The long delay got everyone worried.

title: as + adj./adv. + as + N
content: 和……一樣……（第一個 as 為副詞，第二個 as 為連接詞）。例：You are as smart as a genius.（你像天才一樣聰明。）

title: once 表示「一次」
content: 表示次數。例：I have visited that museum only once.

title: dwell in ... = reside in ...
content: *vi.* 居住；dwell–dwelt/dwelled–dwelt/dwelled：dwell in ... = reside in ...、dwell on ...；dwelling 住所。

title: obey the law ＝ abide by the law ＝ comply with the law ＝ conform to / with the law
sound + adj.
content: 聽起來……。例：Your idea sounds good to me.（我覺得你的想法聽起來很好。）

title: hand down + 事物 / hand + 事物 + down
content: 表示「將物品、故事或傳統傳給下一代」。例：The recipe has been handed down through the family.

title: in the wilds (of + 地方)
content: in the wilds (of + 地方)：在某地的偏遠地區。

title: war vs. battle
content: war 指全面的「戰爭」，battle 指戰爭中一場一場的「戰役」。

title: burst out laughing / burst into laughter
content: 表示「突然大笑起來」。例：Everyone burst out laughing when the dog stole the hat.

title: be in the process of + N/V-ing
S + V, only to + V
content: 表示後來發生出乎意料、往往令人失望的結果，不表示目的。例：We hurried to the station, only to discover that the train had left.

title: meditate on / upon sth
content: vi. 冥想；片：meditate on / upon sth

title: disappoint sb
content: 使某人失望；= let sb down。

title: go down a slide
content: go down a slide：玩溜滑梯。

title: a university student = a college student
It is kind of sb to V
chair a meeting
content: chair 作動詞表示「主持會議」。例：Ms. Lin will chair tomorrow's committee meeting.

title: instruct 句型
content: instruct sb in …：教導某人學習…；instruct sb to V：指示某人做…。

title: neither A nor B
content: 既不是 A 也不是 B。

title: the calm before the storm
content: the calm before the storm：暴風雨前的寧靜。

title: take / catch hold of
content: 抓住。例：She took hold of the railing before stepping down.

title: take part in
content: 參加，相當於 participate in。例：More than fifty students took part in the contest.

title: be destined to V
content: 片：be destined to V、be destined / bound for...

title: entertainment
content: entertain sb with sth；find entertainment in ... = find fun in ...。

title: strike up a conversation with sb
neither of + 複數可數名詞
content: ……兩者皆不；原書註：作主詞時其後接單、複數動詞皆可。

title: once and for all
content: 斷然地，最後一次地。例：John has quit smoking once and for all.（約翰徹底戒菸了。）

title: while away + 時間
content: 消磨時間。例：We whiled away the rainy afternoon with board games.

title: be liable to + N/V-ing
content: ：有…傾向的；可能…的。be liable to + N/V-ing＝be prone to + N/V-ing。

title: restore
content: restore one's health；restore A to B。

title: go well / badly
content: 表示事情「進行順利／不順利」。例：The presentation went better than we expected.

title: sb's point of view
content: 某人的觀點。例：I'm just trying to explain my point of view.（我正試著解釋我的看法。）

title: head for / toward + 地方
content: 此處 head 作動詞，表示「朝……前進」。例：Dark clouds appeared, so we headed for home.

title: stop to V
content: 停下原本的動作並開始做……。

title: a definitive answer
content: a definitive answer 明確的答覆；the definitive collection 最具權威的作品集

title: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
content: 一盎司的預防等於一磅的治療／預防勝於治療。

title: few 作形容詞
content: 表「很少的」時，其後接複數名詞。

title: the nature of sth
content: 某事物的本質／性質。例：Elaine explained the nature of this material.（伊蓮解釋了這個材料的性質。）

title: teach + 人 + about + 事物
content: 表示「教某人有關……的知識」。例：The guide taught us about the history of the temple.

title: change hands
content: 易手、轉由另一位擁有者持有。例：The old house has changed hands several times.

title: a forest fire
content: 森林火災。例：A forest fire broke out last night.（昨晚發生了一場森林火災。）

title: by the name of...
content: 名叫……。例：I met a guy by the name of John Smith.（我遇到一位名叫約翰·史密斯的人。）

title: do sb/sth justice = do justice to sb/sth
content: 為某人／事說公道話；公平對待某人／合理處理某事。

title: a pair of + 複數名詞
Under no circumstances + 倒裝句
content: 絕不……；= By no means / In no way / On no account + 倒裝句。

title: a loan shark
content: a loan shark：放高利貸的人。

title: set a goal / set high goals
content: 表示「設定目標」。例：I set a goal of reading two English books this month.

title: color 作動詞
content: color 可表示「替……上色／染色」，也可表示某物變色。例：The children colored the map blue and green.

title: promise to V = make a promise to V
exert A on B
content: *vt.* 施加（影響、壓力）；盡力：exert A on B、exert oneself；exertion 施加、盡力。

title: a bunch of bananas
content: 表示「一串香蕉」。例：Dad bought a bunch of bananas at the market.

title: a sense of achievement
content: 表示「成就感」。例：Finishing the difficult project gave Leo a strong sense of achievement.

title: slow down
content: 減速；放慢速度或步調。例：You should slow down when driving through the village.

title: neither... nor...
content: 既不……也不……；連接對等單字或片語，若連接主詞時，動詞按第 2 個主詞作變化。

title: use A as B
content: 把 A 當作 B 使用。例：They use the spare room as a study.

title: across from...
content: 在……對面。例：I live in a building across from the post office.（我住在郵局對面的一棟大樓裡。）

title: legend
content: Legend has it that ...；Rumor has it that ... = Word has it that ... = It is said that ...。

title: mean a lot / nothing to sb
content: 對某人意義重大／毫無意義。

title: loyal
content: be loyal to sb = be devoted / faithful / true to sb；be faithful to sth。

title: to put it simply ＝ simply put
throw sth at sb
content: 朝某人丟某物（有傷害意味）。例：Sam threw a stone at me.（山姆朝我扔石頭。）

title: shuffle the cards
content: *vi.* 拖著腳走；*vi. & vt.* 坐立不安；洗（牌）。shuffle one’s feet；shuffle the cards。

title: be on the market
content: 上市。例：This new product will soon be on the market.（這個新產品很快就會上市。）

title: be rich in... = be high in...
knock sb out / knock out sb
next of kin
content: n. 親屬；a. 相似的；片：next of kin、be kin to...

title: in case of + N
content: 萬一……。＝ in the event of + N。例：In case of emergency, call this number.（萬一有緊急事件，請打這個號碼。）

title: throw sth to sb
content: 扔某物給某人（使某人接住）（＝ throw sb sth）。例：The bride threw the bouquet to her bridesmaids.（新娘把花束丟給她的伴娘們。）

title: a couch potato
content: 成天坐在沙發上看電視的人。

title: die of / from...
content: 死於（事故或疾病等）。例：The girl died from head injuries.（這女孩死於腦部創傷。）

title: till 與 until 用法相同
content: 但 till 較常用於口語中。

title: watch out
content: 留神，注意。例：Watch out! That car almost hit you.（小心！那輛車差點撞到你。）

title: have a physical examination = have a physical checkup
for some reason / for no reason
content: 分別表示「不知何故／無緣無故」。例：For some reason, my phone won't connect to the network.

title: rap sb for sth
content: ：饒舌樂；敲擊；批評、責備。rap music、rap on/at ...、rap sb for sth；rapper。

title: drug rehabilitation center
content: ：使（病人、罪犯等）重新過上正常生活。rehabilitation、drug rehabilitation center。

title: priority
content: one's top / first priority；A have / take priority over B。

title: differ from
content: differ from …；書列同義表達：vary from person to person。

title: in an orderly fashion/way
content: ：整齊的、有秩序的；（醫院）勤雜員；orderlies；in an orderly fashion/way；order；disorderly；proceed to。

title: think twice before + V-ing
content: 做某事前再三考慮。例：Think twice before sharing personal information online.

title: a pay raise
content: 加薪。例：Ted would like to ask for a pay raise.（泰德想要求加薪。）

title: bring a blaze under control
content: ：熊熊燃燒；大火；flame；bring a blaze under control；retrieve；portrait。

title: utter a sigh
content: *a.* 完全的；*vt.* 說、發出。not utter a word；utter a sigh；副詞 utterly；近義 complete / completely / entirely / totally。

title: be positive that... = be sure that...
each and every
content: 每一個的（用於加強語氣）。

title: assume the burden of...
content: 挑起……的重擔；＝ shoulder the burden of...。

title: provide sb with sth ＝ provide sth for sb
a sheet of paper = a piece of paper
talk on the telephone = talk on the phone
lead an active life
content: 過著很忙碌活躍的生活。

title: yet 作副詞的句型限制
content: yet 作副詞，表『還，尚未』時，須用於否定句或疑問句。例：Chris hasn't shown up yet.（克里斯還未現身。）

title: gaze / stare / look out of a window
whether 與 if 的用法差異
content: whether 表『是否』時，其後可引導名詞子句，或接不定詞片語，若接不定詞片語，則此時不能以 if 代替 whether。

title: a shred of ...
content: ：碎片；切成碎片／細條。a shred of ...；shredder。

title: come to V
content: 表示「過來做某事」，to 後接原形動詞。例：Nora came to help us prepare the room.

title: polish
content: polish (up) ... = improve ...；polish off ...；give sth a polish；nail polish。

title: rooster 與 cock
content: 原書註：cock 在俚語中表示「男性生殖器」，故較常用 rooster 表「公雞」。

title: focus on + N/V-ing
content: 專注於……；著重於……。例：The course focuses on improving speaking skills.

title: enjoy 的受詞形式
content: enjoy 之後接名詞或動名詞作受詞。

title: be characterized as
content: be characterized as …：被描述有…的特徵。

title: for the time being
content: 暫時、目前先如此。例：The library is closed, so we’ll study at home for the time being.

title: It is hard to V
content: 表示「做……很困難」。例：It is hard to concentrate when the room is noisy.

title: shelter 句型
content: take shelter：避難、尋求遮蔽物；shelter A from B：保護 A 使免於 B 的侵襲。

title: be known for + 特點／事物
content: 因某項特色而聞名。例：The restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.

title: stay behind
content: 留下來。例：Maureen stayed behind to help clean up.（莫琳留下來幫忙清理。）

title: in vain
content: 片 in vain 白費功夫 ＝ to no avail ＝ to no purpose

title: be consistent with...
content: 與……一致／沒有矛盾；= be in accord with...；= correspond with...。

title: dispute
content: be in dispute with sb；It is beyond dispute that ...；dispute about / over ...。

title: rely on ...
content: *a.* 依賴的：A be reliant on B；rely on ... 依賴。

title: offer sb sth ＝ offer sth to sb
數字 + hundred / hundreds of + N
content: 前面有明確數字時 hundred 不加 s；表示概數時用 hundreds of。例：Three hundred guests attended, and hundreds of others watched online.

title: break into a gallop
content: *vi. & n.* （馬的）奔馳。break into a gallop。

title: smooth out...
content: 把（衣服或紙張等的皺摺）用平。

title: It is likely that... ＝ S + be likely to V
appoint 句型
content: appoint sb to + V＝assign sb to + V：指定某人做事；appoint sb as + 職位＝assign sb (to be) + 職位：指定某人擔任…職位。

title: would like to + V
content: 禮貌表達「想要做……」，後面接原形動詞。例：We would like to reserve a table for four.

title: still 表「還」的位置
content: 僅用於肯定句；一般動詞時置一般動詞前，be 動詞時置 be 動詞後。

title: vessel
content: Empty vessels make the most sound.

title: by chance
content: 偶然間。例：I found the secret by chance.（我偶然間發現這個祕密。）

title: raise/boost/improve morale
content: ：士氣（不可數）。low/high morale；raise/boost/improve morale；易混 moral。

title: give + 地方 + a quick sweep
content: give + 地方 + a quick sweep：快速打掃某地方。

title: fire a shot at sth
content: 朝……開槍。例：The hunter fired a shot at a tiger.（獵人朝著老虎開了一槍。）

title: take out/cancel/renew a subscription
content: ：訂閱。subscribe to sth；subscription；take out/cancel/renew a subscription。

title: suffer from+疾病／痛苦
content: 受……之苦；遭受（疾病）。例：Jamie suffers from headaches.（Jamie 深受頭痛之苦。）

title: rap music
content: ：饒舌樂；敲擊；批評、責備。rap music、rap on/at ...、rap sb for sth；rapper。

title: lately／recently 的時態限制
content: lately 與 recently 須與現在完成式或現在完成進行式並用。

title: stay / keep fit
content: stay / keep fit = stay healthy：保持健康。

title: the disabled
content: disabled a. 殘障的；片：the disabled

title: dozen 用法
content: dozen 作「一打」解時，單複數同形；作「許多」解時，恆用複數 dozens。

title: bodily harm
content: ：身體的；整個身體地。bodily harm；inflict sth on sb。

title: found + 組織／公司／機構
content: 此處是「創立、建立」，過去式和過去分詞都是 founded；不要和 find 的過去式 found 混淆。例：The sisters founded a small design studio together.

title: take a leaf out of sb's book
content: 效法某人；以某人為榜樣

title: be located in / on / at...
content: 位於……。同義句型：be situated in / on / at...；lie in / on / at...。

title: code 搭配
content: break a code：破解密碼；a dress code：服裝規定。

title: swim against the tide
content: swim against the tide：不順應潮流。

title: be on the right / left wing of...
synonymous / antonymous
content: n. 同義字／反義字；詞族：synonymous / antonymous

title: take on responsibility
content: 表示「承擔責任」。例：Eric is ready to take on more responsibility at work.

title: to one's anger
content: to one's anger：令某人生氣的是。

title: chase (after) sb
content: chase (after) sb：追趕某人；追求某人。

title: walk sb home
content: 陪某人走回家。例：Please let me walk you home.（請讓我陪你走路回家。）

title: vanity 辨析
content: 比較 a brand-name shirt 有牌子的襯衫（未必是名牌）

title: sound like + N
content: 聽起來像……。例：That sounds like a good idea!（那聽起來是個好主意！）

title: be in a bad mood
content: 表示「心情不好」。例：Dad was in a bad mood after losing his keys.

title: introduce A to B
content: 把 A 介紹給 B，向 B 介紹 A。

title: (be) wrong with sth
content: 某物出問題／故障。例：There's something wrong with Becky's phone.（貝琪的電話出了點問題。）

title: a method for + N/V-ing
content: 做某事的方法；for 後接名詞或動名詞。例：The teacher introduced a new method for remembering vocabulary.

title: take + 事物 + to heart
content: 表示「認真接受忠告」或「因別人的話而介意」。例：Mia took her coach's advice to heart and practiced harder.

title: step on someone's toes
content: 字面是「踩到某人的腳趾」；也可比喻「冒犯某人或干涉其職責」。例：I don't want to step on anyone's toes by changing the plan.

title: be under warranty/guarantee
content: ：逮捕令；搜索令。arrest/search warrant；warranty＝保證書／保固，be under warranty/guarantee。

title: set an alarm for + 時間
content: 表示「把鬧鐘設定在某個時間」。例：I set an alarm for six thirty tomorrow morning.

title: make a division of sth into...
on the border of A and B
content: 在 A 和 B 的交界處

title: have a hot temper
content: 表示「脾氣暴躁、容易生氣」。例：Although he has a hot temper, he calms down quickly.

title: a hearty breakfast
content: 片：give sb a hearty welcome、a hearty breakfast

title: maiden voyage/flight
content: ：少女；（航行／飛行）初次。maiden voyage/flight、maiden name。

title: on account of... = because of... = due to... = owing to...
break / come out in a rash
content: *n.* 疹子；*a.* 草率的。break / come out in a rash；a rash decision；近義 hasty。

title: keep track of + N
content: 表示「持續掌握、記錄……」。例：This app helps me keep track of my study time.

title: be curious about + N / wh-子句
content: 表示「對……感到好奇」。例：The children were curious about how the robot worked.

title: be tired of + N/V-ing
content: ：令人厭倦的。tired、tire；近 boring、weary；be weary of + N/V-ing＝be tired of + N/V-ing。

title: leave / let sb alone
content: leave / let sb alone：不要管某人。

title: well 的詞性
content: 副詞表示做得好；形容詞表示身體健康；名詞可指井。例：She sings well but doesn’t feel well today.

title: at sb's command
content: 聽某人的命令；可運用自如，可支配

title: keep one's head
content: 表示「保持冷靜」。例：Try to keep your head if something goes wrong.

title: replace A with B
content: 以 B 取代 A，把 A 換成 B。

title: interpret A as B
content: interpret A as B：將 A 詮釋為 B。

title: lend sth to sb = lend sb sth
run into...（撞上人／物）
content: 撞上……。書頁「run into... 與……不期而遇；撞上……」的後半義。既有列 126 只涵蓋「偶遇」義

title: have a … feel to it
content: 帶有某種感覺或氛圍。例：The small café has a warm, old-fashioned feel to it.

title: a prohibition on/against sth
content: ：禁令。lift a prohibition；a prohibition on/against sth＝a ban on sth；動詞 prohibit。

title: pound／lb 複數
content: pound sterling 的複數為 pounds sterling；lb 的複數為 lb / lbs。

title: dwarfs / dwarves
content: *n.* 侏儒；*vt.* 使顯得矮小。複數 dwarfs / dwarves。

title: be cynical about...
content: a. 憤世嫉俗的；片：be cynical about...；衍：cynicism

title: between vs among
content: between 用於兩者之間；among 用於三者以上之間。

title: wear a smile / have a smile on one's face
content: 表示「面帶微笑」。例：Ella had a proud smile on her face after the performance.

title: play a(n) + adj. + role in + N/V-ing
content: 在……中扮演某種角色；in 後接名詞或動名詞。例：Exercise plays an important role in keeping the heart healthy.

title: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
content: 只知工作不玩樂，聰明孩子也變傻。

title: reach a new high
content: 表示數量、價格或程度「創新高」。例：Ticket sales reached a new high this month.

title: feel like + V-ing = would like to V = want to V
earn one’s keep
content: 賺取生活費、靠工作養活自己。例：He worked weekends to earn his keep.

title: by no means = not...by any means
Halley’s Comet
content: *n.* 彗星。Halley’s Comet；相關 a shooting star / meteor。

title: spin a coin
content: 旋轉硬幣（用於猜測哪一面朝上）

title: take back + N / take + N + back
content: 表示「拿回、送回」。受詞是代名詞時放中間：take it back。例：She took the damaged lamp back to the shop.

title: come out of the closet
content: *a. & n.* 快樂的；男同性戀的／男同性戀。歡樂義現多用 happy / merry；come out of the closet 出櫃。

title: play a part / role in
content: 在……中扮演角色、發揮作用。例：Sleep plays an important part in learning.

title: question 作動詞
content: 可表示盤問，也可表示質疑。例：The reporter questioned whether the plan was realistic.

title: pace 搭配
content: keep pace with …＝keep abreast of …＝keep up with …；pace the floor：在地板上來回踱步。

title: fortify oneself (against A) with B
content: ：加強。fortify oneself (against A) with B；fort；近 strengthen、reinforce。

title: on the verge of...
content: note：on the verge of... = on the brink / edge of...

title: be used to + N/V-ing ＝ be accustomed to + N/V-ing
site 搭配
content: at the site of …；a construction site＝a building site。

title: a large volume of + 不可數名詞
content: 大量的……。同義說法：a large amount of + 不可數名詞。

title: It is important (for sb) to V
thug / hooligan / hoodlum
content: *n.* 幫派分子；近義 thug / hooligan / hoodlum。

title: be consequent on...
content: 因……而起的；= be caused by...。

title: sooner or later
content: 遲早（＝ eventually）。例：If you don't listen, you'll be sorry sooner or later.（你要是不聽的話，遲早會後悔的。）

title: for fear of + N/V-ing = for fear that...
center on...
content: 集中於……。＝ focus on...。例：Much of the debate centered on privacy issues.（大部分的辯論都集中於隱私權議題。）

title: be in dire / difficult straits
content: 片 (2) be in dire / difficult straits（錢財方面）很窘迫

title: none of + 複數可數名詞
content: 沒有一個……；原書註：作主詞時，其後接單、複數動詞皆可。

title: from coast to coast
content: 從此岸到彼岸；全國各地。

title: It is customary (for sb) to + V
content: ：按慣例的、習俗的、慣常的；It is customary (for sb) to + V；custom；usual；bellboy。

title: define A as B
content: define A as B：將 A 定義為 B。

title: knock on / answer the door
content: 分別表示「敲門／去應門」。例：Someone knocked on the door, but nobody answered it.

title: encounter 搭配
content: encounter a problem：遭遇到問題；bump / run into sb：與某（認識的）人不期而遇。

title: identify A with B
content: 將 A 與 B 視為相等。

title: when 子句的被動簡化
content: 副詞子句為被動語態時，可省略重複主詞及 be 動詞，保留過去分詞。例：When asked about the mistake, he apologized immediately.

title: limit A to B
content: 將 A 限制於 B

title: contagious / epidemic
content: *a.* 傳染的。相關 infection / infect；近義 contagious / epidemic。

title: tell a lie
content: 說謊。例：Jason was accused of telling a lie.（傑森被指責說謊。）

title: a rubber band = an elastic band
take / do the minutes
content: 表示「做會議紀錄」。例：Karen volunteered to take the minutes at today's meeting.

title: think that / think about / think of
content: think that 後接看法；think about 表仔細考慮；think of 可指想到或對……有何看法。例：Think about the choices before you decide.

title: Money doesn’t grow on trees.
content: 錢得來不易；提醒人不要任意浪費。例：Think before buying another game—money doesn’t grow on trees.

title: in view of sth
content: 因為某事物，考慮到某事物

title: forward a letter / an email to sb
content: 將信／電子郵件轉寄給某人。

title: have a vocation for ...
content: *n.* 職業、使命。have a vocation for ...；相關 career / occupation / profession / vacation；形容詞 vocational，vocational education / training。

title: It is wrong (of sb) to V
content: （某人）做……是不對的。例：It's wrong to take something that isn't yours.（拿別人的東西是不對的。）

title: lie in...
content: 在於……。例：My hometown lies on the west coast of Norway.（我的家鄉位於挪威的西海岸。）

title: stand in the / one's way
content: 擋住某人去路；阻礙某人。

title: 課本例句
content: The study emphasizes the importance of a balanced diet.

title: as + 子句：當……時
content: 作連接詞，表示兩件事同時發生。例：As the sun went down, the air became cooler.

title: defend sb/sth against...
content: 保護某人／某事物免受……；為……替某人／某事物做辯護。

title: inhabit + place
content: ：居住於；棲息於。inhabit + place＝live/dwell/reside in/at；inhabitant、resident、dweller、habitat；a city of + 數字 + inhabitants。

title: make an appointment
content: make an appointment with sb：與某人約會。

title: guilt
content: a sense of guilt；be guilty of ...；be innocent of ...。

title: then 作形容詞
content: 放在名詞前表示「當時的」。例：The then principal introduced the new library plan.

title: a big day / decision
content: big 可表示「重要、影響重大」，不只是尺寸大。例：Choosing a university is a big decision.

title: have one's mind set on + N/V-ing
content: 心意已決要做……。例：Sophie has her mind set on becoming an actress.（蘇菲決心要成為一名演員。）

title: burst out crying / laughing = burst into tears / laughter
anger / rage
content: *n.* 震怒。to one’s fury；形容詞 furious；近義 anger / rage。

title: a rearview / side mirror
content: 後視鏡／（車兩側其中一面的）後視鏡。

title: nag at sb
content: 片：nag sb to V、nag sb about sth、nag at sb

title: What do you reckon?
content: 片：reckon (that)...、be reckoned to be...、What do you reckon?、reckon sth up

title: turn on / off the television = turn on / off the TV
cause sb to V = make sb + V
To make a long story short,...
except 須與 all-/any-/every-/no- 開頭的字並用
content: 例：No one can do it except Peter.；Everyone except Lisa will stay home.

title: in a second = in a moment
smell a rat
content: 覺得很可疑，察覺事有蹊蹺。

title: cut / skip class
content: 蹺課。例：Joe never skips class.（喬從不蹺課。）

title: downward(s) / upward(s)
content: *a.* 往下／往上的；副詞 downward(s) / upward(s)；互為反義。

title: supply sb with sth ＝ supply sth to sb
set off a firecracker
content: ：鞭炮（可數）。set off a firecracker；firework(s)、set off fireworks。

title: without sb's permission
content: 未經某人的允許。同義說法：without sb's consent／agreement（未經某人的同意）。

title: secure 搭配
content: secure a contract / job：取得一份合約／工作；be secure against / from …：安全免於…。

title: satisfaction 搭配
content: a sense of satisfaction：滿足感；to one’s satisfaction, …：令某人滿意的是…。

title: manage + 金錢／組織／工作
content: 表示「管理、經營或妥善處理」。例：Learning to manage your time can reduce stress.

title: carry out...
content: 執行……。書頁列為 perform 的類義說法，但為多詞片語，不作關聯詞端點。

title: old / elderly / former / previous
content: old 可指年老或使用已久；elderly 專指年長者；former 指以前的身分；previous 指時間或順序上的前一個。例：I met a former teacher at my previous workplace.

title: project A onto B
content: 把 A 投射／放映到 B。

title: heavy / light / pouring rain
content: 分別表示「大雨／小雨／傾盆大雨」。例：We waited inside until the pouring rain stopped.

title: make / drive + 人 + crazy
content: 表示「把某人逼瘋、使某人非常惱怒」。例：That repeated buzzing sound is driving me crazy.

title: want to V / want + 人 + to V
content: 分別表示「想做……／想要某人做……」。例：I want you to check this answer again.

title: go bad
content: 表示食物「腐壞、變質」。例：The yogurt will go bad if it isn't refrigerated.

title: bow to... = yield to... = surrender to...
content: 「屈服於……」三種說法同義（Never bow/yield/surrender to terrorism.）。

title: pen + 信件／文章／詩
content: pen 作動詞是較正式或文學性的「撰寫」。例：The singer penned several songs for the new album.

title: wish + that 子句（假設語氣）
content: 與現在事實相反時，that 子句使用過去式；與過去事實相反時，that 子句使用過去完成式。例：I wish that my friend were here now.（但願我的朋友此刻在這裡。）／I wish that John had been with us last night.（要是約翰昨晚與我們在一起就好了。）

title: in one's head
content: 表示「在某人的腦中、心裡」。例：I kept repeating the address in my head.

title: a ban on sth
content: ：禁令。lift a prohibition；a prohibition on/against sth＝a ban on sth；動詞 prohibit。

title: whisper sth in sb's ear
content: 在某人耳邊悄悄說某事。

title: make great/giant strides in ...
content: ：跨大步走；步伐。三態 stride–strode–stridden；make great/giant strides in ...；近 step、march。

title: switch / turn... off = switch / turn off...
mobile phone
content: 片：cellular phone = cell phone = mobile phone

title: worry about + N/V-ing
content: 擔心……。例：She worries about arriving late for class.

title: be burned into one's memory
content: 表示某段重大或強烈的經歷「深深烙印在記憶中」。例：The sight of the flooded town was burned into his memory.

title: halt
content: come to a halt = grind to a halt。

title: come into being = come into existence
long to V / long for + N
content: 表示「渴望做……／渴望得到……」。例：After months abroad, he longed to see his family again.

title: ask sb out (on a date / to dinner)
content: 約某人出來（約會／吃晚餐）。

title: violate
content: violate the law = break / disobey the law；violate sb's privacy。

title: for the duration of ...
content: *n.* 期間。for the duration of ...；近義 meantime。

title: isolate A from B
content: isolate A from B；separate A from B：將 A 與 B 隔離。

title: when it rains, it pours
content: 字面是「一下雨就下傾盆大雨」，比喻壞事接二連三發生，即「禍不單行」。例：My laptop broke after I lost my phone—when it rains, it pours.

title: cry out for help / let out a cry
content: 分別表示「大聲呼救／發出一聲叫喊」。例：The injured climber cried out for help.

title: on schedule / ahead of schedule / behind schedule
content: 按照進度／進度超前／進度落後。

title: at heart
content: 內心。例：Jay is serious in appearance but kind at heart.（傑伊外表嚴肅，但內心很和善。）

title: It is legal (for sb) to V
peculiar
content: be peculiar to + 地方 = be native to + 地方 = be indigenous to + 地方。

title: marvel at ...
content: ：驚訝；奇蹟。marvel at ...＝be amazed at；marvelous；近 wonder。

title: at... level
content: 在……的程度。例：Tom's English is at the highest level in his class.（湯姆的英文程度是班上最好的。）

title: a large / small amount of + 不可數名詞
get accustomed to + N/V-ing = get used to
content: *vt.* 使習慣：accustom oneself to ...；accustomed：get accustomed to + N/V-ing = get used to。

title: strike a balance between A and B
content: 在 A 與 B 之間維持平衡。

title: go + V-ing
content: 常用於戶外、休閒或體育活動。例：We went cycling along the river last Sunday.

title: either A or B 的主詞動詞一致
content: 連接兩個主詞時，動詞通常配合距離較近的主詞。例：Either the teachers or the principal is attending the meeting.

title: food 的可數性
content: 一般視為集合名詞、不可數；指特定一種或幾種食物時可數。

title: get/have a cramp
content: ：抽筋；束縛。get/have a cramp；cramp sb's style。

title: recover from...
content: 從……恢復過來／復元；= get over...；= recuperate from...。

title: maiden name
content: ：少女；（航行／飛行）初次。maiden voyage/flight、maiden name。

title: reach for sth
content: 伸手拿某物。例：Ezra reached for his wallet.（以斯拉伸手拿皮夾。）

title: It bothers sb that... = It bothers sb to V
give off ...
content: *vt. & vi.* 放射；散發、流露；形容詞 radiant 光芒四射的、容光煥發的；名詞 radiation。radiate from ...；give off ...；be radiant with ...。

title: try sth on / try on sth
content: 試穿／戴（衣服、帽子等）。例：Can I try on these shoes?（我可以試穿一下這雙鞋子嗎？）

title: honey 作親暱稱呼
content: 可用來稱呼伴侶或孩子，類似「親愛的、寶貝」。例：Honey, could you help me carry these bags?

title: take / have a seat = be seated = sit down
await vs. wait for
content: await 後接抽象事物作受詞；若接人為受詞，帶有「預期某事會發生在某人身上」之意。wait for 可接人或事物。

title: doom ... to failure
content: ：劫數；厄運；使注定難逃。doom ... to failure。

title: stop 與 cease
content: stop 與 cease 同義；stop to V 指停下某事去做另一件事，stop + V-ing 指停止做某事。

title: There is no question about / of
content: 毫無疑問。例：There is no question about her ability to lead the team.

title: arm + 人 + with + 事物
content: 表示「為某人配備武器、工具或知識」。例：The course arms students with practical communication skills.

title: pie in the sky / castles in the air
content: 都可表示「不切實際的夢想或計畫」。例：Without enough funding, the proposal may remain pie in the sky.

title: a couch potato
content: 成天躺在沙發上看電視的人。

title: reach + 地點
content: 到達某地。＝ arrive at / in + 地點。

title: attitude 後接的介詞
content: 本字之後多接介詞 to／toward(s)：an attitude to／toward(s) sth（對某事物的態度）。

title: cost 與 spend 的辨析
content: cost 和 spend 的中文均可譯成『花費』，惟 cost 的主詞是事物，spend 的主詞則是人。

title: nod / shake one's head
content: 分別表示「點頭／搖頭」。例：Leo shook his head when I asked whether he agreed.

title: detach A from B
content: ：使分開。detach A from B；反義 attach A to B。detached：冷漠的；獨立式的（house）；attached。

title: make / shoot a film
content: 表示「拍攝電影」。例：The director plans to shoot the film in Taiwan.

title: 不可數名詞搭配
content: a chalk（×）→ a piece of chalk（○）

title: for fear of + N/V-ing
content: 以免／免得／唯恐……；= for fear that...。

title: be fearful of...
content: 懼怕……。同義說法：be afraid of...。

title: foot the bill
content: 表示「負擔費用、買單」。例：The company agreed to foot the bill for the business dinner.

title: connect A to B
content: 把 A 連接到 B。

title: take the lead
content: 名列前茅，一馬當先。例：The home team took the lead from the beginning.（地主隊從一開始即取得領先。）

title: instant noodles / coffee / soup
content: 泡麵／即溶咖啡／即溶湯品。

title: a staff of 20 / 500
content: ／500 名員工。同義說法：20／500 staff members。

title: a sexually transmitted disease
content: 片 (2) a sexually transmitted disease 性病

title: deprive sb of sth
content: ：剝奪。deprive sb of sth＝rob sb of sth；relieve sb of ...。

title: be supposed to V ＝ should + V
fight over...
content: 為……吵架（＝ have a fight over...）。例：My parents fought over money last night.（昨晚我爸媽為錢吵架。）

title: withhold sth from sb
content: 片 withhold sth from sb 拒絕給與某人某物

title: audience 表多寡的修飾語
content: audience 為集合名詞，表多寡時應使用 large 或 small 來修飾：many／few audiences（×）→ a large／small audience（○，許多／很少觀眾）。

title: lecture 句型
content: lecture on …；lecture sb about / on sth。

title: natural / intuitive
content: *a.* 本能的、直覺的；名詞 instinct；近義 natural / intuitive。

title: draw (sb's) attention
content: 吸引（某人的）注意力。例：I'd like to draw your attention to page ten.（我想請大家注意看第 10 頁。）

title: inflict A on B
content: ：施加（傷害、打擊）。inflict A on B。

title: require + 人 + to V
content: 表示「要求某人做……」。例：The school requires visitors to sign in at the office.

title: prediction 搭配
content: make accurate predictions about sth：對某事做出精確預測。

title: determine to + V
content: 下定決心要……。同義句型：resolve to + V；make up one's mind to + V。

title: in the not too distant future
rejoice in/at sth
content: *a./adv./vt./n.* 快樂的／很、非常／使高興或勸說／歡樂活動；jolly ... along。joyous（事物、事件歡樂的）、joyful（人或心情喜悅的）、rejoice in/at sth。

title: the former
content: 前者；原書註明前面固定加 the。

title: draw + 人 + into / to + 地方
content: 表示「吸引某人進入或前往某處」。例：The smell of coffee drew several customers into the shop.

title: assemble 句型
content: assemble sth＝put sth together；disassemble sth＝take sth apart。

title: let alone...
content: 更別說……，用於否定句中。例：Ben can't afford a car, let alone a house.（班買不起車子，更別說買房子。）

title: not... either
content: 也不……。例：Josh can't sing, and he can't dance either.（喬許不會唱歌，也不會跳舞。）

title: take note of...
content: 留意……。例：You should take note of Ned's behavior.（你該注意奈德的言行。）

title: A be reliant on B
content: *a.* 依賴的：A be reliant on B；rely on ... 依賴。

title: on second thought = on second thoughts
oblige sb to + V
content: *vt.* 迫使、使負有義務、施加恩惠：oblige sb to + V、oblige sb by + V-ing；obliged 感激的：be obliged to sb for sth；obligation 道德或法律上的義務、責任。

title: sacrifice
content: at the sacrifice of ... = at the cost of ...。

title: throw sb a curve
content: throw sb a curve：給某人一個麻煩。

title: go on a hike
content: go on a hike = go hiking：去健行／遠足。

title: administrator / administrative
content: *vt.* 管理；執行／實施（法律等）；給予（藥物、治療等）。administer justice / the law；administer medicine to sb.；衍生 administrator / administrative；近義 manage。

title: can 的時態與否定
content: 助動詞過去式為 could；否定為 cannot 或 can't。

title: a surge in / of ...
content: *vi. & n.* 激增、上揚；急衝、湧入。a surge in / of ...；feel a surge of excitement / fury；近義 rise。

title: perhaps 與 maybe 的辨析
content: perhaps 與 maybe 均表『也許，可能』，但 perhaps 是比 maybe 稍微正式一點的說法。

title: reconcile A with B
content: 片：reconcile A with B、be reconciled with sb

title: be high in... = be rich in...
go by
content: 用於時間，表示「流逝、過去」。例：The afternoon went by quickly while we were talking.

title: dirty / body language
content: 髒話／肢體語言（視為不可數名詞）。

title: a big draw
content: 大家很喜歡的人／事／物。例：This famous actress will be the big draw at the film festival.（這位知名女星會是這次影展的一大看頭。）
