title: a big cheese
content: 口語表示「有權勢或重要的人物」。例：Her uncle is a big cheese in the advertising business.

title: be occupied with + N/V-ing
content: 忙於做……；= be busy with + N；= be busy + V-ing。

title: walk away (from sth)
content: （從某事中）脫身，離開。例：Henry decided to walk away from the deal.（亨利決定從這場交易中脫身。）

title: a table / chair leg
content: leg 除了人的腿，也能表示桌椅等家具的「腳」。例：One leg of the wooden chair is loose.

title: bring sb sth / bring sth to sb
content: 雙受詞句型；把某物帶給某人。例：Please bring me the form. = Please bring the form to me.

title: keep up with
content: 跟上進度或速度。例：I review every night to keep up with the class.

title: privilege
content: have the privilege of + V-ing = have the honor of + V-ing；be / feel privileged to + V。

title: maximum 句型
content: a maximum of + 數字＝at most + 數字：最多不超過…。

title: a wealth of + 可數／不可數名詞 = a lot of / lots of + 可數／不可數名詞
content: 大量的／許多的（有用或很好的東西）。

title: at one's peril
content: *n./vt.* 危險、使陷入危險：put sb in peril = put sb in danger、at one's peril；perilous 危險的。

title: contribute to...
content: 導致……；= lead to...；= result in...；= give rise to...；= bring about...。

title: It is useless to V
content: 做某事沒有用。例：It is useless to argue after the decision is final.

title: at sb.’s disposal
content: *vi.* 處理。dispose of ... = get rid of ...；disposable 用完即丟棄的；名詞 disposal，at sb.’s disposal 任由某人支配；近義 removal。

title: draft
content: draft a plan = draw up a plan = map out a plan。

title: hot 的常見延伸義
content: 除了「炎熱、辛辣」，hot song／hot issue 可表示「熱門歌曲／熱門議題」。例：Online privacy has become a hot issue.

title: fight for...
content: 為……奮戰。例：We should fight for freedom.（我們應為自由而戰。）

title: a piece of land
content: 一塊地。例：This piece of land is used for farming.（這塊地供農作用。）

title: insurance
content: life insurance；health insurance；insure (sb/sth) against ...；assure sb of ... = assure sb that ...。

title: carry out sth
content: 執行某事；完成某事。例：To carry out the plan, we need at least another $50,000.（為了要執行這個計畫，我們至少需要再追加 5 萬美元。）

title: in the course of
content: 在……過程中，相當於 during。例：He learned a lot in the course of the project.

title: be in a hurry to V
hard to say
content: 表示「很難判斷、難以斷言」。例：It's hard to say which plan will cost less.

title: confess
content: confess (to sb) that ...；confess to + N/V-ing = admit (to) + N/V-ing = own up to + N/V-ing。

title: wait / hold on a minute
content: 表示「請稍等一下」。例：Hold on a minute while I find the document.

title: connect with + 人
content: 與某人建立連結、良好關係或產生共鳴。例：The new student quickly connected with her classmates.

title: be absorbed in
content: be absorbed in …＝be buried in …：全神貫注於…。

title: be responsible for + N / V-ing
content: 表示「負責……」。例：Mia is responsible for checking the equipment each morning.

title: take sth with a grain of salt
content: 對某事採保留態度；對某事半信半疑。

title: machinery
content: machinery 為集合名詞、不可數。

title: organize + 活動／事件
content: 表示「籌辦、安排活動」。例：The students organized a charity sale at school.

title: trifle with ...
content: *n.* 瑣事；*vi.* 小看、怠慢。trifle with ...；形容詞 trifling / trivial。

title: at sb’s place
content: 在某人家裡。例：We are meeting at Jason’s place after dinner.

title: nag sb about sth
content: 片：nag sb to V、nag sb about sth、nag at sb

title: stick together
content: stick together：黏在一起；團結一致（延續用例）。

title: stand / cut in line
content: 排／插隊。例：Some people were standing in line at the hotdog stand.（有些人在熱狗攤排隊。）

title: assembly 搭配
content: the National Assembly：國民大會；an assembly line：裝配線。

title: want 通常不用進行式
content: want 表示「想要、需要」時屬於狀態動詞，通常說 I want，不說 I am wanting。例：I want a glass of water.

title: 數字 + thousand
content: 表「幾千」時，前面無論數字多少，thousand 一律不加 s，如 one / two / three / four thousand。

title: To be honest, ... ＝ Frankly speaking, ... ＝ To tell you the truth, ...
professor 與 lecturer 的分別
content: 書頁以「比」欄並列 professor（大學教授）與 lecturer（講師）作辨析。

title: in place
content: a. 貨幣的、金融的；片：monetary policy、in place

title: at the moment
content: 現在，此刻。例：What are you doing at the moment?（此刻你正在做什麼？）

title: a mine of information
content: 某方面的活字典／萬事通。（mine 此處指寶庫）

title: be tired of + N/V-ing = be bored with
as + 子句：因為……
content: 作連接詞，說明原因，語氣通常比 because 輕。例：As the road was blocked, we chose another route.

title: a designer shirt
content: designer *n.* 設計師；a designer shirt 名牌襯衫

title: as if...
content: 好像／似乎……。例：The man looked as if he was going to faint.（那名男子看起來好像要暈倒了。）

title: need 作助動詞
content: need 作助動詞的用法，在英式英語中較常見，且多用於否定句構中，例：need not V 不必做…… ＝ needn't V。例：It's only a short test; you needn't worry.（這只是個簡短的考試，你不必擔心。）

title: impression 搭配
content: a first impression；an impression of …；be left with the impression (that) …；make a good / bad impression on sb；have the impression that …；be under the impression (that) …。

title: be covered with...
content: 被……所覆蓋。例：In winter, the mountain is covered with snow.（冬天時，整座山被白雪覆蓋。）

title: save a dance for + 人
content: 表示「保留一支舞給某人」。例：Will you save the last dance for me?

title: sink or swim
content: sink or swim：自生自滅，載浮載沉。

title: adjust to
content: adjust to + N/V-ing＝adapt (oneself) to + N/V-ing＝accustom oneself to + N/V-ing：使自己適應…。

title: in addition to + N/V-ing = besides + N/V-ing
concentrate 句型
content: concentrate on …＝focus on …；concentrate A on B：將 A 集中在 B 上面。

title: reason that + 子句 / reason with + 人
content: reason that 表示「推論……」；reason with 表示「與某人講道理」。例：We tried to reason with him, but he refused to listen.

title: laugh at 與 laugh about
content: laugh at 常表示「嘲笑某人／某事」；laugh about 表示「因某件事而笑、拿某事說笑」。例：It's unkind to laugh at someone else's mistake.

title: an extra + 數字 = an additional + 數字
star in + 作品 / star + 演員
content: star in 表示「主演某作品」；作品作主詞時，star 可表示「由某人主演」。例：The film stars several young actors.

title: go to see a movie / go to the movies
content: 兩者都表示「去看電影」；go to the movies 常泛指去電影院。例：We're going to the movies after dinner.

title: be worn out
content: 累壞了（＝ be tired out ＝ be exhausted）。例：I was worn out after all the work.（所有工作做完後，我累壞了。）

title: be made of 與 be made from
content: be made of 用於仍看得出原料；be made from 用於原料經加工後難以辨認。例：The chair is made of wood, while paper is made from wood.

title: 數量詞 + of + which
content: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞為事物時可用 some／many／most／all／none + of which；不可改用 that。例：She borrowed five books, two of which were about space.

title: bond with
content: bond with …：與…建立關係、培養感情。

title: roughly + 數字
content: 表示大約、約莫，語氣較口語。例：The journey takes roughly two hours.

title: play with...
content: 和……一起玩。例：Little Vincent loves to play with his toy cars.（小文森喜歡玩他的玩具車。）

title: call a meeting
content: 召開會議。例：The coach called a meeting after practice.

title: admit sb to / into... = sb be admitted to / into...
hard 作形容詞與副詞
content: 可表示「堅硬的、困難的」，也可作副詞表示「努力地、猛烈地」。例：It rained hard while we were driving home.

title: present sb with sth = present sth to sb
emotional support
content: 表示「情感上的支持」。例：Close friends can provide emotional support during difficult times.

title: give + 人 + a smile / smile at + 人
content: 兩種結構都可表示「對某人微笑」。例：The nurse smiled at the nervous child.

title: respect A for B
content: 因 B 而尊敬 A。

title: a roll of toilet tissue / paper
fill out / in sth
content: 填寫（表格）。例：Fill out the form, and then give it back to me.（填好表格後，交還給我。）

title: tell / read sb a story
content: 告訴某人一個故事／念故事給某人聽。

title: have a population of + 數字
constitute 句型
content: A constitute B＝A form B＝A comprise B：A 組成／構成 B。

title: walk a dog / take a dog for a walk
content: 兩種說法都表示「遛狗」。例：Ella takes her dog for a walk before breakfast.

title: get back to basics
content: 開始注重基礎面，回到根本

title: a rash decision
content: *n.* 疹子；*a.* 草率的。break / come out in a rash；a rash decision；近義 hasty。

title: room together
content: 合租，一起租屋。例：We've been best friends since we roomed together after college.（自大學畢業一起租屋後，我們就一直是最好的朋友。）

title: be sentenced to death / life imprisonment
be crazy to V / be crazy about + N
content: be crazy to V 表示「做……很荒唐」；be crazy about 表示「非常迷戀……」。例：My sister is crazy about Korean dramas.

title: usher in...
content: 片：usher sb in / into / to...、usher in...

title: keep up with + N
content: 表示「持續掌握、跟上……」。例：Dad reads the news every morning to keep up with world events.

title: vary / various / variable / invariable
content: *adv.* 總是、不變地。相關 vary / various / variable / invariable；反義 variably。

title: balance A against B
content: 對 A 和 B 兩者作出權衡。

title: relate A to B = A is related to B
content: 找到 A 與 B 有關。

title: It is important for + 人 + to V
content: 表示「某人做……很重要」。例：It is important for children to get enough sleep.

title: mistake A for B
content: 誤將 A 當成 B。

title: work 的延伸義
content: 機器 work 表運作，方法 work 表有效；複數 works 可指作品。例：The printer works, and the artist’s latest works are upstairs.

title: match A against B = A be matched against B
cause/create friction
content: ：摩擦力；衝突（不可數）。cause/create friction；a source of friction between A and B；近 conflict、clash。

title: sth needs + V-ing
content: 某物需要以……方法處理。＝ sth needs to be + p.p.。例：Your car needs washing. ＝ Your car needs to be washed.（你的車需要洗了。）

title: a link between A and B
content: A 和 B（之間）有相關性。

title: make 的使役用法
content: 使役時用 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞；表「使得／成為」時用 make + 受詞 + 形容詞／名詞（受詞補語）。

title: come in first / second / third place
content: 比賽獲得第一／二／三名。例：Our class came in second place in the relay.

title: keep one's fingers crossed
content: 表示「祈求好運、希望事情順利」。例：Keep your fingers crossed for our team tomorrow.

title: break into...
content: 闖入……。例：The thief broke into my house and stole a gold watch.（小偷闖入我家偷走了一只金錶。）

title: take a taxi / train / bus
content: 搭乘交通工具；冠詞依交通工具而定。例：We took a train to Hualien.

title: transportation
content: come to a halt / stop；grind to a halt / stop。

title: cease 句型
content: cease to + V＝cease + V-ing：不做…／停止做…。without cease：不停地。

title: be eager to + 原形動詞
content: 渴望、迫切想做某事。例：The children were eager to see the new animals.

title: It takes sb + 時間 + to V
content: 表示某人花多少時間做某事。例：It takes Kai twenty minutes to walk to school.

title: fall behind
content: 落後。例：Sherry fell behind with her schoolwork.（雪莉的功課落後了。）

title: the young
content: the + 形容詞可表示一群人；the young 指「年輕人」，視為複數。例：This program creates new opportunities for the young.

title: A and B alike = both A and B
gulp sth down
content: vt. 吞食；似／片：gulp sth down、wolf sth down

title: evacuate sb from / to...
content: vt. 撤離；片：evacuate sb from / to...；衍：evacuation

title: tall 與 high
content: 皆有「高的」意；形容人很高時用 tall，不用 high。

title: lose one's temper
content: 發脾氣。例：Stay calm. Don't lose your temper.（保持冷靜，別發脾氣。）

title: be skeptical about...
content: a. 懷疑的；片：be skeptical about...；詞族：skeptic、skepticism

title: be filled with anger
content: be filled with anger：滿腔怒火。

title: break down
content: （車輛）拋錨；（機器）故障；（情緒）崩潰。例：The car broke down in the middle of nowhere.（這輛車子在荒郊野外拋錨了。）

title: pressure sb into + V-ing
content: 強迫某人做……；= pressure sb to V。

title: wind / solar / nuclear power
content: 風／太陽／核能。例：This new machine uses solar power to operate.（這臺新機器使用太陽能來運轉。）

title: a rubbish
content: *n.* 垃圾（英式、不可數）；美式 garbage / trash；也可指胡說：talk rubbish = talk nonsense/garbage。不可說 a rubbish，可說 a piece of rubbish。

title: make / give / deliver a speech on...
find meaning in + N / V-ing
content: 表示「在……之中找到意義」。例：He finds meaning in helping younger students.

title: in a moment
content: 很快，一會。例：I believe we'll get the truth in a moment.（我相信我們很快就會知道真相。）

title: retain sb’s title
content: retain sb’s title：衛冕；保留頭銜。

title: shark finning
content: shark finning：割鯊魚身，割取鯊魚。

title: the number of + 複數名詞
press a button
content: 表示「按下按鈕」。例：Press the green button to start the machine.

title: have a word (with sb)
content: （和某人）簡短交談（以尋求／提供建議）。

title: take a walk
content: 散步。＝ go for a walk。

title: a reason + 疑問詞 why 引導的名詞子句
believe in...
content: 相信……（的存在)；信仰……。例：Michael doesn't believe in Santa Claus.（麥可不相信有聖誕老公公。）

title: cry over / about + N
content: 表示「因……而哭泣或難過」。例：There's no need to cry over one small mistake.

title: small potatoes
content: 小人物（常用複數形式；不可數）。

title: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
content: n. 盎司；相關：pound；片：An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.

title: a cram school
content: ：硬塞；填鴨、惡補；死記硬背。cram A into B、cram for a test/exam、a cram school。

title: a heavy rain advisory
content: a special advisory committee 特別顧問委員會；a heavy rain advisory 大雨特報

title: go wrong
content: 出問題。例：I just don't know where we went wrong.（我就是不知道我們到底哪裡出問題了。）

title: feel a surge of excitement / fury
content: *vi. & n.* 激增、上揚；急衝、湧入。a surge in / of ...；feel a surge of excitement / fury；近義 rise。

title: otherwise 與 or
content: 均表「否則」；or 是連接詞、之前置逗點，otherwise 是副詞、之前置分號，用以連接兩個主要子句。

title: a state banquet
content: *n.* 盛大宴會；*vi.* 舉辦／參加宴會；*vt.* 宴請。a state banquet；近義 feast，a wedding feast。

title: wear a smile = have a smile on sb's face
stick together
content: stick together：黏在一起；團結一致。

title: all over again
content: 從頭再來、全部重做。例：The file was damaged, so we had to type the report all over again.

title: remember to V
content: 記得要做……。例：Remember to close the door when you leave.（你走時記得要把門關上。）

title: fortunate
content: It is fortunate that ...；the unfortunate＝不幸的人；have the misfortune to + V = have the misfortune of + V-ing。

title: have a go at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「嘗試做……」。例：Let me have a go at repairing the bicycle.

title: in the event of sth ＝ in the event that... ＝ in case of sth
be green with envy
content: 非常嫉妒、眼紅。例：Ben was green with envy when he saw the new bicycle.

title: play a(n) + adj. + role in...
content: 在……方面扮演……的角色。例：Hard work plays an important role in achieving success.（努力在獲致成功方面扮演重要的角色。）

title: load A with B = A be loaded with B
review for a test / an exam = do review for a test / an exam
be expert on / in / at + N/V-ing = be experienced in + N/V-ing
a bus/train/MRT station 等四組 station 搭配
content: 公車／火車／捷運站；加油站；警察局／消防站；電視臺／廣播電臺。例：The fire engines are kept at the fire station.（這些消防車全停放在消防站。）

title: with precision = precisely
content: *n.* 精確性：with precision = precisely；precise 精確的；precisely 精確地。

title: be weak in...
content: 拙於……。例：Jack is weak in English grammar.（傑克的英文文法不太好。）

title: scarcely
content: 主詞 + had scarcely + p.p. + when + 過去式子句；書上同列 hardly，並列出對應的 as soon as、upon/on + V-ing 表達。
